article.articleHeadline: Chinese Researcher Sentenced to Prison for Smuggling E. coli DNA into U.S.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-11, Youhuang Xiang, 32, a former Indiana University Bloomington post-doctoral researcher and Chinese national, was sentenced to more than four months in prison, a $500 fine, and one year of supervised release after pleading guilty to smuggling biological materials into the United States. He also agreed to a Judicial Order of Removal to China. Investigators traced a March 2024 shipment from Guangzhou Sci-Tech Innovation Trading to Xiang at his Bloomington residence; the package, mislabeled as “Underwear of Man-Made Fibers, Other Womens,” concealed DNA samples of E. coli to bypass U.S. import controls. The FBI began investigating in November 2025; Xiang admitted the concealed E. coli DNA during a November 23, 2025 CBP interview at Chicago O’Hare after returning from the UK. The case, led by FBI Indianapolis, CBP, and USDA OIG, underscores public safety, agricultural security, and national-security concerns associated with illicit biological materials; Xiang’s CCP affiliation was noted during sentencing.

triage.headline_ja: 中国人研究員、大腸菌DNAを密輸した罪で米国で投獄判決
triage.triage_reason: 本件は犯罪事件（密輸罪）であり、感染症アウトブレイク・公衆衛生上の発生ではない。E. coliの感染患者報告、疾病発症、流行の拡大といった要素がなく、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はバイオセキュリティ関連の刑事事件の判決報道である。密輸されたE. coli DNAサンプルについて、実際の感染症発症・拡大・アウトブレイクの報告はなく、感染症危機管理のシグナルには該当しない。発生地域に中国・米国が記載されているが、本件は感染症イベントではなく、公衆衛生上の発生報告ではないため、検証対象地域の評価対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nhóm trái cây trẻ mắc bệnh tay chân miệng nên ăn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fruits that children with hand, foot and mouth disease should eat.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is an acute contagious enterovirus infection. In Vietnam, parents are advised to support recovery with soft, watery fruits rich in antioxidants and vitamin C, while avoiding highly acidic citrus (orange, grapefruit, lemon) to minimize mouth irritation. Early HFMD can cause mouth ulcers and dehydration; recommended fruits include watermelon, cantaloupe, banana, avocado, papaya, grapes, dragon fruit, strawberries, blueberries, and ripe pear. These provide fiber, vitamins A/C/E, potassium, and hydration, potentially reducing oral discomfort. Preparation options: smoothies (banana, avocado, papaya, dragon fruit) with milk/yogurt or honey; diluted fruit juice; steaming or simmering to soften; soft jelly. Practice good hygiene: wash fruits, peel/remove seeds, clean utensils. Distribute fruit portions across the day and avoid overly cold items. HFMD usually resolves in 7–10 days; seek care for fever ≥39 C, lethargy, persistent crying, seizures, breathing difficulties, or blue discoloration.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の子どもが食べるべき果物グループ
triage.triage_reason: 記事は手足口病の栄養管理に関する医療アドバイス記事であり、新規の感染症イベント報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の新たなリスクを示していない。既知疾患の患者ケアに関する情報記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナムにおける手足口病の既知症例に対する栄養管理・食事療法についての一般向けアドバイス記事である。新たな流行報告、異常な増加、重篤化の増加、地域外への拡大の可能性などの疾病サーベイランス的なシグナルを含まない。患者ケアに関する医療情報提供記事として、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Sudin KPKP Jakbar vaksinasi puluhan hewan penular rabies di Tambora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Jakarta KPKP Office vaccinates dozens of rabies-transmitting animals in Tambora.
article.articleSummary: Vaccination of 60 rabies-transmitting animals (HPR)—cats, dogs, and monkeys—was conducted over 7–9 April 2026 in Jembatan Lima, Tambora, West Jakarta, by Sudin KPKP Jakarta Barat. The free campaign spanned three venues: Lurah Jembatan Lima office courtyard (7 April): 23 cats; RW 02, Jembatan Lima (8 April): 9 cats and 11 dogs; and the local kelurahan office (9 April): 17 cats. The effort, led by Head of Satlak KPKP Kecamatan Taman Sari Dede Sulaeman, aims to keep Jakarta, particularly West Jakarta, rabies-free. No human cases are reported in this article; it focuses on preventive vaccination to reduce rabies risk in domestic and stray animals. The program underscores ongoing public health measures to control HPR transmission within the capital.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャカルタKPKP事務所がタンボラで狂犬病を媒介する動物60頭に予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の予防接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、ヒト患者の報告はなく、すでに確立された動物予防接種プログラムの一環。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に該当せず、新規シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・ジャカルタにおける日常的な狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの報道。ヒト患者なし、流行の兆候なし。行政による定期的な予防対策活動として実施されているもので、感染症危機シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde investiga morte de criança de 8 anos por meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Investigates Death of an 8-Year-Old Child Due to Meningitis.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old child died on April 8, 2026, at Hospital Geral de Areias in Recife’s South Zone (Zona Sul), amid an investigation into meningitis. The Pernambuco State Health Secretariat (SES-PE) states the Meningococcal Disease protocol was used; school closures are not indicated, and chemoprophylaxis is selectively given to close contacts. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges surrounding the brain and spinal cord, caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, or non-infectious factors, with viral and bacterial forms drawing particular public health focus due to outbreaks and severity. Bacterial meningitis typically requires hospitalization and rapid antibiotic therapy; viral meningitis often resolves with supportive care; fungal and parasitic forms require longer, targeted treatment. Any suspected meningitis is an emergency. In children, irritability, bulging fontanelle, and persistent crying are notable warning signs. Case remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局が髄膜炎による8歳児の死亡を調査
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎による小児死亡事例は重要だが、現段階では単一症例の報告であり、流行や複数症例の発生の証拠がない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ペルナンブーコ州レシフェでの単一の髄膜炎死亡例を報告している。州保健局がメニンゴコッカス病プロトコルに従って対応中であり、学校閉鎖は示唆されていない。流行の兆候や複数症例の情報はサマリーに含まれていない。今後、追加症例や集団発生の報告があれば判定を変更する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Técnico de enfermagem é internado com suspeita de mpox em hospital de Itajaí - Jornal Razão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nursing technician hospitalized with suspected mpox at a hospital in Itajaí - Jornal Razão
article.articleSummary: Suspected mpox case in Itajaí, Santa Catarina: a nursing technician employed through a third‑party health provider is hospitalized at Hospital e Maternidade Marieta Konder Bornhausen with suspected mpox. A blood sample has been collected and sent to a laboratory in Florianópolis for analysis. As of 11 April 2026, no mpox case has been confirmed in Itajaí. Mpox, formerly monkeypox, is caused by the Monkeypox virus and spreads mainly through close contact with an infected person. The most characteristic symptom is a skin eruption with blisters or sores, which can last two to four weeks, often accompanied by fever, headaches, muscle pains, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes. The Ministry of Health advises immediate isolation for suspected or confirmed cases and avoiding sharing personal items during the transmission period. Treatment is supportive. The patient remains hospitalized; lab result not yet disclosed. Case under surveillance by the Itajaí Health Secretariat.

triage.headline_ja: 看護技術者がイタジャイの病院でMpox疑い例で入院 - ジョルナル・ラザン
triage.triage_reason: Mpox疑い例であり異常/予想外性があり、医療従事者の感染リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性などスクリーニング基準を複数満たすが、未確診例で検査結果未判定であり情報が確定していないため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Mpox疑い例であり未確診のため、検査結果が重要。医療従事者の感染は感染制御上の関心が高い。ブラジルはMpox地域流行国であり、今後の確認検査の結果を注視する必要がある。スクリーニング基準で異常性、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、医療機関での曝露リスク（医療従事者）が認識されているが、確定症例ではなく検査結果待ちの段階。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Mudah Menular, Anak Jangan Dulu Masuk Sekolah Bila Muncul Gejala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Is Highly Contagious; Children Should Not Go to School If Symptoms Appear.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Jakarta is highlighted as highly contagious: a single infected child can spread to 12-18 others via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking, and via contaminated surfaces. Indonesian health official Dr. Andi Saguni warns the transmission risk is high, so children with symptoms should not attend school until fully recovered. Early symptoms constitute the 3C: Cough, Coryza (runny nose), and Conjunctivitis (red eyes), appearing days before a rash. When a student is diagnosed, teachers should actively monitor classmates for signs and refer suspected cases to healthcare facilities for diagnosis and treatment. Infected children should stay at home to prevent further spread and only return after recovery. Source: Liputan6.com, Jakarta, published 2026-04-11.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しん（はしか）は非常に感染しやすい。症状が出たら子どもは学校に行かないこと
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジャカルタにおける麻しん流行の報道。高い感染性（1人から12-18人への伝播）、学校での集団発症リスク、公衆衛生対応の必要性が指摘されており、IHR基準（異常性・公衆衛生影響）およびWPRO基準（流行しやすさ・長期曝露リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタでの麻しん集団発症を報道。感染力の高さ（R=12-18）と学校における伝播リスクが強調されており、地域の公衆衛生対応が活発化している兆候がある。国際的拡大リスクは記事では言及されていないため、IHR基準は2つに留まるが、WPRO基準で4つが該当し、流行拡大の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: SRAG no Ceará cai 12,5%, com 977 casos em quatro semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SARI in Ceará falls 12.5%, with 977 cases in four weeks.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-related Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) in Ceará, Brazil, totaled 977 cases in four weeks (title), with 865 confirmed influenza-related SARI cases up to epidemiological week 13. Children aged 1–4 years were the most affected (25.5%), followed by people aged 70+ (21.4%). Influenza vaccination was advanced for priority groups; Ceará was the first state to receive the vaccine and start the campaign, receiving an initial 760,000 doses from the Ministry of Health. Priority groups include children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant women, seniors 60+, homelessness, and healthcare workers. On 11–12 April, Fortaleza will offer influenza vaccination at Shopping Benfica and Grand Shopping from 11:00 to 16:00, continuing to prioritize the same groups.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州のSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）が12.5%低下、4週間で977症例
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ関連SARIの症例数が低下傾向を示しており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中で対策が実施されている。公開されているサーベイランスデータの定期報告であり、異常な急増や制御不能な状況の兆候はない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。本イベントは定期的なサーベイランスレポートであり、症例数の低下傾向、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中、死亡や重症化に関する報告がないため、シグナルとしてピックアップする根拠に乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Two new vaccines show promise in tackling TB, especially among kids
article.articleSummary: Two new vaccines, VPM1002 (genetically modified recombinant BCG by Serum Institute of India, Pune) and Immuvac (Cadila), show promise against TB in a BMJ study published April 9. In a cohort of household contacts aged 6+, both vaccines were safe but did not protect against all microbiologically confirmed TB or pulmonary TB. VPM1002 showed 50.4% effectiveness against extrapulmonary TB (EPTB) overall and 79.5% in 36–60-year-olds; Immuvac showed 66.3% efficacy against EPTB in latent TB and over 60% against EPTB in 6–10-year-olds. Across groups, VPM1002 provided about 60% efficacy against all TB, PTB and EPTB in 6–14 years; Immuvac about 60% against EPTB in 6–10 years. EPTB accounts for roughly 22% of India’s TB cases and affects lymph nodes, pleura, abdomen and spine. Neither vaccine offered general protection or prevented latent infection; protection from latent TB at 6 months was noted. Underweight individuals remained unprotected, underscoring the need for nutrition and housing improvements alongside vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 2つの新しいワクチンが結核対策で有望性を示す、特に子どもたちの間で
triage.triage_reason: 結核ワクチンの臨床試験結果に関する医学的ニュースであり、新規感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではなく、既知疾患の治療開発に関する記事。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、公衆衛生危機としての突発的な関心の対象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBMJ誌に発表された結核ワクチン（VPM1002およびImmuvac）の臨床試験結果に関する科学的ニュースである。インドでの既知の結核流行状況の報告ではなく、新規アウトブレイクやシグナル検出ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Com dois casos registrados por dia, estado reforça vacinação contra gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With two cases reported per day, the state reinforces influenza vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Two influenza-associated SRAG cases per day are recorded in Pernambuco, Brazil, during the seasonal SRAG period, with vaccination campaigns ongoing since March 28. In 11 days, 322,045 people were vaccinated, of whom 238,756 are in priority groups (6 months–<6 years, pregnant women, and adults ≥60), about 10.8% of priority targets; the Ministry of Health aims for 90%. Day D vaccination exceeded 180,000, nearly double 2025. The state reports 1,371 SRAG cases and 29 deaths as of April 10; 204 influenza-related SRAG, 162 other respiratory viruses, 22 COVID-19, 17 other etiologies. 0–9 year-olds account for 895 SRAG cases (65%). Hospital capacity is stressed: 80% neonatal ICU SRAG, 87.2% pediatric ward, 96.6% pediatric ICU SRAG occupancy. Pernambuco also implements RSV vaccination for pregnant women; 38,541 vaccinated; 114,058 estimated. Monoclonal antibody nirsevimabe added to SUS; 1,599 doses given.

triage.headline_ja: 1日2件の症例報告で、ペルナンブーコ州がインフルエンザワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける季節性SRAGの増加（インフルエンザ関連204件、RSV、COVID-19を含む）と小児への影響が観察される。小児ICU占有率96.6%と医療逼迫の兆候があるが、現段階では国家的危機を示す明確な証拠に乏しく、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性SRAGイベントであるが、小児（0-9歳が65%）への集中度が高く、小児ICU占有率96.6%と医療システムの逼迫が懸念される。複数病原体（インフルエンザ、RSV、COVID-19）の同時流行状態。ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中で、政府対応も активном。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（serious_impact）であり、WHOへの自動通知基準には達していないが、WPRO基準では3項目該当。続報による医療逼迫の深刻化や死亡数増加の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Exportaciones: temen que se cierren mercados en ovinos y subproductos cárnicos por una enfermedad que investiga el Senasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exports: They fear that markets for sheep and meat by-products will close due to a disease under investigation by Senasa.
article.articleSummary: Argentina's Senasa is investigating a possible scrapie case in sheep in Santa Fe province, a fatal neurodegenerative transmissible spongiform encephalopathy not previously confirmed domestically. The farm has been interdicted for 60 days. The episode involves Dorper pedigree imports from Paraguay; some male animals developed symptoms after arrival and were sacrificed, and a ewe born to an imported animal later manifested symptoms and was sent to INTA Castelar for diagnostics. Argentina had been scrapie-free, but internal documents indicate the status may be in question and that export certificates for animal-origin products, pet foods, and dairy derivatives will be suspended starting Friday. Potential export disruptions could affect Algeria (dairy products) and China (bone meal and meat by-products). Paraguay is cited as free but with different controls; Brazil has atypical scrapie. Certificates will need to declare 'scrapie-free' status; protocols may need renegotiation.

triage.headline_ja: 輸出：Senasaが調査中の病気によりヒツジおよび食肉副産物市場が閉鎖される恐れ
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンで初めて確認されたスクレイピーの疑い事例であり、異常かつ予想外の発生である。国内でスクレイピーフリーステータスを失う可能性があり、国際貿易（アルジェリア、中国への輸出）に直接的な影響を及ぼす重大なリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでのスクレイピー疑い事例であるが、対象国リストにはアルゼンチンが含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ただし、記事にてブラジルの非定型スクレイピーが言及され、中国がアルゼンチンの骨粉・食肉副産物の主要輸入国として具体的に影響を受けると述べられているため、これら対象国を含める。パラグアイも文脈に登場するが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中國35歲孕婦吃冰箱剩菜感染 撐3個月去世 | 李斯特菌 | 發熱 | 腹瀉 | 新唐人电视台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: A 35-year-old pregnant woman who ate fridge leftovers contracted Listeria and died after three months | Listeria | fever | diarrhea | New Tang Dynasty Television
article.articleSummary: In Zhengzhou, Henan, China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman who ate refrigerator leftovers contracted Listeria monocytogenes, was laboratory-confirmed, and died three months later. The case highlights high listeriosis risk during pregnancy, which can cause miscarriage, preterm birth, or perinatal death. The patient fell ill after consuming leftovers; Listeria can survive at 5°C and even at -20°C, earning it the nickname ‘fridge killer.’ Common sources include meat and dairy; symptoms include fever and diarrhea. Public health guidance urges thorough reheating of leftovers (about 10 minutes), avoiding long cold storage, separating raw and cooked foods, washing produce, and maintaining fridge hygiene. Monthly cleaning is advised, with attention to door seals, shelves, crisper drawer, and inner walls to prevent contamination. Source: New Tang Dynasty Television (NTDTV).

triage.headline_ja: 中国：35歳の妊婦が冷蔵庫の残り物を食べてリステリア感染、3ヶ月後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: リステリア症による妊婦死亡は重大だが、単一症例の報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当や国際的懸念を示す情報が不足している。引き続き同地域での集団発生の有無を経過観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一の妊婦死亡症例報告。リステリア症は妊娠中に重症化しやすく死亡リスクが高いため重大度は高い。ただし、食品由来の散発症例であり、集団発生や広域拡散の兆候は記事に見当たらない。郑州市および河南省での追加症例の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ba người ở Cà Mau nghi mắc viêm não mô cầu, một tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people in Ca Mau suspected of meningococcal meningitis, one death.
article.articleSummary: Three residents of Hamlet 6, Khanh An Commune, Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, are suspected of meningococcal meningitis, with one death. On 10 April, Ca Mau CDC announced epidemiological investigation, containment measures, and response to limit spread. Patient 1, admitted 7 April, presented altered consciousness, purpuric rash, vomiting, and neck stiffness; diagnosed with fever of unknown origin, meningitis risk, and septic shock; blood sample sent to Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City. Patient 2, admitted 8 April, developed high fever, confusion, rapid breathing, progressed to coma, and died early 9 April; septic shock with comorbidities noted; sample sent for testing. Patient 3, admitted 9 April after days of fever, cough, myalgia, hypotension, and pleural effusion; fever and purpura; suspected sepsis, dengue fever, and pneumonia; CSF and blood sent. All had contact with a death in mid-March; results pending. No new suspected cases; close contacts monitored for 10 days; authorities vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の疑い例3名、うち1名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の死亡例を含む集団疑い事例であり、IHR基準において重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、またWPRO基準において重症度（死亡）、長期曝露の可能性、流行しやすさ（接触者追跡中）を満たすためフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は高い致死率と二次感染の危険性があり、IHR基準の3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。デング熱も疑われており複合的な評価が必要。Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City での確定診断待機中。接触者監視が適切に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 【立百病毒系列1/3】走过疫情重击　双溪立百新村现况如何？ | 特写 | 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Libai Virus Series Part 1 of 3: Having weathered the epidemic's severe blow, what's the current situation in Shuangxi Libai New Village? | Feature | Life
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus outbreak in Kampung Sungai Nipah (Sungai Nipah New Village) near Port Dickson, Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia, began during the Lunar New Year, lasting about a month and killing more than 109 people. Authorities culled over 1.16 million pigs; villagers were evacuated and pigs buried in pits. Twenty-seven years on (2026), survivor Lin Jianmin recalls the trauma and the collapse of pig farming, with many families later finding work at Kuala Lumpur International Airport and in duty-free shops. A Nipah Time Tunnel Museum, opened in 2018, documents the events. The village traces to 1952 under British colonial policy forming a “New Village”; pig farming once thrived before the 1998–1999 Nipah outbreak shut the industry and spurred diversification. The piece also notes an earlier Nipah outbreak in West Bengal this year as a global health alert.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルス系列1/3：疫病の打撃を乗り越えて　双渓ニパール新村の現況は如何に？
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的な1998-1999年ニパール流行の回顧記事が主体だが、記事サマリーで2026年のインド（西ベンガル州）での新規ニパール発生が言及されている。現在の流行状況の詳細が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はマレーシアの歴史的なニパール流行（1998-1999年）の回顧だが、対象国リストではマレーシアが含まれていない。サマリーで2026年のインド（西ベンガル州）でのニパール流行が言及されており、このイベントが verified_locations に該当する。インドでの現在の流行規模、症例数、死亡者数などの詳細情報が記事本文に記載されていないため、情報不足として WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Lonjakan Kasus Campak di Indonesia, Ancaman Nyata yang Tak Pandang Usia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases surge in Indonesia, a real threat that knows no age.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surge in Indonesia, signaling a threat beyond childhood. WHO ranks Indonesia second worldwide for measles in 2025 with 17,204 confirmed cases, a pattern continuing into 2026. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health, through week 8 of 2026, reports 8,372 confirmed cases and 10,453 suspected. Measles is a highly contagious airborne infection; a single case can transmit to up to 18 susceptible people, and the virus can linger in air or on surfaces for up to two hours after the patient leaves. Without vaccination, measles can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. Transmission is facilitated in crowded closed spaces like public transport and classrooms. A major concern is immune amnesia: 11–73% of the antibody memory bank may be erased after infection, leaving recovered individuals vulnerable to other diseases. Dr. Nina Dwi Putri notes severe complications can occur even in adults; a young doctor’s death is suspected due to measles.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのはしか患者数の急増、年齢に関係なく現実の脅威
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで2025年に確認患者17,204名、2026年第8週で確認患者8,372名・疑い患者10,453名と大規模な麻疹流行が継続しており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、ヒト-ヒト感染の高さ）と WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行可能性、国際的な関心）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが2025年の麻疹患者数で世界第2位にランクしたインドネシアの継続的な大規模流行。免疫健忘症による二次的感染リスク、成人も含めた重症化、2026年初期の患者数増加傾向が懸念される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Descoperire Ã®ngrijorÄƒtoare. Virusul din fructele de mare care a trecut la oameni È™i provoacÄƒ o afectiune gravÄƒ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming discovery. The virus from shellfish that has jumped to humans and causes a serious condition.
article.articleSummary: China researchers investigating a rise in an unusual ocular disease have found evidence linking a marine Nodavirus (CMNV) to a chronic viral anterior uveitis with persistent ocular hypertension (POH-VAU) in humans. In a study of 70 POH-VAU patients diagnosed 2022–2025, viral particles were detected in ocular tissues, with immunological markers specific to CMNV and genetic analysis showing ~99% similarity to CMNV strains from aquatic animals. The team notes that most affected individuals reported frequent exposure to raw seafood or handling of seafood without protective gear, suggesting a zoonotic transmission route. Experimental work in cell cultures and mice reproduced features including ocular inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure, supporting a potential causal role for CMNV. The virus appears not geographically restricted, found in multiple marine species (crabs, mollusks) across continents. Findings published in Nature Microbiology; highlighted by MedicalXpress; emphasize seafood safety and ongoing surveillance for emergent zoonoses.

triage.headline_ja: 懸念される発見。貝類から人間に感染したウイルスが深刻な症状を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾患、国際的な地理的拡大の可能性）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。新規ウイルス（CMNV）の人獣共通感染症としての確認であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 未知の眼病（慢性ウイルス性前部ぶどう膜炎）とCMNV（海産ノダウイルス）の関連を初めて報告する新規知見。貝類由来の人獣共通感染症であり、複数大陸で海産動物に存在することが確認されている。Nature Microbiologyに掲載された査読済み論文がソース。食品安全および新興人獣共通感染症監視の観点で重要。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau: 3 trường hợp nghi viêm não mô cầu, 1 người đã tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau: 3 suspected meningococcal meningitis cases, 1 person has died.
article.articleSummary: On 11 April 2026, Ca Mau Provincial Center for Disease Control reported three suspected meningococcal meningitis cases in Hamlet 6, Khanh An Commune, Ca Mau Province. All three had contact with a person who died in March 2026 after fever, petechiae, and hypotension. Case 1: admitted 7 April with petechiae, vomiting, lethargy; fever of unknown origin; meningitis/sepsis suspected; blood sample sent to Pasteur Institute, Ho Chi Minh City. Case 2: admitted 8 April with high fever and altered mental status; died 9 April; diagnosed as septic shock from gastrointestinal infection with multiple comorbidities; samples collected for etiologic testing. Case 3: transferred 9 April after prolonged fever, cough, myalgia, hypotension and pleural effusion; fever with skin hemorrhages; initially managed as sepsis, dengue fever, and pneumonia; CSF and blood sent for testing. No additional suspected cases reported at investigation time; local authorities implementing outbreak controls.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の疑い例3件、1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の死亡例を含む確定・疑い例が複数報告され、IHR基準で「重篤な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常/予想外」の2基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）と管理可能性で該当。感染症危機対応の開始が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに3つの疾患が記載されているが、主題は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の集団発生。死亡例1件、重症例複数（敗血性ショック）が報告されており、直近での感染症危機管理対応が必要。サマリー内でデング熱や肺炎の鑑別も言及されているため、複合的な評価が重要。パスツール研究所（ホーチミン市）への検査送付により、確定診断の早期判明が期待される。

article.articleHeadline: 74 Kasus Suspek Campak di Sidoarjo, Dinkes Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan dan Tunggu Hasil Lab - Suara Merdeka Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 74 Suspected Measles Cases in Sidoarjo, Health Office Steps Up Vigilance and Waits for Lab Results - Suara Merdeka East Java
article.articleSummary: As of April 11, 2026, Sidoarjo Regency, East Java, reports 74 suspected measles cases across multiple areas, with patients under monitoring while awaiting laboratory confirmation. Numerous samples have been sent to the provincial lab for testing, but results are pending due to reagent shortages. Despite the high number of suspected cases, officials state no severe symptoms or complications have been observed and no confirmed measles cases yet. Routine measles vaccination continues normally, with no central-government policy on additional vaccination for health workers; vaccination by health personnel remains allowed on a voluntary basis. In addition to outbreak surveillance, Dinkes Sidoarjo is reinforcing maternal and neonatal mortality reduction through cross-disciplinary collaboration between obstetricians (SpOG) and pediatricians (SpA), and is advocating uniform implementation of Clinical Practice Guidelines (PPK) across facilities.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョで麻疹が74例疑い例、保健局が警戒を強化し検査結果を待機中
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの麻疹疑い例74例の報告であり、異常/予想外性と長期曝露のリスクが認められるが、確定例ゼロ、重症例なし、検査結果待機中のため情報が不完全。続報により確定例・重症度が明確になれば評価が変わる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事では74例全てが疑い例であり、確定例はゼロ。重症例・合併症の報告もなし。検査試薬不足により検査結果待機中。麻疹はWPRO域内でのリスク疾患だが、現段階では確定例がないため、検査結果による続報が重要。地域的に対象国（インドネシア）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya en alza en Tucumán: claves para prevenir contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya on the rise in Tucumán: keys to preventing transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-11, Tucumán, Argentina reports a chikungunya outbreak with cases rising from 10 to 93 in 15 days. Most transmission foci are in the southeast neighborhoods of San Miguel de Tucumán, plus El Manantial and San Pablo; some isolated cases have no travel history, indicating local circulation and higher transmission risk. The outbreak is driven by Aedes aegypti, with rainfall sustaining larval habitats. Health authorities have intensified control operations, including epidemiological surveillance and vector control; a recent operation was conducted in Yerba Buena, Barrio 120 Viviendas. With no vaccine or specific treatment, prevention focuses on eliminating mosquito breeding sites. Key measures: remove or store objects that collect water, cover or routinely flush drains, keep pools chlorinated and filtered, and wash containers every three days. Aedes eggs can persist up to a year on container walls and hatch when water returns.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱はトゥクマン州で増加中：感染を予防するための重要ポイント
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の異常事象、国際的拡大リスク）。15日間で10例から93例への急速な増加、地域流行の確認、ベクター媒介性感染症による南米での懸念。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはメキシコ、アルゼンチン、ポルトガルが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアルゼンチンのトゥクマン州でのチクングニア熱アウトブレークである。対象国リスト内ではフィリピンのみが該当する（Calabarzon地域が記事で言及されている）。ただし記事の主要な焦点はアルゼンチンであり、フィリピンは地理的に記事の補助的な参照地域と考えられる。本来対象国外のイベントであるが、API結果にフィリピンが含まれているため検証位置に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 7 người chết vì chó dại cắn trong 4 tháng tại Tây Ninh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven people died of rabies after being bitten by rabid dogs in Tay Ninh over a four-month period.
article.articleSummary: Seven people have died of rabies in Tay Ninh province, Vietnam, after dog bites dating from the start of 2026. The most recent fatality is Phan Văn Đol, 66, of Lộc Ninh, who died about one year after exposure. He developed fatigue, fever, headache, anxiety, hydrophobia (fear of water), photophobia, aerophobia, seizures, and excessive saliva; he was hospitalized but prognosis deteriorated and he died at home. In his history, about a year earlier his family’s dog bit him and his brother; they did not seek medical care, rinsed wounds with water, and used garlic; the dog later left the house. Six other victims: all men, from Lương Hòa, Hưng Điền, Mỹ Hạnh, Đức Lập, Mỹ An and phường Thanh Điền. Incubation ranged from one month to one year; most infections came from household dogs of acquaintances. Authorities warn hot season raises rabies risk in pets as of 11 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのタイニン省でイヌ咬傷による狂犬病で4ヶ月間に7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による複数死亡事例（7人、4ヶ月間）の報告で、IHR基準の「異常性」と「重症度」に該当。地域内での継続的な曝露リスク（家庭犬からのヒト感染）と予防接種未実施による管理可能性の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タイニン省及び周辺複数地域（ロックニン、フンディエン、ドゥクラップなど）での狂犬病死亡事例が報告されている。潜伏期間が1ヶ月～1年と長く、家庭犬からの感染が主要な感染源。予防接種未実施による死亡率100%の懸念。当局が公式警告を発出。

article.articleHeadline: 【立百病毒系列3/3】不是日本脑炎！　陈忠登医生率团揭开立百病毒致命真相 | 特写 | 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Li Bai Virus Series Part 3/3] Not Japanese Encephalitis! Dr. Chen Zhongdeng Leads Team to Unveil the Deadly Truth of the Li Bai Virus | Feature | Life
article.articleSummary: Nearly 109 human deaths and over a million pigs culled during Malaysia’s Nipah virus outbreak, initially misdiagnosed as Japanese Encephalitis. First cases appeared Feb 27; by June there were 94 cases. Infected individuals, mostly healthy middle-aged pig farmers, developed high fever and delirium, with about 30% dying within ~10 days. The outbreak clustered near Nipah Village (立白新村) and Bukit Pelanduk; a ~100-foot-wide Sungai Pelek river separated affected communities, arguing against mosquito transmission. JE antibodies were misleading. Dr. Chen Zhongdeng led Universiti Malaya Medical Centre teams; after culturing samples, the virus was identified and sent to the US CDC, named Nipah virus, with the first patient sample from Nipah Village. Bats (Pteropus) identified as natural reservoir; spillover to pigs then humans. Bangladesh and India outbreaks later showed human-to-human transmission. Nipah encephalitis is now recognized as highly deadly, with outbreaks in Kerala, Mindanao, Singapore and elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: 【立百病毒シリーズ3/3】日本脳炎ではない！陳忠登医生がチームを率いてニパ病毒の致命的な真実を解明 | 特集 | ライフ
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスアウトブレイクにおいて109人の死亡例と100万頭以上の豚の殺処分が報告され、複数国（マレーシア、バングラデシュ、インド）での発生が確認されている。IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでマレーシア、バングラデシュ、インド、フィリピン（ミンダナオ）、シンガポール、ケーララ州での発生が記載されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには複数国が含まれているが、verified_locationsは対象国リストに該当する実際の発生地のみを記載。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。初期診断の誤り（日本脳炎との混同）、ヒト-ヒト感染の確認、高い致命率（約30%）、動物-ヒト感染の媒介者（コウモリ→豚→ヒト）が確認されており、新興感染症として重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 50 Rumah RW 06 Kalideres Jadi Sasaran Gerebek Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 50 Houses in RW 06 Kalideres Targeted by Mosquito Breeding Site Eradication Raids
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever control activity conducted in Kalideres, Jakarta. On 11 April 2026 at about 09:00 WIB, 50 houses in Kampung Kojan, RT 009 RW 06, Kalideres were inspected via vector-control raids (PSN) by joint teams including Satpol PP, Kalideres Public Health Center, RT/RW leaders, and jumantik volunteers. Larvae were found in 4 residences, with the highest infestation in a resident’s water bucket. Immediate 3M actions—Drain, Close, and Recycle—were implemented to remove standing water and clean containers. Residents received education to become independent jumantik to prevent dengue transmission. The initiative targets breaking the dengue transmission chain in Jakarta, focusing on Aedes breeding sites in housing areas.

triage.headline_ja: カリデレス地区RW 06の50戸がボウフラ防除作戦の対象に
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防・制御活動に関する記事であり、デングは地域的に風土病であるが、本記事は個別の駆除キャンペーンの実施報告に過ぎず、異常な発生状況や重篤な影響の増加を示す新しいシグナルは認められない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジャカルタのカリデレス地区で実施された定期的なデング媒介蚊の駆除活動を報じたものである。4軒の住宅でボウフラが発見されたことが述べられているが、これは日常的な制御活動の一部として機能している。新規発生の増加や重症化を示す兆候は認められず、異常性も低い。ただし、デングは地域の流行性疾患であり、継続的な曝露リスクが存在するため、より大規模な発生増加の兆候に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Ekor HPR Divaksinasi dan Sterilisasi, Upaya Cegah Penyebaran Kasus Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of rabies-transmitting animals vaccinated and sterilized in an effort to prevent the spread of rabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination and sterilization drive in Jembrana Regency, Bali, focusing on Mendoyo District in the red zone (Pohsanten Village). The program, a collaboration between the Jembrana Regency government and Yayasan Seva Buana, targets dogs and cats. Vaccinated animals receive a red collar and a vaccination card; sterilization is available but requires waiting. As of March, 15 rabies-positive animals (HPR) had been recorded in Jembrana, with Mendoyo reporting the highest numbers. Residents such as Ayu Rika brought multiple pets to the event (one dog and two cats). Officials say the combined vaccination and sterilization approach aims to curb rabies transmission by reducing the susceptible animal population, especially in red zones, to prevent further spread of positive rabies cases. The initiative highlights the need for ongoing public awareness and field vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: 数十頭の動物がワクチン接種と去勢手術を受ける、狂犬病の蔓延防止を図る
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）での狂犬病動物検出は異常と評価でき、WPROスクリーニング基準に該当する可能性があるが、ワクチン接種・去勢手術による予防対策プログラムであり、深刻な公衆衛生危機の段階ではない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: バリ州ジェンブラナ県メンドヨ地区での狂犬病検出。2026年3月時点で15頭の狂犬病陽性動物(HPR)が記録されている。当該イベントは動物への感染症対策の予防プログラムであり、人間への公衆衛生的な緊急性は現時点では低い。ただしバリは観光地であり、継続的な動物の狂犬病状況と人への感染リスクの推移を監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau ghi nhận 3 ca nghi mắc não mô cầu , 1 trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau reports 3 suspected meningococcal meningitis cases, 1 death.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau reports 3 suspected meningococcal meningitis cases in ấp 6, Khánh An commune, Ca Mau province, with 1 death. All patients are above 30. As of 10 April 2026, the first case is a 37-year-old woman admitted to Ca Mau General Hospital on 7 April for fever of unknown origin with suspected meningitis; a sample was sent to Viện Pasteur Ho Chi Minh City for testing. The second case is a 66-year-old woman admitted on 8 April with high fever, impaired consciousness, and tachypnea; she deteriorated and died in the early hours of 9 April, death attributed to septic shock from a gastrointestinal source with multiple comorbidities. The third case is a 31-year-old woman admitted on 9 April after prolonged fever, diagnosed with septicemia, dengue fever, and pneumonia; CSF and blood samples sent for etiological testing. All three had contact with a fatal case from mid-March 2026 (death due to septic shock from GI infection, hypertension, Cushing’s syndrome). Authorities launched investigations, contact tracing, surveillance, and environmental disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で髄膜炎菌髄膜炎の疑い患者3人を報告、1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎の疑い患者3人（死亡1人）が短期間に同一地域で発生し、予期しない事象であり、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）とWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、対応の必要性）を複数満たす。当該感染症は国際的公衆衛生上重大な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 記事では3人が髄膜炎菌髄膜炎の『疑い』患者とされ、1人は既に死亡（死因は消化管感染による敗血性ショック）。確定診断待機中。同一地域（カマウ省カンアン郡アップ6）での短期間（4月7日～9日）の集中発生、3月中旬からの関連事例との時間的関連性、接触者追跡と環境消毒が展開中。Bluedot分類に古典的豚熱とデング熱も含まれているが、記事サマリーは髄膜炎菌髄膜炎に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Tháp ứng phó với dịch tả heo châu Phi có nguy cơ bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Thap Province Responds to African Swine Fever with Outbreak Risk
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) remains a high risk in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam, where the pig herd totals about 460,900 across the Mekong Delta region. In the week of 26 March–1 April, an ASF outbreak occurred in Tan Ho Co commune, with 60 pigs infected and culled. Since the end of last year, Dong Thap has recorded 51 ASF outbreaks in 11 communes/wards, resulting in the culling of 1,673 pigs; several outbreaks remain under 21 days of observation. Authorities are implementing stringent, province-wide control measures, with the Department of Agriculture and Environment leading technical guidance; transport and sale of pigs and pork products are being controlled; public awareness campaigns are being intensified. The province emphasizes active local leadership to prevent complacency. Separately, 11 ASF outbreaks were reported in Vinh Long Province, including an outbreak in Long Hiep commune reported by local officials on 27 March.

triage.headline_ja: ドン・タップ省がアフリカ豚熱の流行リスクに対応
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（ASF）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低いが、ベトナムにおける継続的な複数のアウトブレイク報告と管理上の課題が認識されているため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはアフリカ豚熱（動物疾患）であり、IHR基準の該当数は0。しかしWPRO基準では「長期曝露」（51件のアウトブレイク、継続的な発生）と「流行しやすさ」（豚群への感染性、管理上の課題）に該当。政府・自治体レベルでの対応強化が報告されており、社会的関心も高い。ただし、ヒト感染症ではなく動物疾患であるため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Mysterious Seafood Virus May Be Behind
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious Seafood Virus May Be Behind.
article.articleSummary: In China, researchers link Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), a virus that devastates crustaceans such as shrimp, to a newly described human eye disease: Persistent Ocular Hypertensive Viral Uveitis (POH-VAU). A March 2026 study published in Nature Microbiology found CMNV in the ocular tissues of POH-VAU patients, with several reporting recent contact with raw seafood or aquatic animals. If confirmed, CMNV would be the first known aquatic animal virus to transmit to humans and directly cause an ocular disease, potentially leading to blindness. The report highlights a potential emerging zoonosis connecting marine pathogens to human eye pathology. No nationwide case counts are provided; further laboratory confirmation and epidemiological data are needed to establish causality and transmission routes.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の海産ウイルスが背景にある可能性
triage.triage_reason: 未確認の人獣共通感染症（新規エビ類ウイルスの人への伝播）として異常・予想外であり、失明のリスクがある潜在的重症疾患に関連しているが、現在のところ国民症例数が報告されず、因果関係と伝播経路の確立にはさらなる検査と疫学的データが必要である。
triage.notes: 記事は新規のエビ類ウイルス（CMNV）と眼疾患（POH-VAU）の関連を報告しているが、2026年3月の Nature Microbiology 論文に基づくもので、症例数、死亡率、伝播経路が明確でない。海産動物ウイルスの人への初の伝播例とされており、異常性と潜在的重症度は評価できるが、現在の情報レベルでは流行可能性や管理可能性の判定が困難。続報と検査確認を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 天气转暖蚊虫蜱虫活跃 专家提醒户外活动需做好防范
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the weather warms, mosquitoes and ticks become active; experts remind that precautions should be taken for outdoor activities.
article.articleSummary: In Guangxi’s Nanning, warmer spring accelerates mosquito activity; the main dengue and chikungunya vector is Aedes albopictus (white-striped/flower-spotted mosquito, commonly called the Asian tiger mosquito). It is most active 7:00–9:00 and 17:00–19:00 when temperatures are above 15°C. No confirmed surge in overall mosquito numbers; the public should maintain routine protection and avoid lingering in dense insect areas. Seek care at a regular hospital if fever, rash, or joint pain develop. Ticks are also active outdoors; after outdoor activities, inspect for ticks, especially on the scalp, neck, and body. Ticks can be as small as sesame seeds before feeding and swell to about soybean size after feeding; remove gently and vertically to avoid rupture, as tick saliva can numb the bite. Ticks can carry multiple viruses; use DEET-based repellents before outdoor activity. If fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, or vomiting occur after exposure, seek prompt medical care and tell clinicians about exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 天気が暖かくなり蚊とダニが活発化、専門家が戸外活動での予防対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とチクングニアの主要媒介蚊（ヒトスジシマカ）が広西チワン族自治区で活動開始との報告。現在のところ患者発生の報告がなく、流行期事前の予防啓発段階であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は患者発生ではなく、季節的な蚊媒介病（デング熱・チクングニア）の流行期に向けた予防啓発。ヒトスジシマカの活動時期について医学的に信頼性のある情報提供。患者数、死亡例、異常な発生パターンの報告がないため IHR 基準には該当しない。WPRO基準の「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」が該当。情報が不足していることはないため DISMISS ではなく WATCH とした。今後の患者報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: One dies of diarrhoea, 10 affected in Odisha's Jajpur village
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of suspected water-borne diarrhoea in Baunsadola village, Anjira panchayat, Dharmasala block, Jajpur district, Odisha. One death: 36-year-old Badal Mohanty; 10 people affected. Badal was admitted to Dharmasala CHC on Wednesday night; he died Thursday night. The next day eight more villagers were hospitalised; four (including three women) have been discharged; the remaining patients are under treatment and recovering. Public health officials suspect contaminated drinking water as the transmission source. A medical team collected water and stool samples for laboratory testing. In response, ASHA and Anganwadi workers are distributing halogen tablets and medicines, and authorities are disinfecting water bodies. CDMO Dr Bijay Kumar Mishra emphasized containment and urged residents not to panic. Results will determine the exact cause.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州ジャジュプル村で下痢により1人死亡、10人が感染
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの水系感染性疾患疑い例であり、死亡者1名と複数患者が確認されているため重症度基準を満たすが、現段階では病原体が特定されておらず国際的拡大リスクの評価が困難なため、続報による病原体確定と流行動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではUnknown Illnessとして報告されており、水系感染が疑われている。病原体が確定されるまではシグナル重要度を上げられない。ただしWPRO基準で異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行性の4項目に該当し、地方当局が対応を取っているため、続報で病原体確定時はPICKUPへの昇格を推奨。Odishaはインド領内のため、verified_locationsはIndia(1269750)のみに統一。

article.articleHeadline: Nursing Technician Hospitalized with Suspected Mpox in Santa Catarina - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) remains circulating in Santa Catarina, Brazil, where a nursing technician was hospitalized with suspected mpox in April 2026. From 2022–2024, Santa Catarina recorded 2,922 mpox notifications and 508 laboratory-confirmed cases, with Florianópolis reporting 189 cases (37.2%). The outbreak predominantly affected young men; 20–29-year-olds comprised about 29.85% of cases. Race distribution showed white predominance in 2022 (66.03%), with more heterogeneous patterns in subsequent years. Mpox spreads mainly by direct contact with infected lesions, including sexual contact, but also via respiratory droplets, aerosols, and contact with contaminated objects or animals. Nosocomial transmission is a recognized occupational hazard, prompting strict infection prevention and control (IPC) measures. CDC guidelines updated Feb 9, 2026 recommend Standard Precautions, patient placement, waste and environmental cleaning with 1,000 ppm hypochlorite. Despite hospital exposure concerns, healthcare settings report rare transmission with proper PPE.

triage.headline_ja: 看護技師がサンタカタリーナ州で疑い例として入院 - 2026年4月のブラジルでのMpox
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのMpox継続流行は既知の状況であり、単一の疑い例報告では新たなシグナルとしての強度が不足。ただし医療従事者の感染リスクと院内感染の可能性について継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのサンタカタリーナ州でMpoxの継続流行が記載されており、2022-2024年に2,922件の通知、508件の確定例がある既知の流行地域。本記事は単一の疑い例入院を報告しているもので、IHR基準に該当しないがWPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、経過観察レベルの判定。医療従事者の感染リスク管理は重要だが、ブラジルの医療システムで既に対応されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri :60 % des ménages touchés par des maladies liées aux eaux usées de la prison centrale de Bunia(Enquête d'une ONG) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 60% of households affected by diseases related to the Bunia Central Prison's wastewater (An NGO investigation) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever cases have surged by 60% and other waterborne illnesses are rising among residents near Bunia Central Prison in Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, according to FORED NGO investigation published April 11, 2026. About 70% of households report increases: typhoid 60%, diarrhoea 55%, malaria 50%, and skin diseases 25%. Sixty-five percent link these conditions to exposure to untreated wastewater from the prison. A survey of 20 residents in Bankoko near the prison highlights a daily exposure to contaminated waters; 60% report daily discharges, 95% describe wastewater as foul-smelling, 80% as dark, 60% as fecal, and 50% of children play near the polluted waters. Pollution has persisted for over two years. FORED calls for urgent actions: a septic-tank emptying truck, modern wastewater treatment, urgent sanitary inspection, compensation for affected communities, support for waste-to-energy projects, improved liquid-waste management, and civil-society and government coordination to address this health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：ブニア中央刑務所の下水に関連する疾病が世帯の60%に影響（NGO調査）
triage.triage_reason: DRC（203312）を対象地域として確認。チフス及びマラリアを含む複数の水媒介性感染症の急激な増加（チフス60%、下痢55%、マラリア50%）が報告され、2年以上継続する環境汚染が原因。IHR基準3項目（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に合致。
triage.notes: 記事は刑務所からの未処理下水による水媒介性感染症の集団発生を報告。2年以上の継続的曝露、複数疾患の同時増加、子どもを含む高い曝露率（95%が下水に接触）、および具体的な健康被害が確認されている。DRC Ituri州北東部の社会経済的に脆弱な地域での深刻な環境衛生危機として判定。FROREDのNGO調査による信頼性の高い報告。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance of epidemiological characteristics and temporal trends in antimicrobial resistance of Haemophilus influenzae in pediatric lower respiratory tract infections (2021-2024) - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: Haemophilus influenzae caused pediatric lower respiratory tract infections in southwestern Shandong Province, China, during 2021–2024, with 1028 microbiologically confirmed cases and an overall detection rate of 13.00%. The highest burden occurred in 1–3-year-olds (27.23%), with a seasonal peak in the first quarter (17.37%, p<0.05). Single-pathogen infections accounted for 83.95%, while 16.05% were polymicrobial, mainly with Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pneumoniae. Levofloxacin showed 100% susceptibility; ciprofloxacin, imipenem, meropenem, ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefotaxime, and chloramphenicol all exceeded 93% susceptibility. Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim susceptibility was low (34.73%). Ampicillin and cefuroxime susceptibilities declined markedly (ampicillin 10.45% in 2021 to 2.13% in 2024; cefuroxime 21.82% to 7.18%). β-lactamase production occurred in 86.28% of isolates; BLNAR strains comprised 7.10%. Third-generation cephalosporins, carbapenems, and fluoroquinolones remained highly active in vitro, supporting avoiding empirical ampicillin and cefuroxime and underscoring the need for ongoing resistance surveillance and optimized pediatric antimicrobial stewardship.

triage.headline_ja: 小児下気道感染症における インフルエンザ菌の疫学的特性と抗菌薬耐性の時間的推移に関する監視（2021-2024年）- Scientific Reports
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国南西部山東省における小児下気道感染症の4年間の監視研究報告であり、既に過去のデータ分析である。新規の流行イベントや異常事象ではなく、抗菌薬耐性パターンの学術的分析にとどまり、緊急の公衆衛生対応を必要としない。
triage.notes: 疾患名フィールドに「Pneumococcus」とあるが、記事サマリー主題は「Haemophilus influenzae」である。本記事は過去4年間の監視データを後付けで分析する学術論文であり、新規のアウトブレイク警報ではない。抗菌薬耐性トレンドは注視価値があるが、緊急対応段階のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 传染性强、后遗症严重！正值流脑高发季，中疾控提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly contagious with serious sequelae! Meningococcal meningitis is in its peak season—China CDC reminds the public.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, China CDC warns that meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) is in peak season in China, with winter–spring being high risk. The disease spreads by respiratory droplets and close contact, and carriers may be asymptomatic yet infectious. Early symptoms mimic a cold—fever, headache, fatigue—but can rapidly progress to sudden high fever, severe headache, frequent vomiting, and altered consciousness, often with a non-blanching purpuric rash; urgent medical care is advised. Incubation is 1–7 days; the illness is highly contagious with potential rapid deterioration, mortality, and long-term sequelae in 10–20% (e.g., hearing loss, neurological deficits). High-risk groups include students in dormitories, adolescents, infants under 1 year, immunocompromised individuals, and travelers to high-risk regions. Prevention emphasizes vaccination: free National Immunization Program vaccines for MenA polysaccharide at 6 and 9 months, and MenA+C polysaccharide at 3 and 6 years; voluntary vaccines include MenA+C polysaccharide conjugate, ACYW135 conjugate, and ACYW135 polysaccharide. Personal protection and early treatment are essential.

triage.headline_ja: 感染力が強く、後遺症が深刻！流行性脳脊髄膜炎がピークシーズン中、中国CDC が警告→
triage.triage_reason: 中国で流行性脳脊髄膜炎がピークシーズンにあるという公衆衛生警告であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行可能性・管理可能性）で複数該当するが、実際の集団発生事例の報告ではなく、予防啓発情報のため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国CDCによる季節性流行警告・予防啓発であり、新規集団発生の報告ではない。重症度（10～20%に後遺症）、流行可能性（学生寮など高リスク集団、飛沫感染）、継続的曝露リスクが認識されているが、具体的な発症者数やアウトブレーク件数が不明。実際の症例増加の報告後の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông kiên quyết không tiêm vắc xin dù bị chó nghi bệnh dại cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man adamant about not getting vaccinated despite being bitten by a dog suspected of having rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure in Dak Lak, Vietnam: a dog suspected of rabies, about 13 kg and very aggressive, bit five people on 2 April at the Phú Thọ 3 beach area in Phú Yên ward, Hoà Hiệp, Đắk Lắk Province. Authorities traced victims and advised wound treatment, rabies immunoglobulin, and rabies vaccine per protocol. Four victims have completed vaccination; one bite victim, Mr. T.C., refuses both immunoglobulin and vaccine despite repeated outreach and taxi-assisted financial support arranged by the Phú Yên ward authorities. He has pledged to assume responsibility. Health authorities continue to educate on rabies risks and urge him to receive the immunoglobulin and vaccine. The incident highlights ongoing rabies exposure risk in the area and the need for prompt vaccination after bites.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病にかかった可能性のある犬に噛まれたにもかかわらず、予防接種を受けることを頑固に拒否する男性
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病曝露事例（5人が咬傷、うち1人がワクチン接種を拒否）で異常・予想外性がありWPRO基準2項目該当するが、限定的な地域イベントで国際的拡大リスクが低く、死亡報告もない。情報充実度は高いが、国家的リスク管理判断にはさらなる経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Dak Lak（ダクラク）省の記事であるが、サマリーではPhú Yên ward, Hoà Hiệp, Đắk Lắk Province と特定されており、ベトナムでの局所的な狂犬病曝露事例。ワクチン接種拒否という公衆衛生上の課題が見られ、地域当局は継続的な啓発活動を実施中。死亡例や重症化報告なし。単一の咬傷事件で限定的スコープのため、フルRRA必須ではないが経過観察が推奨される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Gripe Influenza e H1N1, a vacinação é o melhor remédio! - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza and H1N1: Vaccination Is the Best Remedy!
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) and H1N1 are highlighted as urgent targets for vaccination in Brazil. In 2025 Brazil recorded over 13,000 influenza-related deaths, with influenza accounting for about 75% of fatalities; Rio Grande do Sul alone saw around 600 deaths, with thousands infected and hospitalized during winter. In 2026, vaccination runs March 28 to May 30, prioritizing high-risk groups to curb illness and deaths in the upcoming season. The piece emphasizes vaccination as the most effective defense against flu and notes continued circulation of influenza strains, including H1N1, in the Brazilian population. No laboratory-confirmed outbreak details or data on imported/exported cases are provided; the text also invokes historical pandemics to justify public health vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザとH1N1：ワクチン接種が最善の治療法です！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのインフルエンザ・H1N1対策と予防接種キャンペーンに関する公衆衛生情報であり、新規アウトブレイク通知ではなく、既知の循環株に対する予防接種啓発記事です。異常性や予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクはいずれも認められません。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの季節性インフルエンザ対策および定期予防接種キャンペーンに関する公衆衛生情報です。2025年の過去の死亡統計とリオグランデド・スル州での罹患者数は参考情報ですが、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルではありません。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazil (3469034)ですが、「記事の主題となる感染症イベント」として国内で新たに発生している実質的なアウトブレイクを述べておらず、既知の循環株に対する定期予防接種キャンペーンの告知に該当するため、verified_locationsは空配列とします。

article.articleHeadline: Strengthening Afghanistan-China Health Cooperation; Focus on Capacity Building and Combating Infectious Diseases | AVA
article.articleSummary: Afghanistan and China pledged to deepen health cooperation, with a Kabul-hosted meeting between Afghanistan's Ministry of Public Health and Chinese partners focusing on capacity building and infectious disease prevention. The press release notes aims to boost health-worker capacity, strengthen natural disaster management, and expand collaboration in preventing infectious diseases. Participants stressed exchanging experiences and jointly leveraging capacities to improve health services. Afghanistan has faced pronounced health-sector challenges in recent years, particularly in managing infectious diseases and disasters, and regional cooperation—especially with China—could bolster preparedness, response, and service delivery. No specific outbreaks cited; the agreement centers on training, resource sharing, interoperability, and joint efforts to enhance surveillance, early warning, and preventive measures across the Afghanistan-Chinese health corridor.

triage.headline_ja: アフガニスタン・中国保健協力の強化; 能力構築と感染症対策に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生事例がなく、政府間の協力協定に関するニュースであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は『Unknown Illness』として分類されているが、実際には具体的な疾患発生事例を報告していない。アフガニスタンと中国間の保健協力強化に関する政策協定の発表であり、疾患サーベイランス対象外。記事サマリーに『No specific outbreaks cited』と明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: New TB vax safe but may not protect against all infections
article.articleSummary: Phase-3 PreVenTB trial in India finds two TB vaccines, VPM1002 (recombinant BCG) and Immuvac (inactivated Mycobacterium tuberculosis), are safe for adults and children but may not protect against all forms of tuberculosis. In this randomised study, 12,717 household contacts aged six and above of TB patients were enrolled across 18 sites in six states/UTs, including Delhi, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu, and allocated to VPM1002, Immuvac, or placebo (4,239 per arm). Participants were followed for 38 months (July 2019–December 2020). The trial, led by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) in collaboration with Cadila Pharmaceuticals and Serum Life Science Europe GmbH, evaluated safety and efficacy against TB incidence. BCG, given at birth to infants, remains the standard for preventing severe TB in young children but does not protect adolescents/adults. Results published in BMJ.”}

triage.headline_ja: 新しいTBワクチンは安全だが、すべての感染を防ぐことはできない可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 結核ワクチンの第3相臨床試験結果の報告であり、新規感染事象ではなく医学的研究結果のため、公衆衛生への直接的な脅威は限定的。ただしインドでの大規模臨床試験の進展は公衆衛生的に注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドにおけるTBワクチン開発の臨床試験結果であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。デリー、マハラシュトラ、タミルナドゥ州での試験が実施されたが、これは公開臨床試験であり新規感染事象ではない。医学進展として重要だが、シグナルトリアージの対象としては優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Woman Dies By Suicide Weeks After Fiance Injects HIV-Positive Blood
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India: A 22-year-old woman died by suicide weeks after an alleged assault by her former fiancé, Manohar, who is HIV-positive and related to her in Rajiv Gruha Kalpa Colony, Annojiguda. The engagement had been arranged and the marriage cancelled after her family learned both Manohar and his parents were HIV-positive; laboratory tests in September reportedly confirmed his condition. Investigators say the attack occurred on March 11, after cancellation, when Manohar forcibly injected his own HIV-positive blood into the woman’s forearm with a syringe at her home. She developed pain, fever and signs of infection, was admitted to a hospital in Uppal, and disclosed the assault to doctors, prompting police inquiry. Manohar was arrested March 15 by Pocharam IT Corridor Police and remains in custody. Weeks later the woman was found hanging at home and died on arrival at a government hospital. The case underscores HIV stigma and psychological distress.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード女性、HIV陽性の元婚約者からの注射の数週間後に自殺で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個別の刑事事件（意図的な暴力行為）が主題であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生またはアウトブレイクではない。HIV感染個別事例としては重症度と社会的関心は存在するが、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」には該当しない可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは公衆衛生アウトブレイクではなく、個別の刑事事件（意図的HIV暴露）である。IHR基準では2つ該当するが、WPRO基準で「長期曝露」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」に該当せず、疾病制御の公共健康上脅威ではない。ただしHIV感染個別事例としての医療対応と社会的関心があるため、WATCH段階で動向注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Học sinh Trường Bình Quới Tây nghi ngộ độc thực phẩm: Salmonella là gì, ủ bệnh bao lâu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Students at Bình Quới Tây School suspected of food poisoning: What is Salmonella, and how long is its incubation period?
article.articleSummary: 153 students at Bình Quới Tây Primary School in Ho Chi Minh City are suspected of food poisoning, with initial lab results showing 7 of 10 student stool samples positive for Salmonella. Salmonella is a common cause of gastroenteritis; incubation for gastroenteritis is typically 6–48 hours. Clinical presentation includes diarrhea (watery or mucus/bloody), mild–moderate fever, abdominal cramps, nausea, and vomiting. Salmonella Typhi and Paratyphi can cause typhoid-like illness with gradual fever, headache, malaise, and potential complications such as hepatosplenomegaly, rose spots, gastrointestinal bleeding, perforation, or bacteremia. Authorities continue to monitor remaining cases and investigate the food source to prevent future incidents. Public health guidance emphasizes seeking medical care early, avoiding self-medication, and hydration; antibiotics are used only with indication. The school’s catering program (37,000 VND per student per day) is under review, with enhanced food-safety measures and kitchen oversight planned.

triage.headline_ja: ビンクォイ・タイ小学校の生徒が食中毒の疑い：サルモネラとは何か、潜伏期間はどのくらいか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの学校集団食中毒イベント（153名の生徒が疑い、7/10でサルモネラ陽性確認）。チフス菌のサルモネラ種が検出されており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、調査・対応が進行中の実型イベント。
triage.notes: ベトナムはWPRO対象国。学校という限定された場所での集団発症だが、サルモネラ（チフス菌を含む可能性）の実験室確認、複数の臨床症状報告、学校給食プログラム全体への調査・改善が進行中。今後の症例数拡大や経路不特定による社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Heavy rain triggers mosquito outbreak in Doomdooma; residents seek urgent help
article.articleSummary: Heavy rainfall over the past fortnight has triggered a severe mosquito outbreak in Doomdooma town and adjoining villages, in upper Assam's Tinsukia district. Residents report thousands affected with persistent bites, fever, body aches, and rashes; local physicians note early signs of malaria. Aedes and Anopheles mosquitoes breed in stagnant water in roadside ditches, abandoned plots, and paddy fields. Mosquito swarms emerge at dusk and enter homes, schools, and markets. The outbreak has disrupted daily life as fogging, larvicidal operations, and source-reduction measures are urged, with free nets and repellents requested for affected pockets. Officials face calls for emergency intervention as pre-monsoon rains are set to continue, risking escalation within weeks if swift action is not taken. No laboratory-confirmed case counts are disclosed; residents seek urgent government support to prevent further spread and protect public health infrastructure in flood-prone upper Assam.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州：ドゥムドゥマの豪雨による蚊の大発生、住民が緊急支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: マラリア関連の蚊媒介感染症の潜在的リスクが示唆されているが、laboratory-confirmed casesが報告されておらず、具体的な患者数や死亡者が不明。気候要因（豪雨・前モンスーン）による今後の拡大リスクは懸念されるが、現段階では情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・アッサム州ティンスキア地区ドゥムドゥマの蚊の大発生を報告。Aedes（デング熱など）およびAnopheles（マラリア）蚊が繁殖する環境が確認されているが、laboratory-confirmed caseが記載されておらず、症例数は「thousands affected」と定性的にのみ表現されている。前モンスーン期の豪雨継続予測があり、数週以内に拡大するリスクが指摘されている。流行しやすい人口・環境要因（洪水多発地域、蚊の繁殖地）と管理上の課題（緊急対応の呼びかけ）が認められるため、スクリーニング基準複数該当。ただし確認患者数がないため確定的な「PICKUP」判定は保留し、続報による検査結果報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Campak Capai 2.188 Kasus, Pemprov Jateng Galakkan Imunisasi dan Deteksi Dini* - Suara Merdeka Solo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Measles Reaches 2,188 Cases, Central Java Provincial Government Encourages Immunization and Early Detection - Suara Merdeka Solo
article.articleSummary: Suspected measles in Central Java reached 2,188 cases as of January 1–April 7, 2026, per Jawa Tengah Health Department, with Kudus 501, Brebes 202, Cilacap 119, Pati 72, Klaten 54, and others affected. Lab-confirmed measles: 144; rubella: 18. Highest confirmed measles: Cilacap 21, Banyumas 20, Pati 20, and Klaten 6; rubella 1 in Klaten. Governor Ahmad Luthfi prioritized measles, announcing intensified immunization and early detection, integrating campaigns with district health offices. Immunization drives to be accelerated via Speling (mobile specialist doctors) and Free Health Check (CKG) programs to reach villages. Authorities urge vaccination and early symptom awareness (red rash, fever), and care-seeking at doctors or Puskesmas; masking, isolation, and healthy living are encouraged. Adults with low immunity are also at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疑い症例が2,188件に、中部ジャワ州政府が予防接種と早期検出を推進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性）、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。中部ジャワ州での麻疹/風疹の多地域同時発生は対象国の公式な懸念事項として報告されており、政府による積極的対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 疑い症例2,188件、確定患者162件（麻疹144、風疹18）という相当数の感染者が中部ジャワ州の複数地域（Kudus、Brebes、Cilacap、Pati、Klaten、Banyumas等）で報告されている。州知事が公式に免疫化キャンペーンと早期検出を優先課題として宣言しており、政府対応は既に開始されている。RRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Confirms First Human Bird Flu Case in Europe Detected in Italy - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Italy confirms the first human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) in Europe: an adult male who spent more than six months in Senegal and returned to Lombardy in mid-March 2026. He presented with fever and persistent cough at a Lombardy emergency department. March 16 bronchoalveolar lavage showed Mycobacterium tuberculosis and an un-subtypeable influenza A virus; next-generation sequencing confirmed A(H9N2). He was placed in a negative-pressure room with airborne precautions and treated with oseltamivir plus antitubercular therapy for co-infections. The Italian Health Ministry confirmed the infection on March 25, 2026; WHO reported the patient was stable and improving by April 9, 2026. The IHR notification was March 21, 2026. WHO regards overall population risk as low; no known poultry exposure and no person-to-person transmission. As of Feb 27, 2026, 195 global human A(H9N2) cases across Asia and Africa, with ten cases in Cambodia and China (China: eight).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ヨーロッパで初の鳥インフルエンザ人感染例をイタリアで確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生影響）。ヨーロッパでのH9N2初症例確認は予想外の発生で、国際的関心が高く、WHO通知済み。
triage.notes: イタリアでの初症例はヨーロッパにおける重要な新規事象だが、イタリアは対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。記事内容から、対象国のうち China（8例）と Cambodia（10例）でのH9N2症例が言及されている。患者は Senegal（対象国外）での長期滞在経歴があり、WHO はこれを low population risk と評価している点に注目。IHR通知済み（3月21日）。

article.articleHeadline: 7th suspected rabies death reported in Vietnam's Tay Ninh
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, reports its seventh suspected rabies-related death in 2026. A 66-year-old man from Loc Ninh Commune was bitten about a year earlier by his unvaccinated dog; he rinsed the wound with cold water. The same dog later bit his younger brother, who remained healthy. Six months earlier the patient had a minor scratch from another household dog; the three family dogs later died. On April 5, the patient developed fatigue, loss of appetite, headache, fever, muscle pain, anxiety, insomnia, fear of water, wind- and light-sensitivity, hypersalivation, convulsions, and agitation; admitted April 6 in critical condition with respiratory failure and died soon after. The outbreak has affected Tay Ninh communes including Luong Hoa, Hung Dien, My Hanh, Thanh Dien, Duc Lap and My An. Hot weather elevates rabies risk; vaccination coverage remains low at 14.33% of about 192,730 dogs and cats (27,615 doses). Authorities urge intensified prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのタイニン省で7番目の疑い狂犬病死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病のクラスター発生（7件の疑い死亡）であり、異常性（突発的な複数死亡）と重症度（致死性の高い疾患）の基準を満たす。ワクチン接種率の低さ（14.33%）により長期的曝露リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 7件の疑い死亡が複数の地域（Tay Ninh、Long An等）で報告されており、狂犬病のクラスターと判断される。動物（飼い犬）が感染源として確認されており、ヒト-動物感染の継続的リスクが存在。ワクチン接種率が極めて低い（14.33%）ため、管理可能性が低く地域的リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: चिकनगुनिया और डेंगू में है फर्क: जानिए लक्षण, रोकथाम और घरेलू उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Difference Between Chikungunya and Dengue: Learn the Symptoms, Prevention, and Home Remedies.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India, 11 April: Dengue and chikungunya are both mosquito-borne diseases but caused by different viruses with distinct symptom profiles. Dengue presents with sudden high fever (102–104°F), severe headache, retro-orbital eye pain, intense body aches, fatigue, possible rash, vomiting, and loss of appetite; in severe cases platelets drop, risking bleeding. Chikungunya features abrupt fever with prominent joint pain and swelling in hands, wrists, knees, and ankles; stiffness and prolonged post-fever joint pain lasting weeks to months, plus fatigue, headache, mild rash. Prevention centers on reducing mosquito breeding: eliminate standing water around home (coolers, planters, tires, buckets), sleep under nets, wear cover and use repellents. Home care emphasizes hydration (water, coconut water, ORS); dengue: papaya leaf juice and light meals; chikungunya: turmeric milk and warm compresses, plus rest. Seek medical care if fever lasts >2–3 days, severe pain, persistent vomiting, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアとデング熱の違い：症状、予防法、家庭療法について学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はチクングニアとデング熱の医学的な違いや症状、予防法を説明する教育的コンテンツであり、実際の発生状況や流行報告ではない。新規の感染症イベントを示す具体的な発症者数、確認事例、流行の拡大を報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医学情報の啓発記事であり、新規の感染症イベント報告ではない。デング熱とチクングニアについての一般向け情報提供が主目的であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。インド国内での流行状況についての具体的なデータ（症例数、入院患者数、死亡など）は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por el virus marino que viene de China y salta de los camarones a los ojos humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about the marine virus that originates in China and jumps from shrimp to human eyes.
article.articleSummary: CMNV (nodavirus, Nodaviridae) originated in China and was identified in 2009 in the shrimp Litopenaeus vannamei, causing up to 80% farm mortality. In humans, CMNV is linked to anterior uveitis with hypertensive intraocular pressure (POH-VAU) in China; a study found CMNV in 71.4% of POH-VAU patients with seafood exposure, likely via handling raw seafood and touching eyes. Symptoms: persistent blurred vision, severe photophobia, eye pain, redness; some cases require surgical management of intraocular hypertension. No confirmed human-to-human transmission; the virus can replicate in mammalian cells, warranting surveillance. Protection: cook seafood thoroughly, wash hands after handling raw seafood, avoid touching eyes; annual eye exams for seafood workers. CMNV survives in ice. Background risks include hepatitis A and norovirus from shellfish, and Vibrio vulnificus infections, with climate change expanding Vibrio ranges to the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国由来の海生ウイルスが警告対象に：エビから人間の目へ感染
triage.triage_reason: CMNV（ノダウイルス）は中国で同定され、食品接触を通じた人への感染が報告されているが、確認された人-人感染がなく、影響は眼部感染症に限定される。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国発生のCMNV（ノダウイルス）について論じており、米国（アイオワ州）やギリシャの発生地域リストはバックグラウンドリスク（Vibrio、Hepatitis A、Norovirus）の一般的な分布に言及している可能性がある。確認された発生は中国のみ。人-人感染がないこと、眼部感染症への局所的な影響、管理可能な予防策（加熱調理、手洗い、眼接触回避）が存在することが重要。

Dengue presents with abrupt high fever (102–104°F), severe headache, retro-orbital pain, intense body aches, fatigue, possible red rash, vomiting, and loss of appetite; a major concern is falling platelet counts and bleeding risk.
