triage.headline_ja: チクングニアとデング熱の違い：症状、予防、家庭療法について知る
triage.triage_reason: 記事は教育的な内容で、症状や予防方法の一般的な情報提供に止まっている。具体的な流行状況、患者数、死亡例、異常な疫学情報などの感染症危機管理上の重要な警告信号がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデリーにおけるチクングニアとデング熱の症状比較、予防方法、家庭療法に関する一般的な情報提供記事である。流行の規模、患者数、死亡者、報告機関からの公式発表など、感染症危機対応トリアージに必要な疫学情報が含まれていない。教育コンテンツとして分類され、シグナルピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 4 Daerah di Sulsel Berstatus KLB Campak, Total 169 Kasus Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four regions in South Sulawesi are in measles outbreak status, with 169 positive cases in total.
article.articleSummary: Four districts in South Sulawesi have been designated as a measles outbreak (KLB) as of April 10, 2026, after 169 confirmed cases out of 1,304 tested, spanning Makassar, Sinjai, Luwu, and Wajo. Measles immunization coverage among children is only about 69%, identified as a key factor in the surge. Authorities have activated Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) in areas suspected or linked to the events, issued circulars on outbreak awareness, and implemented digital case reporting with verification by health workers and door-to-door contact tracing. Despite the KLB designation, the outbreak is described as controllable, with no need for additional health personnel or dedicated posts at this time. Surveillance relies on a single reporting app to flag cases and guide tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシ州の4地域が麻疹アウトブレイク(KLB)指定、計169例の陽性確認
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹のアウトブレイク指定(KLB)で169確認例、IHR基準2つ該当(異常性・重症度)、WPRO基準複数該当。国内で継続的な曝露リスクあり。
triage.notes: インドネシア南スラウェシ州(Sulawesi Selatan)4地域での麻疹アウトブレイク。ワクチン接種率が69%と低く、感染拡大要因と指摘されている。アウトブレイク対応免疫化(ORI)の実施、デジタル報告システム、戸別接触追跡が展開中。地元当局は現在のところ制御可能と評価しているが、継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Menino de 8 anos morre com suspeita de meningite bacteriana após passar por três hospitais; família relata negligência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 8-year-old boy dies from suspected bacterial meningitis after visiting three hospitals; family alleges negligence.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Benjamin Leite Costa died in Recife with suspected bacterial meningitis after visiting three health facilities for days of fever, vomiting, and headache that began during a trip to Gravatá in Pernambuco’s Agreste. He was first treated at the UPA in Gravatá, then at UPA Jardim Paulista, and later admitted to Hospital Geral de Areias in Recife’s West Zone. Three blood samples were collected; one ruled out dengue, the third was inconclusive, and doctors later indicated a bacterial infection without naming the organism. He received antibiotics, developed a red rash after the injection, and was placed in an improvised ICU within the ward; an ambulance transfer to Hospital Oswaldo Cruz was arranged, but he died around 21:30 on April 7. An autopsy reportedly identified meningitis as the cause of death. The case is under investigation by the Pernambuco State Health Secretariat; the family alleges negligence, while SES has not provided a response.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブッコ州で8歳の少年が細菌性髄膜炎の疑いで死亡、3つの病院を受診後に医療過誤を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 単一の疑い事例であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡1例）のみで、流行可能性、異常性、または広がりの兆候が記事に示されていない。地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す証拠不足。
triage.notes: 記事は医療過誤の疑いを伴う単一死亡事例を報じている。細菌性髄膜炎の確定診断ではなく疑い、他の症例の報告なし。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはBrazilが含まれており、記事の主題もペルナンブッコ州（ブラジル）での事例であるため verified_locations に Brazil を記載。ただし、本件は個別の医療事案であり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança no país com 1,6 mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu spreads across the country with 1,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, Brazil faces an early influenza season with more than 1,600 deaths and about 32,000 SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) cases nationwide, driven by widespread influenza A/B circulation. From January to mid-March, influenza-associated SRAG nearly doubled versus 2025 (3,584 vs 1,838 cases), with over 800 respiratory-virus deaths in that period. Experts link atypical spread to more transmissible influenza A variants, including subclade K identified since late 2025. A São Paulo private school instructed symptomatic students to stay home to reduce transmission. The National Influenza Vaccination Campaign launched on 28 March targets 90% coverage in priority groups: elderly, children 6 months–6 years, pregnant women, health professionals, and teachers; public health uses a trivalent vaccine, while the private sector offers tetravalent. Government investments include R$41 million to InCor to expand capacity, CESIN for teaching/simulation, InCor’s Mais Médicos Especialistas mentorship, and a R$9 million health-digital agreement focusing on telessaúde and innovation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで流感が広がり1,600人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生上の影響」「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」の3基準に該当し、大規模な死亡数と異例の季節性、感染力の強い新しいインフルエンザA変異株の流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リスト外だが、記事がSão Pauloおよび全国規模のイベントをカバーしており、1,600人の死亡、32,000件のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例、新しいインフルエンザA/B亜系統（サブクレードKを含む）による異例の流行が記述されている。季節外れの大規模流行、政府による大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン（目標90%カバー率）、R$41百万の医療施設拡張投資など、公衆衛生上の重大対応が進行中。2025年比で流感関連SRAG症例がほぼ倍増（3,584対1,838件）している。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es el nodavirus? El virus del marisco que estaría causando enfermedades oculares en China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is nodavirus? The shellfish virus that could be causing ocular diseases in China.
article.articleSummary: Up to 70 patients in China with anterior viral uveitis with persistent ocular hypertension (POH-VAU) show detection of nodavirus CMNV in ocular tissues, a virus historically affecting fish and shellfish. Scientists, in a Nature publication, warn climate change and human activity may drive spillover from wildlife to humans, potentially linking CMNV to human eye disease. Clinical presentation includes red eye, severe pain, photophobia, blurred vision, and high intraocular pressure, risking blindness. Epidemiology suggests highest risk from handling fish and shellfish without protection and from consuming raw seafood; eye contact after handling or eating contaminated products could trigger infection. Some patients lacked direct seafood contact but had household exposure, implying possible indirect transmission; however, no confirmed human-to-human transmission. Correlation remains under investigation; precautionary measures during seafood handling and proper cooking are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ノダウイルスとは何か？中国で眼疾患を引き起こしているとみられるシェルフィッシュウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 新興ウイルスによる眼疾患の集団発生（患者数最大70名）が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度の高さ」に該当する。また、野生動物から人間への感染拡大メカニズムが科学的に警告されており、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事では野生動物から人間への感染拡大（zoonotic spillover）がメカニズムとして警告されており、Natureに掲載された科学的警告がある。現在のところ確認されたヒト-ヒト感染はなく、感染経路は主に水産物の取扱いや消費を通じたもの。ノダウイルスは歴史的には魚類・貝類に影響を与えるウイルスであり、人間への感染は新たな現象である。患者数（最大70名）の確度や医学的因果関係の確実性については継続調査中とされているため、フルRRAで詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: വിവാഹം വേണ്ടെന്നു വെച്ചതിന് പക; എച്ച്ഐവി രക്തം കുത്തിവെച്ച് യുവാവിന്റെ ക്രൂരത; വൈറസ് ബാധയേൽക്കുമോ എന്ന ഭീതിയും മാനസികാഘാതവും 24കാരിയെ തളർത്തി; പിന്നാലെ യുവതി ആത്മഹത്യ ചെയ്തു; നാടിനെ നടുക്കിയ പകയുടെ കഥ ഇങ്ങനെ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revenge for refusing marriage; a young man’s cruelty of injecting HIV-infected blood; the fear of contracting the virus and mental anguish overwhelmed the 24-year-old woman; later she committed suicide; the tale of vengeance that shook the nation goes like this.
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India: A 24-year-old woman in the Pocharam IT Corridor area died by suicide after a man forcibly injected HIV-infected blood into her, in retaliation for calling off their arranged marriage. The suspect, a relative named Manohar, was found HIV-positive along with the victim in September, prompting pre-marital screening by the family. The woman reportedly endured about a month of severe depression, driven by fear of infection and social ostracism. She was found hanging at home on Friday and died after being rushed to a government hospital. Police have arrested Manohar, with abetment to suicide and related charges to be considered. Authorities highlight the profound mental health impact of HIV fears; investigators are pursuing all angles, including the infection source, as the case proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: 結婚を拒否したことへの復讐；HIV感染血液を注射した若い男の残虐行為；ウイルス感染への恐怖と精神的苦痛が24歳の女性を苦しめた；その後、女性は自殺；国を揺るがした復讐の物語
triage.triage_reason: 本件は個人的な復讐事件に基づく単一のHIV暴露事件であり、公衆衛生の大規模な脅威を示さない。感染症の流行拡大や国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念がなく、刑事事件としての側面が強い。
triage.notes: 本件は医療上の感染症事例というより、刑事事件（傷害罪、自殺教唆等）として取り扱われている。単発の個人的トラブルに基づく暴力的なHIV暴露事件であり、感染症の公衆衛生上の流行リスクはない。ただし社会的関心と当局の関心は高いため、精神保健と社会的側面での追跡は必要。感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan Campak, Anak yang Demam dan Batuk Sebaiknya Tak Sekolah Dulu : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the spread of measles: A child who has a fever and cough should not go to school yet — Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a highly contagious infectious disease among Indonesian children as of April 11, 2026, with ongoing cases due to incomplete vaccination. In Jakarta, health officials warn that transmission is strongly favored in schools. Dr. Andi Saguni, Acting Director General for Disease Prevention and Control at the Ministry of Health, urged parents and teachers not to send feverish, coughing children to school and to ensure they return only after recovery. He noted that measles can spread rapidly, with one infected child capable of transmitting the virus to 12–18 others, underscoring the need for prompt isolation and vaccination to curb outbreaks. The remarks come as Indonesia accelerates immunization coverage, highlighting the risk to classmates and the broader community if vaccination gaps persist. No specific case counts are provided in the report, but vigilance in schools is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しんの感染を防ぐために：発熱と咳のある子どもはまず学校に行くべきではない — Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）における麻しんの継続的な発生を報告する記事であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ・長期曝露）が該当するが、具体的な症例数が記載されておらず、重症度や国際的拡大リスク等の重要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は予防メッセージと公衆衛生上の警告が中心であり、具体的な流行規模、死亡者数、入院患者数などの重症度指標が記載されていない。麻しんは高い感染力を有する疾患（1人が12-18人に感染可能）として記述されており、学校環境での継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行のしやすさ（epidemic_prone）が確認される。ワクチン接種カバレッジ不足への言及があり、インドネシア保健省による対策強化が進められている状況が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局发布通知推进重点虫媒传染病防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention Issues Notice to Advance Prevention and Control of Key Vector-Borne Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued on 2026-04-10 a notice to strengthen prevention and control of key vector-borne diseases, releasing the 2026 plans for dengue fever, chikungunya, and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (FTS). A ‘one health’ framework—integrating human, animal, and environment—will guide surveillance, early warning, prevention, emergency response, disease management, and enforcement. The strategy prioritizes environmental management as primary, with biological and physical controls, and uses chemical control only when necessary. In high-incidence areas, interdepartmental coordination and sanitation governance of key venues should minimize hygiene blind spots; port/public health collaboration will manage imported cases and enable point-to-point containment. The plan mandates the Four Early measures and frontline-diagnosis responsibility, plus enhanced training for primary care. From 1 April 2026, dengue, chikungunya, and FTS are classified as Category B infectious diseases with corresponding preventive measures. Suspected cases should seek care and report two-week travel history, tick exposure, outdoor activity, or animal contact.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局が重点虫媒伝染病防控の推進に関する通知を発布
triage.triage_reason: 中国がデング熱、チクングニア熱、発熱性血小板減少症候群の3つのベクター媒介感染症について公式な防控計画を発布し、4月1日からCategory B感染症に分類。予防的な政策動向としての関心は高いが、現在の発生状況・患者数・重症度の具体的情報が記事には含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は当局の防控計画発布に関する政策通知であり、具体的な患者発生やアウトブレイク情報ではない。デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS（発熱性血小板減少症候群）は既知の地域的脅威であり、既に当局がカテゴリB感染症として管理対象としている。現時点では公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す数字（患者数、死亡数、増加傾向）が記事に記載されていないため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準での該当は限定的。ただし、複数のベクター媒介感染症の「ワンヘルス」統合戦略の発表という政府関心の顕在化と、長期的な人口曝露リスク、感染しやすい地域での対策強化という点で継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 痛起来像刀割！这种病近期易发，青田医生紧急提醒！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pain that feels knife-like! This disease is prone to outbreaks in the near term, Qingtian doctors issue urgent warning!
article.articleSummary: Herpes zoster (shingles) is highlighted by doctors at Qingtian County People's Hospital as a near-term outbreak risk. About one in three people will experience shingles in life; those aged 50+, with chronic diseases, or with weakened immunity are at high risk. The disease results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus after chickenpox and can affect any body part, with the waist region most common. Typical presentation is unilateral pain, sometimes without a visible rash. Early antiviral and analgesic treatment within 72 hours reduces severity, shortens the course, and lowers complication risk. Vaccination is an effective prevention and is advised for people over 50, with chronic disease or weak immunity, and those with prior chickenpox or shingles; after an episode, vaccination is often delayed for one year. Manage sleep and stress; maintain regular exercise, sleep, a balanced diet, and control diabetes/hypertension; rest and high-protein intake are important; avoid spicy foods and alcohol.

triage.headline_ja: 痛起来像刀割！この病気は近期に易発、青田医者が緊急警告！
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹（Herpes zoster）の予防啓発記事であり、新規の感染症イベント（集団発生または異常）ではなく、既知の季節性疾患に関する医療情報提供。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは帯状疱疹（Herpes zoster）に関する医療啓発・予防ガイダンスであり、実際の集団発生の報告ではない。疾患名として「Varicella」が登録されているが、本文の主題は帯状疱疹の再活性化リスクおよび予防策についての医学的アドバイスである。発生地は中国（青田県）と確認されるが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "电饭煲'保温'不要超过4小时"上热搜，这三种常见细菌易污染米饭→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Rice cooker's 'Keep Warm' function should not exceed 4 hours" is trending on the hot search, these three common bacteria easily contaminate rice.
article.articleSummary: Beijing Chaoyang Hospital infectious-disease experts warn that keeping leftover rice in a rice cooker on 'Keep Warm' for more than four hours promotes bacterial growth and foodborne illness risk. The warmer operates around 60–70°C, but uneven heating can leave portions at or below 60°C, WHO-defined as the danger zone for bacterial proliferation (5–60°C). Bacteria highlighted include Staphylococcus aureus (heat-stable enterotoxin), Bacillus cereus (common in rice, noodles, potatoes), and Escherichia coli (contamination from dirty utensils or poor hand hygiene). To prevent illness, refrigerate leftovers within two hours; keep-warm should not exceed four hours; reheat thoroughly before eating. Regular cleaning of vent holes, the gasket, and the inner pot is essential; if the inner coating is damaged or peeling, stop using it due to aluminum leaching and potential acrylamide formation. Location: Beijing, China.

triage.headline_ja: 電子炊飯器の「保温」機能は4時間を超えないこと、これら3種類の一般的な細菌がご飯を汚染しやすい
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食品衛生上の一般的な予防啓発情報であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクやイベントの報告ではない。異常な発生パターン、集団発症、医療施設への負担増加、国際的拡大リスクなど、公衆衛生上のシグナルが存在しない。
triage.notes: 記事は北京市の感染症専門医による食品安全に関する一般的な啓発情報であり、実際の感染症イベント（集団発症、アウトブレイク）を報告していない。"trending on hot search"とあるため社会的関心は存在するが、公衆衛生上の危機管理対象となるシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bị chó nghi dại tấn công, người đàn ông ký cam kết "tự chịu trách nhiệm" thay vì tiêm phòng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attacked by a dog suspected of rabies, a man signed a commitment to take personal responsibility instead of getting vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk persists in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, after a dog suspected of rabies attacked several people on 2 April in Phu Tho 3 Hamlet, Hoa Hiep Ward. Five bite victims identified; four have completed post-exposure prophylaxis (rabies immunoglobulin where indicated and rabies vaccine), while Mr. T.C., born 1993 and resident of Phu Yen Ward, refuses vaccination and signed a personal-responsibility commitment. Despite outreach, transport assistance, and cost coverage, he remains uncooperative. The dog was killed, leaving no specimen for testing; authorities have no basis for compulsory treatment and will continue education about rabies risks. This incident underscores ongoing exposure risk and the importance of timely post-exposure prophylaxis in Dak Lak.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病が疑われる犬に襲われた男性が、予防接種の代わりに「自己責任」の誓約書に署名
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの狂犬病暴露事例であり、1名の予防接種拒否により管理可能性の懸念がある。ただし患者数が限定的（5名中4名は既に適切に対応）で、国際的拡大リスクは低いため、経過観察レベルの判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは5名の咬傷被害者が特定され、4名は既に対曝露後予防処置（PEP）を完了している。1名（T.C.氏）が予防接種を拒否しており、当局による継続的な教育が進行中。犬はすでに殺処分され、検査は不可能。狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが低く、既に一定の管理がなされているため、IHR基準での重大性は限定的。ただしWPRO基準では「継続的曝露リスク」「流行可能性」「管理上の課題」が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: 广东报告1起学校流感暴发疫情，已采取有效控制措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports a school influenza outbreak; effective control measures have been implemented.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province, China, reports a school influenza-like illness outbreak based on the 2026 Week 14 Acute Respiratory Infectious Disease Surveillance. For March 30–April 5, influenza-like illness accounted for 4.69% of emergency and outpatient visits at sentinel influenza hospitals, down from 5.17% the prior week and below the baseline of 5.89%. One outbreak occurred at a school, with effective control measures implemented. The dominant circulating influenza strain is Influenza B (Victoria lineage); rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, and parainfluenza virus are also detectable. Overall influenza activity remains below epidemic thresholds, though fluctuations occur. Surveillance continues province-wide. Recommendations call for improved indoor ventilation and cleaning in schools and childcare settings, continued morning/noon health checks and illness-related absenteeism recording, and reinforced hand hygiene and cough etiquette.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省が学校インフルエンザ暴発疫情を報告、効果的な制御措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: 学校でのインフルエンザアウトブレイク単発報告であるが、確定症例数が明記されていない。インフルエンザ活動は流行警戒値以下であり、制御措置が既に講じられている。情報不足のため引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単発の学校アウトブレイク報告。サマリーではILI割合が前週比低下・流行警戒値以下とされており、重症度は低い。制御措置が既に実装されている。インフルエンザB（Victoria系統）が優位循環株であることが特徴。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局发布通知推进重点虫媒传染病防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention Issues Notice to Advance Prevention and Control of Priority Vector-Borne Diseases.
article.articleSummary: China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention issued a notice on 10 April 2026 to advance prevention and control of priority vector-borne diseases, releasing the 2026 control plans for dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS). From 1 April 2026, chikungunya fever and SFTS will be managed as Category B infectious diseases with corresponding measures. A 'one-health' monitoring system—human–animal–environment—will guide surveillance, early warning, prevention, emergency response, case management, and enforcement. The strategy prioritizes environmental management, with biological and physical control as auxiliaries and chemical measures as needed; strengthens interdepartmental action in high-incidence areas; enhances port/public health cooperation for imported cases; enforces the four early requirements and frontline diagnosis/treatment. Suspected cases should seek care and report two-week travel, tick bites, outdoor activity, or animal contact; fever clinics will operate during transmission seasons; clustered outbreaks require testing of all fever cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局が重点虫媒伝染病の予防管理推進に向けた通知を発表
triage.triage_reason: 中国における3つの虫媒感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS）の管理体制強化を示す公式通知であり、国家レベルでの対応方針変更（チクングニア熱とSFTSがカテゴリーB感染症に格上げ）が報告されている。ただし、新規発生や異常な流行の報告ではなく、既知疾患の予防管理計画の公表であるため、現段階では継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規発生事例ではなく、既知の虫媒感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS）に対する中国当局による予防管理計画の公表。チクングニア熱とSFTSの法的分類変更（カテゴリーB感染症に格上げ）は中国での感染症管理強化の意思を示す。「One-Health」アプローチの採用、特にティック媒介疾患（SFTS）への対策強化が注目される。流行状況の詳細（患者数、死亡数、発生地域など）は記事サマリーに記載されていないため、続報の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 广东报告1起流感暴发疫情，发生在学校！官方：已采取控制措施！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports an influenza outbreak at a school; officials say control measures have been taken.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong reports 1 influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak at a school, with control measures implemented. Week 14 Acute Respiratory Disease surveillance (Mar 30–Apr 5, 2026) shows outpatient ILI sentinel share at 4.69% of ED visits (below last week’s 5.17% and baseline 5.89%). Influenza-virus positivity among tested ILI samples is 8.47% (down from 8.96% and baseline 12.44%), with B/Victoria lineage predominating (82.42%) and A(H3N2) at 15.38%. Multi-pathogen surveillance in outpatients: rhinovirus 10.00%, influenza 9.23%, RSV 6.15%. In hospitalized severe ARI cases: rhinovirus 6.15%, parainfluenza 4.62%, influenza/adenovirus/enterovirus 1.54% each. Expert notes flu activity below non-seasonal level but fluctuating; main circulating strain B/Victoria, with rhinovirus, RSV, and parainfluenza also present. Recommendations: improve school ventilation and cleaning, maintain morning/afternoon fever checks and sick-day attendance registration, and reinforce hand hygiene and cough etiquette.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省が学校でのインフルエンザ集団発生を報告；当局は管理措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: 学校でのインフルエンザ集団発生が報告されているが、既に管理措置が実施されており、全体的なインフルエンザ活動は非季節水準以下である。国際的拡大リスクは現時点で明確ではなく、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 学校環境における限定的な集団発生であり、既に管理措置が実施されている。地域的なインフルエンザ活動水準は非季節水準以下で低下傾向。複数の病原体（ライノウイルス、RSV、パラインフルエンザ）が同時に検出されており、通常の春季呼吸器疾患の状況と考えられる。引き続き監視が必要だが、現段階ではPICKUP基準を満たしていない。

article.articleHeadline: 'That's Impressive': German Tourist Shocked After Receiving Free Rabies Vaccine At Government Hospital In India- VIDEO
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination given free at a government hospital in Surat, Gujarat, India, to a German tourist after a stray-dog bite. Initial treatment and the first rabies vaccine dose were provided without charge; four additional doses were planned to complete the full vaccination schedule. The tourist praised the quick, clean, and free care at the Vesu-area facility, noting the contrast with high costs abroad. The Indo-German Vibes post sparked online debate, with supporters highlighting India’s public healthcare initiatives and others urging completion of the full vaccine course. The article notes India’s government-backed rabies prevention programs and the ongoing public health challenge of dog bites, emphasizing the availability of anti-rabies vaccines at little or no cost to ensure timely treatment. No laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「素晴らしい」ドイツ人観光客、インドの政府病院で無料の狂犬病ワクチン接種を受けて驚愕 - ビデオ
triage.triage_reason: 本件は狂犬病ワクチン接種の肯定的事例であり、新規感染症イベントまたは公衆衛生危機ではない。ドイツ人観光客が野犬に咬まれた単一の事例に対する適切な医療対応の報道であり、異常な流行、重症化傾向、国際的拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは狂犬病の流行やクラスターではなく、インドの公衆衛生制度における予防接種プログラムの好例として報道されている。単一事例の適切な医療対応に関する肯定的事例報道であり、感染症シグナルとしての指標を満たさない。Bluedot APIが検出した他の地域（イラン、ドイツ）はサマリー内容に関連しておらず、verified_locationsからは除外。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 2.102 casos confirmados de chikungunya - Agência de Noticias do Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records 2,102 confirmed Chikungunya cases - News Agency of the Government of Mato Grosso do Sul - OPINION AND NEWS
article.articleSummary: As of epidemiological week 13, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul reports 4,281 probable chikungunya cases, with 2,102 confirmed in SINAN. Ten chikungunya deaths are confirmed across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim and Fátima do Sul, five of which had comorbidities; 43 confirmed chikungunya cases are in pregnant women. Dengue shows 2,793 probable and 454 confirmed cases, with no deaths. In the last 14 days, dengue-confirmed cases remain at low incidence in many municipalities. Vaccination data indicate 223,322 dengue doses administered; total doses received from the Ministry of Health amount to 241,030. The dengue vaccination scheme comprises two doses, three months apart, recommended for children and adolescents aged 10–14 years (11 months and 29 days), the age group with the highest dengue hospitalizations (6–16 years). Health authorities urge against self-medication and advise seeking care for symptoms; consult the weekly epidemiological bulletins for chikungunya and dengue (SE 13-2026).

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ドスル州、チクングニア確認症例2,102件を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（マットグロッソ・ドスル州）でチクングニア4,281件（確認2,102件）、デング2,793件が報告されており、チクングニアで10人の死亡が確認されている。重症度が高く、妊娠中の女性43人が感染していることから公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: チクングニア10人の死亡、妊娠中女性43人の感染は公衆衛生上の重大事項。デングも同時流行中。マットグロッソ・ドスル州は複数の市町村で同時発生しており、ベクター制御対策の状況確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 自由說新聞》中國傳12省口蹄疫爆發慘況曝光！當局1舉動挨酸：果真共產國 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Freedom Talk News: China reports foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in 12 provinces; grim situation exposed! One government move draws online criticism: indeed a Communist country - International - Liberty Times Net.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks have been reported across 12 provinces in China as of April 11, 2026. The report highlights a worsening situation but provides no case or death totals, no laboratory confirmation details, or information on infection sources or vaccination status. The article emphasizes ongoing outbreaks and uses the term 'grim situation' to describe the spread. It also notes online criticism directed at a government action, framing it within a charged political context—calling China a Communist country. The piece appears to be drawn from Liberty Times Net and includes a promotional prompt and unrelated Taiwan content within the page body. No imported/exported case specifics or international transmission data are mentioned. The date in the report is 2026-04-11 17:33.

triage.headline_ja: 自由說新聞》中國傳12省口蹄疫爆發慘況曝光！當局1舉動挨酸：果真共產國
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫が中国の12省で同時多発的に報告され、複数地域での異常な拡大パターンを示している。IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「貿易制限リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」も確認される。大規模動物疾病の突然の多地域発生であり、国際的な家畜貿易・食料安全保障への影響を考慮してフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はサマリーのみで本文がないため、具体的な症例数・死亡数・ワクチン接種状況などの詳細情報は不明。ただし12省同時多発という報告パターン自体が異常性を示唆。口蹄疫は畜産業に甚大な経済的影響を及ぼし、国際家畜貿易制限に直結する可能性が高い。政治的背景を含む報道という点は信頼性評価の対象とするが、シグナルの判定には直接影響しない。フルRRAで詳細情報の入手と検証が必須。

article.articleHeadline: PT Vale Pomalaa Perkuat Akses Kesehatan Lewat Edukasi Tuberkulosis dan PHBS di Baula
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PT Vale Pomalaa Strengthens Access to Healthcare Through Tuberculosis Education and PHBS in Baula.
article.articleSummary: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, through the Indonesia Growth Project Pomalaa (IGP Pomalaa), strengthens access to health services by delivering tuberculosis (TB) education and Clean and Healthy Living (PHBS) promotion in Baula, Kolaka Regency. On Friday, April 10, 2026, at the Watalara Village Office Hall, health workers, residents, and company representatives participated. Occupational Health Doctor Dr. R. Fausan Numyani P explained the program aims to empower community self-reliance in health through PHBS in daily life. The session covered TB transmission, symptoms, and simple preventive steps, including home cleanliness, regular handwashing, and environmental sanitation. Dr. Numyani noted similar outreach has been conducted in villages within PT Vale IGP Pomalaa’s mining circle, reflecting the company’s ongoing commitment to reducing TB spread and promoting healthier living.

triage.headline_ja: PT Vale Pomalaaはバウラでの結核教育とPHBS(清潔で健康的な生活)を通じてヘルスケアアクセスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業による結核予防教育・啓発プログラムの報道であり、新たな感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規流行事例ではなく、採掘企業による社会的責任活動(CSR)としての健康教育キャンペーンを報じたもの。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng xây dựng ít nhất 29 vùng an toàn dịch bệnh dại cấp xã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang builds at least 29 rabies-safe zones at the commune level.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang City unveils a 2026–2030 plan to combat rabies, targeting 80% of dog and cat households and at least 80% vaccination coverage of the total dog/cat population in 2026–2028, rising to 90% in 2029–2030, and establishing at least 29 commune-level rabies-safe zones. For humans, the plan requires 100% of areas with animal rabies activity to have at least one human vaccination point, while other areas aim for 90%, reaching 100% by 2030. Key measures include stronger management of dogs and cats, vaccination campaigns, post-exposure prophylaxis, policy refinement, public awareness, outbreak surveillance/investigation, and development of disease-safe zones, aligned with One Health and international cooperation. As of March 10, 2026, rabies is detected in 7 households across 7 hamlets in 6 communes/wards—Tam Xuan, Dong Duong, Son Cam Ha, Thanh Binh, Tien Phuoc, and Thang An—with 7 infected dogs culled.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンが狂犬病対策として少なくとも29の地区レベルの安全ゾーンを構築
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病の既知の風土病に対する計画的な公衆衛生対応報告であり、新規の突発的事象ではない。既に検出されている感染事例（7世帯の7匹の犬）は限定的であり、IHR基準またはスクリーニング基準を満たすリスク要因が不明確である。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ダナン市による狂犬病対策計画の発表であり、既知の風土病への対応施策である。現在の動物感染事例は限定的（7世帯）で重篤な公衆衛生危機の兆候は見当たらない。計画の実行過程で新規事象が発生した場合の続報を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 广东一所学校刚刚出现流感暴发！家里有娃的最近千万别忽略这件事_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An influenza outbreak has just occurred at a school in Guangdong! If you have kids at home, please don't overlook this right now. Mobile NetEase
article.articleSummary: Guangdong Province, China, reports one influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak at a school, per Guangdong CDC’s Week 14, 2026 surveillance (as of 2026-04-11). Overall influenza activity is below seasonal epidemic levels, so this is a localized flare rather than a large winter-spring surge. Lab data from detected influenza viruses show B/Victoria lineage 82.42% and A/H3N2 15.38%. B/Victoria can present with milder fever but remains highly transmissible, potentially triggering several classmates to become ill within days. The report also notes rhinovirus positivity at 10.00% among outpatient ILI tests, higher than influenza at 9.23%, with rhinovirus and parainfluenza viruses common among hospitalized cases, suggesting possible sequential infections in children. Transmission is attributed to the crowded school setting rather than poor hygiene alone. Parental guidance focuses on ventilation, cleaning, daily morning checks, cough etiquette, and monitoring class-wide absence signals; antibiotics or antivirals are not advised, and public health guidance will evolve with surveillance data. Habits remain the best protection.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省の学校でインフルエンザの集団発生が発生！家に子どもがいる場合は、最近このことを見落とさないでください
triage.triage_reason: 学校での限定的なインフルエンザ様疾患の集団発生が報告されているが、全体的な流感活動は季節的流行レベル以下であり、国際的拡大の即座のリスクは低い。ただし、学校内での高い伝播可能性と小児への潜在的影響があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学校という限定的な場所での集団発生を報告しており、全体的な流感活動レベルは季節的流行以下とされている。B/Victoria系統（82.42%）とA/H3N2（15.38%）が検出されており、後者はスミスブタインフルエンザに関連している。小児における継次感染の可能性が示唆されている。管理可能性は良好で、外部支援の必要性は記事から示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberkulose: Neuer Impfstoff halbiert riskante Krankheitsform
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: New vaccine halves the risk of a dangerous form of the disease.
article.articleSummary: India-led Phase-III PreVenTB trial across 18 sites in six states enrolled 12,700 healthy household contacts of TB cases to test two vaccines, VPM1002 (a genetically modified BCG) and Immuvac (killed mycobacteria), against placebo. Over roughly three years, TB incidence was 1.68% with VPM1002, 2.09% with Immuvac, and 2.13% with placebo. Vaccines showed notable efficacy against extrapulmonary tuberculosis, which can affect abdomen, bones, lymph nodes, or the nervous system, and is harder to diagnose. VPM1002 reduced total TB by about 21% and extrapulmonary TB by about 50% (though statistical uncertainty remains). The findings address BCG’s limited protection in adolescents and adults, aiming to curb onward transmission and disease in high-burden settings like India. The results come as the WHO targets substantial reductions in TB infections by 2030, highlighting progress in vaccine development against this global health threat.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：新しいワクチンが危険な疾患形態のリスクを半減させる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核ワクチンの臨床試験成功を報じるもので、新規感染症アウトブレイクではなく、医学研究の進展報告である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドで実施された結核ワクチン（VPM1002）の第III相臨床試験（PreVenTB試験）の肯定的な結果に関する報道である。新規アウトブレイク、未制御の感染拡大、または緊急の公衆衛生上の脅威を報じるものではなく、医学研究の進展として扱われるべき内容である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: RS Adam Malik Imunisasi 160 Nakes, Dukung Penurunan Kasus Campak - Tribun-medan.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adam Malik Hospital Vaccinates 160 Health Workers, Supports Reduction in Measles Cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles–rubella (MR) vaccination for health workers launched at RS Adam Malik in Medan, North Sumatra, Indonesia, as part of a Ministry of Health effort to reduce measles cases. On 10 April 2026, 160 healthcare workers at RS Adam Malik received MR vaccine in the first phase; 16 vials were supplied by the Medan City Health Office, with immunization continuing in waves for all hospital staff. The program, coordinated with six hospitals nationwide, aims to shield health workers at high risk of measles exposure and expand to all Ministry of Health and district hospitals in 14 provinces with the highest measles burden. National targets include 39,212 doctors and health workers and 223,150 health workers across 14 provinces, including Aceh, North Sumatra, and Central Sulawesi; plus 28,321 general practitioners and dental interns.

triage.headline_ja: アダム・マリク病院、160人の医療従事者にMMR予防接種を実施、麻疹症例の減少を支援
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の発生が報告されており、公衆衛生対応が実施されている。しかし記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、アウトブレイクの規模・重症度・国際拡大リスクについて具体的な情報が欠落している。続報により麻疹症例数、重症度、地域的拡大の詳細が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の活動的な感染事例の存在を示唆し（14州で最も高い麻疹負担地域と記載）、政府の対応体制が整備されている。WPRO基準の異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさの3項目で該当。しかし具体的な症例数、死亡率、重症度、国際的拡大の可能性についての明示的情報がないため、WATCH判定。フルRRA前に追加情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Biological Terrorism: China engineered Covid-19 'bioweapon' to purposely infect people, reveals Wuhan researcher - www.lokmattimes.com
article.articleSummary: Beijing, June 28: A Wuhan Institute of Virology researcher claims the coronavirus (COVID-19) was engineered by China as a bioweapon and that four strains were given to colleagues to determine which could spread best across species and to humans. In an interview with Jennifer Zeng, Chao Shao describes a colleague, Shan Chao, noting a superior tasked him with testing four strains for cross-species infectivity. The whistleblower says several colleagues disappeared during the 2019 Military World Games in Wuhan, later said to have been dispatched to hotels housing international athletes to check health or hygiene conditions. He also recounts April 2020 being sent to Xinjiang to assess Uyghurs in re-education camps, implying attempts to spread or observe the virus in humans. Not lab-confirmed; the pandemic’s global death toll nears 7 million, with origin still under exploration.

triage.headline_ja: 生物テロ：中国がCOVID-19『生物兵器』を意図的に人に感染させるために開発した、武漢の研究者が明かす
triage.triage_reason: 記事は未確認の告発・陰謀論に基づいており、実験室確認なし。現在のCOVID-19パンデミックは既知の事象であり、新たな公衆衛生上の懸念シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 2026年4月配信とされているが、記事の内容はCOVID-19パンデミック初期の既知の陰謀論を参照。「not lab-confirmed」と記載されており、信頼性に問題がある。新規感染症シグナルではなく、政治的主張・陰謀論であり、EBS活動の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DBD di Buleleng Tembus 109 Kasus, Anak 4 Tahun Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever in Buleleng Reaches 109 Cases, 4-Year-Old Child Dies
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Buleleng Regency, Bali, reached 109 cases by early April 2026, including a 4-year-old girl from Banyuning, Buleleng, who died after dengue infection progressed to dengue shock syndrome (DSS). The child developed fever on April 2, sought emergency care April 3, was discharged, then deteriorated; a blood test was performed April 4, and she required ICU care with oxygen by April 6 as platelet counts fell from 60,000/µL to 30,000/µL. She died on April 7, 2026. Local health authorities will conduct an epidemiological investigation at the home to curb transmission. The health office reported 109 dengue cases in Buleleng up to early April, with adults 15–44 years constituting about 42.2% and children 5–14 years about 33%; cases also occur in toddlers. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブレレン地区のデング熱が109例に達する、4歳児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の重症化（デング出血熱）による小児死亡例を含む109例の集団発生が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」も満たし、フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: バリ州ブレレン地区でのデング熱集団発生。デング出血熱（DSS）への進行と小児死亡例が確認されており、地方保健当局が疫学調査を実施予定。年齢分布はほぼ全年代で報告されており、伝播のリスクが高い。国際拡大の詳細情報および輸入/輸出例の有無は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 中國發布通知  推動登革熱屈公病等蟲類傳染病防控 | 兩岸 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China issues notice to promote the prevention and control of dengue fever, lymphatic filariasis, and other vector-borne diseases.
article.articleSummary: China CDC issued a notice to strengthen prevention and control of vector-borne diseases, including dengue fever, Qu Gong disease, and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), together with the 2026 edition prevention and control plans. The plan promotes a One Health surveillance framework integrating human, animal, and environmental data to enable multi-disease prevention. It emphasizes surveillance, early warning, prevention, intervention, emergency response, disease management, and enforcement. The strategy centers on environmental management as the primary method, with biological and physical controls, and chemical control if needed. Areas with high transmission should boost cross-department coordination and hygienic management of key locations to close sanitation gaps. Strengthen border health cooperation for imported cases and point-to-point control. Enforce the Four Early measures (early detection, reporting, isolation, treatment) and train frontline health workers; fever clinics should operate widely. Vector control is essential for dengue and Qu Gong disease; SFTS requires tick-bite prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がデング熱、チクングニア熱などの蚊媒介感染症の防止・制御を推進する通知を発表
triage.triage_reason: 中国が複数のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱、SFTS、チクングニア熱）の予防・制御計画を発表した公式通知であり、スクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。ただし、現在の流行状況や重症度に関する具体的データが記事に記載されておらず、これは予防策の強化通知であるため情報不足が大きい。
triage.notes: この記事は現在の流行状況や患者数、死亡者数などの具体的なデータを含まない。中国CDCが複数のベクター媒介感染症の予防・制御計画を発表したことは政府レベルの関心を示唆するが、流行事象そのものではなく予防策強化通知である。スクリーニング基準は「長期曝露」（ベクター媒介疾患は継続的な曝露リスク）と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、実際の患者増加や公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す証拠がないため、続報を待つべき段階。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Aumenta em 163% casos de síndrome respiratória no HU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Respiratory syndrome cases rise by 163% at HU
article.articleSummary: In Jundiaí, Brazil, Hospital Universitário da Faculdade de Medicina de Jundiaí (HU/FMJ), a SUS reference for pediatric and adolescent care, reports a sharp rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) among youths in Q1 2026: 113 SRAG cases vs 43 in Jan–Mar 2025, a 163% increase. The municipality logged 14 influenza cases in 2026, and on April 9, 2026, recorded its first SRAG death this year, caused by influenza virus. State data through April 7 show 7,879 confirmed SRAG cases and 510 deaths across the state. Authorities urge influenza vaccination and preventive measures, including frequent hand hygiene and mask use when symptomatic. Note: influenza-like illness is not a notifiable condition unless it progresses to SRAG requiring hospitalization. The hospital emphasizes vaccination and prevention to curb ongoing SRAG activity.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジャイ：大学病院での呼吸器症候群患者数が163%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内の限定的な施設での呼吸器症候群増加報告であり、国家的または国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念を示す証拠は現時点で不足している。ただし、死亡例の発生と感染の上昇傾向は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ジュンジャイの特定病院（HU/FMJ）での呼吸器症候群増加を報告。2026年第1四半期に113例のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）が記録され、前年同期の43例から163%の増加。初めての死亡例はインフルエンザウイルスによるもの。州全体での7,879確定例と510死亡が報告されている。ただし、これは既知のインフルエンザシーズンにおける季節的変動の可能性があり、異常性の判断には追加情報が必要。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度、流行性で該当するが、現時点では単一国内の施設レベル報告であり、IHR基準は基本的に非該当。続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: 自由說新聞》中國傳12省口蹄疫爆發慘況曝光！當局1舉動挨酸：果真共產國 - 自由電子報影音頻道
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Freedom Talk News: China reports foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in 12 provinces; grim conditions exposed! One move by authorities draws criticism: "Truly a Communist country" - Liberty Electronic News Video Channel
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak reported in China across 12 provinces as of 2026-04-11, involving cloven-hoofed livestock such as pigs, cattle, and sheep. The report highlights grim conditions and an official response that has drawn sharp criticism, with observers calling the handling indicative of a Communist system. The article provides no laboratory confirmation, no specific case counts, and no stated infection source, and it does not detail import/export implications or containment outcomes. It appears to present a politically tinged view of epidemic management rather than a full epidemiological briefing. Key takeaways: disease is foot-and-mouth disease; location is China; spread across 12 provinces; major species affected include pigs, cattle, and sheep; main controversy centers on government actions during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 自由說新聞》中國傳12省口蹄疫爆發慘況曝光！當局1舉動挨酸：果真共產國
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の中国12省での多地域同時発生は異常・予想外であり、国際的な家畜貿易への波及リスク、社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは口蹄疫が中国の12省で発生と明記されており、豚・牛・羊などの偶蹄類が関与。ただし検査確認、具体的患畜数、感染源等の詳細が不明であり、政治的な批評色が濃い報道となっている。国際的な家畜疫病として中国での大規模発生は周辺国への輸入リスク、国際的な貿易制限の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: திருமணத்துக்கு மறுத்ததால் வாலிபர் விபரீத செயல்- இளம்பெண்ணுக்கு ஊசி மூலம் எச்.ஐ.வி. தொற்று ரத்தம் செலுத்தியதால் அதிர்ச்சி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rejected for marriage, a young man commits a depraved act—HIV infection via syringe to a young woman; shock after a blood transfusion.
article.articleSummary: Medchal-Malkajgiri district, Telangana: a 24-year-old woman faced an arranged marriage to Manohar, a close relative. After screening, Manohar tested HIV-positive, and HIV infection was confirmed. Consequently, the girl's family canceled the arranged marriage. Manohar allegedly pressured the woman to marry him despite the confirmed HIV status, but she refused. The report’s title describes an alleged depraved act involving HIV infection via a syringe and a subsequent shock after a blood transfusion. The article does not provide further clinical details, outcomes, or documentation of transmission events. Authorities have not disclosed any investigation status, and no confirmation of actual transmission from Manohar to the woman is provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 結婚を拒否されたため、若い男性が不品行な行為を犯す―若い女性への注射によるHIV感染；血液輸血後のショック
triage.triage_reason: 個人的な犯罪事件であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生を示す証拠がない。実際の感染伝播の確認がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本事例は、個人間の犯罪行為（意図的なHIV感染の可能性）の報道であり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の危機とは見なされない。記事サマリーでは実際の感染伝播が確認されておらず、臨床的詳細や結果も明記されていない。調査状況も開示されていない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: دراسة هندية تكشف لقاحين ضد "السل القاتل" | صحيفة الخليج
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Indian study reveals two vaccines against 'killer TB' | Al-Khaleej
article.articleSummary: Indian BMJ study tests two TB vaccines, VPM1002 and Immuvac, with mixed results in 12,000+ Indian participants over 38 months. Both vaccines were safe and immunogenic but did not provide universal protection against all TB forms. VPM1002 showed 50.4% efficacy against extrapulmonary TB, rising to 79.5% in 36–60-year-olds, and protected children aged 6–14 against all forms. Immuvac protected children only against extrapulmonary TB. The findings come amid a global TB burden, with about 10.8 million infections reported in 2023, highlighting limitations of the traditional BCG vaccine, the longstanding sole option. While the study suggests potential for replacing BCG, it emphasizes gaps in understanding how nutrition interacts with vaccine efficacy, and notes COVID-19 disruptions as a factor, indicating need for further research."

triage.headline_ja: インドの研究が『致命的な結核』に対する2つのワクチンを明かにする
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核ワクチンの臨床試験結果に関する研究報告であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではなく、公衆衛生政策の進展を報じたものである。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は臨床試験の学術的な成果報告であり、感染症危機管理の対象となるアウトブレイク、異常な発症パターン、または緊急対応が必要な状況ではない。EBS監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam's Ca Mau reports 1 death linked to suspected meningococcal infection
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam reports one death linked to suspected meningococcal infection. A Vietnamese student died; Ca Mau CDC received three suspected meningococcal cases at Ca Mau General Hospital. Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City confirmed Neisseria meningitidis in two patients; the third case tested negative, likely due to prior antibiotic treatment. A second confirmatory test is underway, with an official report pending. Authorities are monitoring close contacts and have implemented sanitation measures in affected areas. Meningococcal meningitis is transmitted via respiratory droplets and presents with severe headache, high fever, stiff neck, vomiting, drowsiness, and a necrotic rash. Vaccination is advised but not part of Vietnam’s national immunization program, requiring private vaccination. Preventive measures include good hygiene, frequent handwashing, and masks in crowded places; no large outbreak has been observed, with only a handful of cases this year in southern Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのカーマウ省が髄膜炎菌感染の疑いによる1人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎による死亡例と確定例が報告されており、異常な発生イベントであること、および国内での対応が開始されている点からシグナルとして識別される。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Neisseria meningitidis が2患者で確定。カーマウ省で死亡例を含む複数の疑い例が報告されている。ホーチミン市のパスツール研究所が確定診断を実施。当局が接触者の監視と衛生措置を実施しており、対応体制が構築されている。ベトナムでは髄膜炎菌ワクチンが国家予防接種プログラムに含まれていないため、さらなる感染拡大の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Otorita siapkan masyarakat bebaskan IKN dari malaria dan DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IKN Authority prepares the public to rid the IKN of malaria and dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Malaria and dengue fever are priorities as the IKN Authority mobilizes residents to help rid the IKN area—spanning Sepaku, Penajam Paser Utara, and part of Kutai Kartanegara in East Kalimantan—of these diseases. The authority trains community health cadres to educate residents, conduct vector control, and sustain prevention, underscoring that transmission must be tackled beyond the health sector. In the KIPP area, local malaria transmission is not reported, but dengue remains a challenge. Aiming for a 50% reduction in dengue, officials will strengthen early-warning systems and target high-risk housing and construction zones with stagnant water. Pre-cadre training has been provided to housing managers and health-and-safety teams. The Health Ministry backs Kampung Bebas Jentik to curb vectors; plans include jentik-free zones for industrial and IKN areas. Construction work sites pose risk due to standing water; health screening for new workers is practiced.

triage.headline_ja: IKN当局がマラリアとデング熱から首都移転地区を解放するための国民準備活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（東カリマンタン州）でのマラリアおよびデング熱対策に関するニュース。異常性は認められるが、制御可能な公衆衛生予防活動であり、現時点では国際的な急速拡大リスクは低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKansasとUSAが含まれているが、記事サマリーはインドネシア（東カリマンタン州）のIKN地区でのマラリアとデング熱対策に関するもの。米国での感染症イベントではないため、verified_locationsはインドネシアのみ。これは既知の地域での予防・制御活動であり、新規の急速拡大するアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Oxfam lance un projet de renforcement du système de santé dans la province de l'Équateur pour lutter contre les épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Oxfam launches a project to strengthen the health system in the Équateur Province to combat epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Oxfam and partners launched PRESYS (Projet de renforcement de la résilience du système de santé dans les zones fragiles de la RDC) to strengthen the health system in Équateur Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid persistent epidemics of Ebola, cholera and mpox and risks from displacement, climate change, food insecurity and malnutrition. The project, officially launched on 10 April 2026 in Kinshasa with support from Global Affairs Canada, targets health zones Bolomba, Iboko, Ingende and Lolanga. It plans to rehabilitate and equip 16 health facilities with water, sanitation and sustainable energy, train 324 health workers (doctors, nurses, midwives), and bolster surveillance for epidemics and malnutrition. It also aims to improve medicine supply chains, community health campaigns, and governance through health committees and civil-society spaces. Direct beneficiaries: 165,768 in DRC (mostly women and adolescents); indirect: 789,371. Consortium: Oxfam, Santé Monde, APEE, AMEF, AHD, VillageReach, in partnership with provincial authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：オックスファムが赤道州の保健システム強化プロジェクトを立ち上げ、流行病との闘いを目指す
triage.triage_reason: 記事は保健システム強化プロジェクトの立ち上げを報道しており、複数の重篤な流行病（エボラ、コレラ、mpox）が背景にある。ただし、新しい疾病発生や急速な拡大ではなく、既知の継続的な流行への対応プロジェクトの発表であるため、即座のフルRRA対象とはならないが、DRCの複合流行の状況は注視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はプロジェクト立ち上げの報道であり、新規のアウトブレイク通知ではない。背景にエボラ、コレラ、mpoxの既知の複合流行があることが明記されており、DRCが国際支援を受けている。Canadaが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではプロジェクト支援国として言及されており、疾患発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Penyakit Menular yang tak Boleh Diremehkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: a contagious disease that should not be taken lightly.
article.articleSummary: Measles (rubeola) is a highly contagious respiratory infection in Indonesia caused by the measles virus and spread via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking. Symptoms typically appear 10–14 days after exposure and progress through prodromal flu-like illness (high fever, dry cough, runny nose, red, watery eyes), followed by Koplik spots inside the cheeks, and a red-brown rash that starts on the face and behind the ears and then spreads downward. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive—rest, hydration, fever control with paracetamol or ibuprofen (avoid aspirin in children), and isolation for at least 4 days after rash onset. Complications can include otitis media, severe diarrhea, pneumonia, and encephalitis. Prevention is via vaccination with MR (Measles-Rubella) or MMR; in Indonesia, basic immunization starts at 9 months, with boosters at 18 months and at school entry. The article emphasizes vaccination as the most effective preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：軽視してはならない感染症
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹についての一般的な医学情報・啓発記事であり、特定の患者発生数、流行規模、または急速な拡大を示す証拠がない。ルーチン的な疾患教育コンテンツと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアにおける麻疹についての疾患概説・予防啓発であり、具体的な患者数、死亡、またはアウトブレイク報告を含まない。複数の疾患ID（麻疹、風疹、不明な脳炎、インフルエンザ）が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題は麻疹の一般医学情報である。シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 广东报告1起学校流感暴发疫情，已采取有效控制措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports an influenza outbreak in a school; effective control measures have been implemented.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong, China, reports influenza activity at non-epidemic season levels for Mar 30–Apr 5, 2026, with one influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak in a school and effective control measures in place. ILI accounted for 4.69% of outpatient visits, below last week's 5.17% and the baseline 5.89%. Lab surveillance found influenza positivity at 8.47%, down from 8.96% and 12.44% baseline; among positives, influenza B (Victoria lineage) dominated at 82.42%, with A(H3N2) at 15.38%. Multi-pathogen testing in outpatient ILI samples showed rhinovirus 10.00%, influenza 9.23%, RSV 6.15%; in hospitalized SARI samples, rhinovirus 6.15%, parainfluenza 4.62%, and influenza/adenovirus/enterovirus 1.54% each. Experts emphasize ongoing fluctuations with B Victoria as the main strain; continued surveillance and school-based measures—ventilation, disinfection, morning/afternoon checks, sick leave logs, hand hygiene, and cough etiquette—are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省が学校でのインフルエンザ集団発生を報告、効果的な制御措置が実施されている
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザなど複数の呼吸器感染症の活動が報告されているが、サマリーでは非流行期レベルとの記載があり、深刻な大規模流行の兆候に乏しい。学校での集団発生は認識されているが、情報が部分的で全体的なリスク評価には更なる情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は広東省の単一学校での集団発生を報告しており、全体的な活動レベルは非流行期とされている。複数の呼吸器病原体が同時流行しており、長期的な曝露リスクと流行のしやすさが認識される。ただし、深刻度や国際的拡大の明確な兆候は現在のところ観察されない。今後の発生動向の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: 'Um quarto dos doentes sofre complicações que exigem internação', alerta pediatra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: "A quarter of patients suffer complications that require hospitalization," warns pediatrician.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, a pediatrician warns that measles remains a very serious disease. About one-quarter of measles patients develop complications that require hospitalization. Even with the best available medical care, mortality is around 0.1% (1 in 1000); mortality rises substantially in settings with malnutrition and inadequate care. Many patients may suffer severe permanent sequelae. The message emphasizes vigilance and vaccination, urging parents to immunize children according to the official country vaccination schedule without delays or exclusions to prevent complications and deaths and reduce potential outbreaks. The report highlights the risk of hospitalization-related burden and the critical role of timely vaccination in outbreak prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹: 「患者の4分の1が入院が必要な合併症を患う」と小児科医が警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の合併症率（25%）と死亡率（0.1%）による深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認でき、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度（入院率の高さ）も該当。社会的関心（予防接種キャンペーンの呼びかけ）がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける麻疹の臨床的特性（合併症率25%、死亡率0.1%）と予防接種の重要性に関する小児科医からの警告。具体的な発生件数・流行状況は不明だが、重症度が高いことが強調されている。予防接種キャンペーンの呼びかけから、ブラジル政府の関心が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: বিয়ের আলাপকালে যুবকের এইচআইভি পজিটিভ, তারপর যা ঘটলো
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During marriage talks, the young man's HIV-positive, and then what happened.
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India — a traumatic case linked to marriage negotiations ends in the death of a 24-year-old woman. Monohar, a relative of the prospective bride who tested HIV-positive, forcibly injected his infected blood into her on March 11 after the engagement talks were called off in September. About a month later, she was found unconscious at home, hospitalized, and died. Police arrested Monohar soon after. Family members say the victim suffered severe psychological distress; investigators say they are examining all angles to confirm the exact cause of death. The incident highlights violence surrounding rejected marriage proposals and HIV transmission via contaminated blood. Investigations are ongoing as of 11 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 婚約話の最中に青年がHIV陽性、その後何が起きたのか
triage.triage_reason: HIVの強制的な血液注射による意図的な感染と死亡という異常かつ深刻なイベント。公衆衛生上の影響、予想外性、重症度の基準を満たし、国際的な関心も高い可能性がある。
triage.notes: 本件は通常のHIV流行ではなく、婚約破棄に関連した暴力犯罪であり、意図的なHIV感染と死亡の事例。刑事事件としても重大だが、感染症の異常な感染経路・状況として公衆衛生当局の注視対象となる可能性がある。ハイデラバード（テランガーナ州）、インドでの発生。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz: internações por gripe aumentam no Centro-Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz: influenza-related hospitalizations rise in the Central-South region.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz's Boletim InfoGripe shows mixed national trends for severe acute respiratory infections. Influenza A hospitalizations are not rising uniformly; declines are seen in many states in the North and Northeast, while rhinovirus contributes to SARI across much of the country. The analysis flags 13 states with SARI at alert levels during the week of 29 March–4 April: Acre, Pará, and Tocantins (North); Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Alagoas, Sergipe, Bahia (Northeast); Mato Grosso, Goiás (Central-West); Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo (Southeast). SARI is characterized by fever, severe cough, dyspnea, chills, and fatigue, usually caused by SARS-CoV-2, influenza, or RSV, and often requires hospitalization with potential fatal outcomes. Age-stratified data show declines in children/adolescents linked to fewer rhinovirus cases; among adults/older adults, declines reflect reduced influenza A hospitalizations, especially in the North and Northeast. Vaccination remains the primary protective measure, urged for high-risk groups and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz: インフルエンザ関連入院がセントロ・スル地域で増加
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ等の呼吸器感染症が複数州で警報レベルに達しており、重症度基準に該当する可能性があるが、国全体では混合的なトレンド（地域による低下と上昇の両存在）であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の記述がないため判定は抑制的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の複数州（13州）でSARI警報レベルに達しているが、全体的には地域別に異なるトレンド（北部・北東部での低下、中央部での上昇）を示している。Fiocruz公式データに基づく信頼性の高い情報源。ワクチン接種が主要対策として強調されている。国際的拡大やWHO通知レベルのリスク表現は見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline: سمندری غذائوں میں موجود وائرس کس بیماری کا سبب بن سکتا ہے؟نئی تحقیق میں چونکا دینے والا انکشاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What disease can the viruses present in seafood cause? A startling revelation in a new study.
article.articleSummary: Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), a virus affecting shrimp and other seafood, may cause a newly identified human eye disease: Persistent Ocular Hypertension Viral Anterior Uveitis (POH-VAU). Chinese scientists linked CMNV to POH-VAU, reporting CMNV evidence in ocular tissues of affected patients, with several individuals reporting recent contact with raw seafood or aquatic animals. If confirmed, CMNV would be the first aquatic-origin virus to transmit to humans and provoke an eye disease, posing a potential future health risk. The study was published in Nature Microbiology in March 2026. The findings highlight a possible zoonotic connection between seafood-associated viruses and emergent ocular disease, underscoring the need for further laboratory confirmation and surveillance for seafood-to-human viral transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 海産物に含まれるウイルスがどのような病気を引き起こす可能性があるか？新しい研究で驚くべき発見
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の新興人獣共通感染症（CMNV→POH-VAU）の可能性を報告する研究発表であるが、症例数が不明で、実際の流行状況が不明確。確認が必要な段階。
triage.notes: Covert Mortality Nodovirus (CMNV)という水生生物由来ウイルスが初めてヒトの眼病(POH-VAU)を引き起こす可能性が報告されている。Nature Microbiologyに2026年3月掲載の研究だが、症例数、重症度、感染者数、地域的な広がりなど重要な詳細情報が不足している。海産物消費のリスク評価と追跡調査が必要。確認待ちのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es el nodavirus? El virus acuático que puede dejarte ciego | El Norte de Castilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is nodavirus? The aquatic virus that can leave you blind | El Norte de Castilla
article.articleSummary: First documented human transmission of an aquatic nodavirus, CMNV (Concealed-Mode Nodavirus), linked to anterior uveitis with persistent ocular hypertension and risk of blindness if untreated. In China, about 70 people have developed CMNV; most exposures involved direct contact with seafood or consumption of raw or undercooked fish or shellfish. Reported in Nature, the finding aligns with climate change and growing aquaculture-driven human–seafood contact. Symptoms include red eye, intense eye pain, blurred vision, and photophobia; severe cases can damage the optic nerve and cause blindness. Infections largely arise in regions with intensive aquaculture. Treatments span anti-inflammatories, antivirals, and intraocular pressure-lowering drugs. Authorities urge enhanced surveillance at human–aquatic-animal interfaces; CMNV has also been detected in aquatic species on other continents, suggesting broader monitoring is needed.

triage.headline_ja: ノダウイルスとは何か？あなたを盲目にしてしまう可能性のある水生ウイルス｜エル・ノルテ・デ・カスティーリャ
triage.triage_reason: 新規病原体（CMNV）の初の人間感染事例で、失明リスクを伴う重症化例あり。中国で約70人の患者発生が報告されており、国際的な監視強化が求められている新興感染症。
triage.notes: 新規水生ノダウイルス（CMNV）の初の人間感染事例。失明リスク、養殖との関連、複数大陸での検出報告など、複数のWPRO基準に該当。IHR基準も3つ該当しシグナルレベルに達している。早期のフルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: um quarto dos pacientes pode precisar de internação, alerta pediatra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: A quarter of patients may require hospitalization, warns pediatrician.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains highly contagious with potential severe complications; about a quarter of patients may require hospitalization, and there are deaths even with care, says pediatrician Carlos González. Vaccination per the official calendar is the main control tool. In the United States, 285 cases were reported in 2024; 2,281 in 2025 with 3 deaths; by 20 February 2026 there were 982 confirmed cases. Europe recorded 5,762 cases in the previous year, with Romania, France, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain; Spain lost its measles-free status after internal transmission. In Brazil, a major outbreak occurred 2018–2022, with over 20,000 cases in 2019; since 2024 Brazil regained measles-free status but remains vulnerable to importations from abroad. Public messaging stresses high vaccination coverage to reduce hospitalizations and sequelae, alongside vigilant surveillance based on official health data.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：患者の4分の1が入院の必要がある可能性、小児科医が警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は高い伝染性を持ち、複数国での多数の症例報告、死亡事例、入院率の高さが報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上および複数のWPRO基準に該当。国際的な広がりとワクチン接種率低下による管理上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国、欧州複数国での麻疹流行を報告しているが、対象国リスト内ではBrazilのみが該当。Brazilは2024年にはしか根絶ステータスを回復したが、海外からの輸入による脆弱性がある。米国および欧州の事例は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: German tourist hails Gujarat government hospital after free, swift rabies care goes viral
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk highlighted in Gujarat as a German tourist bitten by a stray dog in Surat’s Vesu area received completely free, swift anti-rabies care at a government hospital. The treatment—from first aid to anti-rabies vaccination—was provided at no cost and with rapid efficiency, prompting a viral video in which David Nebel praises India's public healthcare as clean, organized, and surprisingly inexpensive for foreigners. He contrasted this with his experience in Germany, saying free treatment for such injuries is unlikely there. The incident follows a Supreme Court order emphasising compulsory availability of anti-rabies treatment across all health facilities. The viral post underscores public confidence in Indian public healthcare and the practicality of government-run facilities in handling rabies-related injuries, reported on 2026-04-11.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ人観光客がグジャラート州の政府病院を賞賛 無料で迅速な狂犬病治療が話題に
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の発生事例（咬傷事案）は報告されているが、現時点では個別症例の治療成功事例が主題であり、集団発生や異常な疫学パターンの証拠が不明。狂犬病自体は既知の脅威であり「異常」とは言えない。ただしインドの公衆衛生対応能力と狂犬病管理に関する国際的関心がある可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから返された発生地域にはイラン（Ostān-e Māzandarān, Vesū）とドイツ（Federal Republic of Germany）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは明確にインド（グジャラート州スーラト）での単一咬傷事案を扱っており、イランやドイツでの狂犬病発生は述べられていない。したがって verified_locations はインドのみ。個別の治療成功事例は公衆衛生上の「シグナル」の定義（異常な疫学パターン、集団発生の兆候など）には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz: internações por gripe aumentam no Centro-Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz: influenza-related hospitalizations rise in the Central-South.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz Infogripe’s bulletin (29 Mar–4 Apr 2026) shows SRAG remains at alert levels in 13 states: Acre, Pará, Tocantins; Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Alagoas, Sergipe, Bahia; Mato Grosso, Goiás; Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo. Influenza A hospitalizations declined in many states of the North and Northeast, while rhinovirus remains a major contributor nationwide (40.8%). Four-week positives: influenza A 30.7%, influenza B 2.0%, RSV 19.9%, rhinovirus 40.8%, SARS-CoV-2 6.2%; deaths among positives: influenza A 40.5%, influenza B 3.2%, RSV 5.5%, rhinovirus 27.3%, SARS-CoV-2 25.0%. Children/adolescents SRAG fell with fewer influenza A; adults/older adults benefited from fewer influenza A hospitalizations, especially in North/Northeast. Vaccination remains key: flu vaccine for high-risk groups; pregnant women from week 28 should receive RSV vaccine; symptomatic individuals should isolate and wear masks. Six states with SRAG at alert but growth interrupted; RSV rising in Northeast, Central-West, Southeast; rhinovirus rising in Pará, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Alagoas.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz：インフルエンザ関連入院が中南部で増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける複数州でのインフルエンザ関連SRAG（重症急性呼吸器疾患）がアラート水準に留まっており、複数の呼吸器病原体の流行が継続しているが、死亡率や重症度についての詳細情報が不足し、国際的拡大の具体的なリスク評価ができない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの公式サーベイランス機関（Fiocruz Infogripe）による季節的な呼吸器感染症の流行監視報告である。複数州でSRAGがアラート水準にあり、インフルエンザA、RSV、ライノウイルスなど複数の病原体が同時に流行している状況が示されている。ただし、死亡例については陽性者中の死亡率として報告されており、絶対数や公衆衛生への深刻な影響の程度が不明確である。国際的な拡大の具体的なリスクについての記載はない。ワクチン接種推奨と感染対策の強化が施策として提示されており、保健当局によって管理されている状況が伺える。

article.articleHeadline: MP News: दमोह में हैजा के चपेट में पूरा गांव, इधर  मंडला में चूहा मार दवाई खाने से बच्चों की बिगड़ी तबीयत - Lalluram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MP News: In Damoh, the entire village is in the grip of cholera; here in Mandla, children's health deteriorated after eating rat poison - Lalluram
article.articleSummary: Two districts in Madhya Pradesh report infectious disease events. In Damoh, a cholera outbreak affects about 30–40 people in Mohara village, Tejgarh area, with two days of vomiting and diarrhea; around 20 patients were admitted to Damoh District Hospital and others referred to Jabalpur. Officials say the cluster may be linked to meals at a Bhandara and to handpump water; investigations are underway. In Mandla, five children in Chapra Tola, Mohgaon Block, consumed rodenticide (rat poison) at an Anganwadi center during play; all were admitted to Mohgaon Community Health Center, treated, and discharged, with stable conditions. No laboratory confirmation details are provided. Authorities continue outbreak investigations and control measures, including monitoring exposures and affected households.

triage.headline_ja: MP News: ダモーでコレラが村全体に蔓延、マンドラでは齧歯動物駆除薬を食べた子どもたちの健康悪化 - Lalluram
triage.triage_reason: インドのマディヤプラデーシュ州で30～40人がコレラに感染した確認済みアウトブレイクが報告されている。IHR基準（異常性、深刻な公衆衛生影響）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行性）も該当する。
triage.notes: マディヤプラデーシュ州ダモー地区モハラ村でのコレラアウトブレイクは確定的。30～40人の感染者、20人が入院（ダモー地区病院）。水源（ハンドポンプ）および共同食事が感染源の可能性。検査室確認なしとの記載だが、症状クラスターと流行病学的つながりから妥当性あり。マンドラ地区の齧歯動物駆除薬事件は別事案で、コレラではなく中毒。

article.articleHeadline: Legislator Jabar mendorong Dinkes perkuat langkah penanggulangan campak - ANTARA News Jawa Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java lawmaker urges the Health Department to strengthen measles control measures.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Garut, West Java prompts Aten Munajat, a member of the West Java Provincial Council’s Commission V, to urge the Health Departments (Dinas Kesehatan) at provincial and district levels to strengthen measles control. Emphasis on boosting case surveillance, accelerating responses to new infections, and ensuring vaccine and logistics availability across health facilities. Hospitals and community health centers should improve early detection and rapid management of patients with fever, red rash, cough, and runny nose. Health workers are advised to intensify public education on immunization and healthy living, while parents should ensure their children’s health status and complete measles vaccination to prevent outbreaks. Citizens are urged to seek care promptly if symptoms arise. The message underlines cooperation, vaccination, and vigilant surveillance to protect children and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワの議員、保健局に麻疹対策強化を促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（西ジャワ州ガルット地区）での麻疹アウトブレイクが報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行性）に複数該当する可能性があるが、患者数、重症度、死亡例などの具体的データが記事に記載されていないため、より詳細な情報を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い伝播性を持つ疾患であり、西ジャワでのアウトブレイク報告とそれに対する政府機関（保健局）および立法府の対応が確認された。ただし、患者数、死亡例、入院者数などの重症度指標が記事に記載されていないため、実際の影響規模は不明。続報での具体的な流行データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Nipah India Cómo Afecta Y Qué Vigilar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus in India: How It Affects and What to Watch For
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus in India remains a high-concern zoonotic threat due to potential rapid, severe outbreaks. Nipah India is linked to fruit bats and, in some outbreaks, animal intermediaries or close person-to-person contact. Outbreak control hinges on rapid transmission interruption: contact tracing, case isolation, exposure monitoring, and distinguishing animal spillover from human transmission to tailor strategies. Early symptoms mimic common illness but can quickly worsen; typical manifestations include fever, headache, fatigue, malaise, and sometimes vomiting, dizziness, confusion, and somnolence, with progression to encephalitis in severe cases. Alarm signs include persistent fever, severe headache, confusion, somnolence, speech or gait difficulties, and seizures; seek urgent care when exposed to affected areas. No approved antiviral exists; care is supportive, with emphasis on neurological and respiratory complication management and strict infection control. Public guidance stresses official information, hygiene, and monitoring after exposure; overall population risk remains low without exposure.

triage.headline_ja: インド出現のニパウイルス：その影響と監視すべき点
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ新興感染症であり、インドでの発生は異常・予想外である。IHR基準を複数満たし（異常性、重篤度、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い病原性（致死率40-75%）と人獣共通感染のリスク特性を持つ。記事では接触追跡、症例隔離、感染制御の重要性が強調されており、公衆衛生上の懸念が明確である。2026年4月の配信日時は将来日付だが、イベント情報として処理。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Katanga : distribution prochaine des médicaments contre les maladies tropicales négligées - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Katanga: Upcoming distribution of drugs for neglected tropical diseases - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Free distribution of drugs for neglected tropical diseases is planned in Lubumbashi, capital of Haut-Katanga province, southeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, in the coming days. The Haut-Katanga provincial Health Ministry, via the provincial health division and partners, will run a campaign providing praziquantel, ivermectin (Mectizan), and albendazole to prevent and combat schistosomiasis, lymphatic filariasis, intestinal worms, and onchocerciasis among people aged 5 years and older. The medications will be distributed at no cost across 25 health zones in Haut-Katanga, including Katuba, Lubumbashi, Kisanga, Kenya, Mumbunda, Kanpemba, Tshamilemba, Kowe, Vangu, Likasi, Kilela, Kambove, Panda, Mufunga Sampwe, Mitwaba, Rwashi, Kafubu, Kipushi, Sakania, Lukafu, Kasenga, Kilwa, Kashobwe, Mpweto, and Kamalondo. Community distributors will visit households and schools to administer the drugs, aiming to curb the severe health impact of these diseases and ensure uptake.

triage.headline_ja: 上カタンガ州：顧みられない熱帯病に対する医薬品の近日中の配布 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 顧みられない熱帯病（住血吸虫症、リンパ系フィラリア症、オンコセルカ症）の医薬品配布キャンペーンであり、これは予防・管理活動を示唆しているが、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、疾患の重症度や国際拡大リスクに関する詳細情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは医薬品配布キャンペーンの公開告示であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。上カタンガ州（ルブンバシを含む）での医薬品配布は管理活動を示唆している。ケニアはGeoNames IDで参照されているが、記事サマリーではケニアは主題ではなく、地名言及のみであるため除外。長期曝露基準は適用（これらの風土病に対する継続的な対策の必要性）。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de São Paulo ultrapassa marca de 50 mil casos de Covid-19 - 27/05/2020 - São Paulo - Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of São Paulo surpasses 50,000 COVID-19 cases - May 27, 2020 - São Paulo - Agora
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in the City of São Paulo: By May 26, 2020, the city reported 51,852 confirmed cases and 3,421 deaths; 174,422 cases and 3,717 deaths were under investigation (total 7,138). São Paulo’s cases exceed those of several South American countries (Colombia 23,003; Argentina 13,228; Bolivia 7,136; Venezuela 1,211; Paraguay 877; Uruguay 789) and are higher than the Netherlands (45,970) or Ecuador (37,355) per Johns Hopkins data. The city records 4,232.12 cases per million; Ecuador 2,133.27. Infectious-disease expert Marcelo Otsuka cites low adherence to social distancing; the minimum threshold to avoid health-system collapse is 55% (vs WHO 70%). This month, thresholds were met only on May 3 (58%) and May 24 (57%), due to holiday adjustments. Authorities announced a gradual reopening. ICU occupancy was 85% of municipal beds; 1,920 hospitalized (587 in ICU, 424 on ventilators). Growth rate fell from 17.3% (March 17) to 3.1%, with four-week mortality stabilizing. The city did not comment.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市が5万件のCOVID-19症例を突破 - 2020年5月27日 - サンパウロ - Agora
triage.triage_reason: 2020年5月の過去イベントであり、現在の進行中の感染症危機ではない。また、記事配信日時が2026-04-11となっているが、見出しと記事内容は2020年5月のものであり、時系列の矛盾がある。歴史的記録としての価値は有るが、シグナルトリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年5月のCOVID-19パンデミック初期段階の過去イベント。配信日時（2026-04-11）と記事日付（2020-05-27）に矛盾あり。Bluedot APIから抽出された複数の南米国は比較対象として言及されているが、実際の発生地はサンパウロ市（ブラジル）のみ。対象国リストではBrazilのみが該当。歴史的なパンデミック記録として興味深いが、現在のシグナルトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Diagnóstico tardio: Acre tem alto índice de sequelas graves de hanseníase | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Late diagnosis: Acre has a high rate of severe sequelae from leprosy | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) in Acre, Brazil shows a mixed picture: strong contact-tracing but late diagnoses. In 2024 Acre had the highest share of new cases detected by contact examination in Brazil at 36.6%. Yet 18.8% of patients were already diagnosed with Grade 2 physical incapacity at diagnosis (deformities, permanent damage), up from 1.6% in 2015, marking Acre as one of the worst nationwide for disability. Cure rate reached 84.7% in 2024, down from 96.9% in 2018. Contact tracing performance remains a strength: 92% of exposed individuals were examined, rated 'good' by the Ministry of Health. Detection via contact monitoring was 45.9% in 2022, still above national averages. The data imply effective surveillance but delayed diagnosis, underscoring the need to improve early detection and disability prevention in Acre. Based on the Ministry of Health epidemiological bulletin; data through 2022–2024.

triage.headline_ja: 診断の遅れ：アクレ州はハンセン病の重度の後遺症の高い割合を有する
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症であり、アクレ州での診断遅延と障害率の増加は懸念される傾向を示しているが、急性の流行や国際的拡大のリスクは明らかでない。スクリーニング基準複数該当だが社会的関心が限定的。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空とする。ハンセン病は慢性的で進行が遅い疾患であり、急性の流行性感染症ではない。アクレ州での診断遅延と障害率上昇は公衆衛生上の懸念だが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。IHR基準は2つ該当（serious_impact, unusual_unexpected）するが、対象国外のため本フレームワークではWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo-Central : 13 décès et 160 cas de choléra signalés à la prison de Mbanza-Ngungu - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo Central: 13 deaths and 160 cholera cases reported at the Mbanza-Ngungu prison - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Mbanza-Ngungu prison, Kongo-Central (DR Congo): 160 suspected cases and 13 deaths among inmates since March 23–April 8, 2026, linked to transfers from Luozi, signaling rapid spread in overcrowded prison conditions. Authorities are implementing containment and treatment measures for affected detainees. In Kinshasa city-province, 51 new suspected cases this week with no deaths (previous week: 89). Nationally, the South Province is the most affected during this period with 234 new suspected cases and 6 deaths. Weekly totals show a slight decline in suspected cases from 1,161 to 1,157 and 12 deaths overall, giving an estimated case fatality rate of ~1% (up from 0.5%). Despite the down-tick, cases remain above 1,000 per week, maintaining vigilance. Efforts continue to protect prisoners and civilians and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ中部：ムバンザ・ングング刑務所でコレラ13人死亡・160件報告 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国における大規模コレラ集団発生（週1,000件以上の患者、複数地域での拡大、死亡事例あり）で、公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。
triage.notes: 刑務所での集団感染（160例、致死率13/160=8.1%）に加え、国全体で週1,000件以上のコレラ患者が発生中。南部州が最も影響を受けており（週234新規患者、6死亡）、キンシャサなど複数地域での伝播確認。年初以来の全国的なコレラ流行の継続を示す。獄中での感染制御がミッションクリティカルで、地域社会への二次的拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria deaths in Yanomami territory fall 80% in 2025, government says
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in Yanomami territory, Roraima, Brazil, fell 80.8% from January 2023 to end-2025 after the ESPIN Public Health Emergency declaration. Active case finding increased testing by 75.9% (144,986 to 257,930 in 2025). Malnutrition deaths declined 53.2% (2023–2025); under-five adequate weight rose from 45.4% to 53.8%; regular follow-up care up from 70.1% to 85.1%; severe underweight down from 24.2% to 15.2%. Acute respiratory infections consultations grew 254% (2023–2025), with the case fatality rate down 76% and overall deaths down 16.7% since ESPIN. Immunizations rose 40% in 2025 vs 2023 (31,999 to 44,754); complete vaccination under one year up from 27% to 60.6%; under five from 47.4% to 78.3%. Health workforce expanded from 690 to >2,130; water interventions 261 and 1,400+ filters; 61 solar systems; renovation of the Indigenous Health Reference Center at Surucucu, delivering 4,374 outpatient consultations, 2,081 lab tests, and 328 ultrasounds for 48 communities.

triage.headline_ja: ヤノマミ領土におけるマラリア死亡が2025年に80%減少、政府発表
triage.triage_reason: マラリア死亡が大幅に減少し、公衆衛生対応が成功している好ましい進展を報告する記事。新たな危機や緊急事態を示すシグナルではなく、既存の公衆衛生宣言下における改善状況の報告であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのヤノマミ領土（ロライマ州）におけるマラリア対策の成功事例を報告している。2023年から2025年の期間における死亡率の大幅な改善（80.8%減）、検査体制の拡大、予防接種率の向上など、全て好ましい公衆衛生指標の改善を示している。新たな感染症の危機やアウトブレイクを示唆する内容ではなく、既存の公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（ESPIN）下における成功した介入プログラムの進捗報告である。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外として判定。

article.articleHeadline: برای اولین بار ویروس حیوانات آبزی در چین به انسان‌ها منتقل شده است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the first time, an aquatic animal virus has been transmitted to humans in China.
article.articleSummary: First-ever documented human infection with an aquatic animal nodavirus with hidden fatalities in China, linked to glaucoma-like eye disease (uveitis with persistent elevated intraocular pressure, POH-VAU) and potential irreversible vision loss. In Qingdao, a study of 70 Chinese patients (Jan 2022–Apr 2025) found all tested positive for the nodavirus with hidden fatalities. Transmission suspected from consumption of raw seafood and contact with aquatic animals; over half were aquaculture farmers or workers; about 16% consumed raw seafood or had high-risk contacts. No definitive evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission; some cluster-like cases suggest household spread via shared items and close contact. Globally, 523 aquatic animals across Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Africa revealed infection in 49 species, including shrimp, crabs, fish, sea cucumbers, and shellfish. The mechanism for eye disease remains unclear; scientists emphasize broader host range and food-chain–mediated dissemination.

triage.headline_ja: 初めて、水生動物ウイルスが中国でヒトに感染したことが確認されました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、重症度）。新興人獣共通感染症、複数国の動物での確認、ヒト感染による視力喪失の可能性があり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事では中国（青島）での人感染が主題。発生地域にはスペイン（カナリア諸島）も含まれているが、サマリーに具体的な発生記載なく、動物での感染報告にとどまるため検証対象外。水生動物ノドウイルスの初ヒト感染確認、複数国での動物感染の存在、食品媒介可能性、眼疾患と視力喪失リスクなどにより高い優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura confirma 6ª morte por chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall confirms 6th Chikungunya death in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Sixth chikungunya death confirmed in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 1,572 confirmed cases in the municipality; the victim is a 55-year-old Indigenous man who was hospitalized on April 1 and died two days later. Two additional deaths are under investigation, including a 10-year-old girl. The Jaguapiru and Bororó Indigenous reservations report about 1,200 confirmed cases by week’s end. Statewide, 4,281 probable and 2,102 confirmed chikungunya cases; 29 patients are hospitalized in Dourados. Transmission remains above surveillance targets, with a positivity rate over 70%; incidence in Mato Grosso do Sul is 144/100,000, about 13 times the national average (Goiás 95/100,000). Federal funding exceeds R$28 million to broaden specialized care in Dourados and surroundings, including an annual R$1 million for Hospital Mission Evangélica de Caiuá; 40 National Health Force personnel deployed since March 17. Ten chikungunya deaths have been confirmed across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, and Fátima do Sul, with 43 pregnancy-related cases.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラドスでチクングニア熱による6番目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響（死亡例、高い発症率、地域の保健システム逼迫）と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例、入院患者多数）と管理可能性（連邦資金投入、追加人員配置が必要）が該当。社会的関心も高い。フルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、イベントはブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥアラドスで発生。Goiásは比較データとしてのみ言及されており、主要な発生地ではないため除外。死亡者数増加（6例確認、2例調査中）、先住民コミュニティでの高い発症率（1,200例/2つの保留地）、全州での発症率が国家平均の13倍（144/100,000）、医療システムへの大規模連邦支援投入など、深刻な地域的流行を示す。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Cà Mau khuyến cáo về viêm não mô cầu sau 3 ca nghi mắc bệnh
