article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau CDC issues an advisory on meningococcal meningitis after three suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau Province, Vietnam reports 3 suspected meningococcal meningitis cases, including 1 death, prompting vaccination drives as of 11 April 2026. Citizens flock to centers for meningococcal vaccines; vaccines are available and administered after procedures. CDC Director Tran Hien Khoa warns the disease is transmitted via respiratory routes and advises masking in crowded places, hand hygiene, and vaccination where possible; residents with symptoms should seek timely medical care. Local authorities have conducted outbreak suppression efforts, including spraying and public education; no new suspected cases have been recorded in the past two days. Case timelines: Case 1 admitted 7-4 with petechiae, vomiting, lethargy; blood samples sent to Pasteur Institute, Ho Chi Minh City. Case 2 admitted 8-4, rapidly deteriorated and died in the early hours of 9-4. Case 3 admitted 9-4 after prolonged fever and myalgia; CSF and blood samples collected for testing. All three had contact with a person who died in March 2026 with fever, petechiae, and hypotension.

triage.headline_ja: Ca Mau CDCが3つの疑わしい髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例後に公開勧告を発行
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確認された死亡例を含む集団発生がベトナムで報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外性）および WPRO スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）複数に該当する。当局の対応と社会的関心も確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はベトナム（Ca Mau Province）での髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の集団発生であり、死亡例1件を含む3件の疑い例が報告されている。発生地域フィールドに Ho Chi Minh City（ホーチミン市、ベトナム）と India/Tamil Nadu が含まれているが、サマリーで実際に記述されているのはベトナム（Ca Mau Province）のみであり、インドでの発生は記載されていないため verified_locations に含めない。また、Classical Swine Fever も疾患名に含まれているが、サマリーではメンタルグローバル髄膜炎が主題であり、豚熱については言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: Fátima do Sul e Jardim registram novas mortes; estado soma 10 óbitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: Fátima do Sul and Jardim report new deaths; the state has 10 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Two new chikungunya deaths were confirmed in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil: an 82-year-old man from Fátima do Sul, who died on 8 March after symptoms began 25 February; and a 94-year-old man from Jardim, who died on 4 March after symptoms starting 4 February. As of 10 April 2026, the state reports 4,281 probable and 2,102 confirmed chikungunya cases, with 10 fatalities and 4 deaths under investigation. Sixteen municipalities show high incidence, including Dourados (983 probable), Fátima do Sul (519), Corumbá (465), Jardim (321), and Amambai (244). The ten deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul include individuals aged from 3 months to 94 years, with Jardim 82-year-old (23/03) and Jardim 94-year-old (04/03) among the deceased and Fátima do Sul 82-year-old (08/04). The state received 46,000 vaccine doses, and an emergency care flow prioritizes P1.0/P1.1 cases with referrals and a 'zero vacancy' transfer policy. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱：Fátimaド南とJardimで新たな死亡報告、州は10人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州におけるチクングニア熱の急増により、4,281例の推定患者と10人の死亡が報告されており、異常性・重症度・国際関心の観点から複数のWPRO基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はマットグロッソドスル州での局地的発生だが、死亡者数（10人）、複数自治体への広がり（16市），罹患率の高さ（4,281例），高リスク群への影響（3ヶ月～94歳）など、深刻性が認識されている。ただしブラジルは対象国に含まれるため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kasaï Oriental : plus de 1.200.000 enfants de 0 à 59 mois attendus à la vaccination contre la poliomyélite - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasai-Oriental: more than 1,200,000 children aged 0 to 59 months expected to be vaccinated against polio - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign launched in Kasai-Oriental, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 1,204,267 children aged 0-59 months targeted across 19 health zones. Report from Mbuji-Mayi on April 11, 2026. The campaign runs April 16–19, 2026, using a door-to-door strategy to reach all eligible children, including those regularly vaccinated. Dr. Daniel Kazadi Tshilumbayi, Provincial Minister of Public Health, urged parents and opinion leaders, including religious leaders, to vaccinate to protect children from polio, describing it as a very serious and dangerous disease that can leave a child permanently disabled. He emphasized the vaccine is safe. This marks the province’s first polio vaccination campaign of 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ・オリエンタル州：ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンで0～59ヶ月齢の子ども120万人以上が対象 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際的に重要な感染症であり、DRCでの予防接種キャンペーン実施は異常/予想外ではないが、ワイルドポリオウイルス（WPV）確認報告が記事に明示されていないため、シグナル判定には情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、ポリオの患者発生(confirmed cases)の記述がない。ポリオは輸出可能性が高い疾患であるが、本記事では具体的な症例確認、流行状況、国際拡大リスクが明記されていない。DRCのポリオ流行・患者確認の背景情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SFA lifts ban on import of pork products from Taiwan after African swine fever outbreak is contained
article.articleSummary: Singapore's SFA lifted its temporary ban on importing pork and pork products from Taiwan on April 9, 2026, after an African swine fever (ASF) outbreak there was contained. ASF is a highly contagious, fatal disease of pigs and does not affect humans. The restrictions had been in place since Oct 25, 2025. Taiwan reported ASF in Taichung in October 2025, with positive tests from dead pigs in Wuqi district and at least 195 pigs culled. Taiwan houses about five million pigs, with a pork industry valued at roughly NT$70 billion (S$2.9 billion) annually. The ban targeted pork and pork products not processed to inactivate the virus, and its removal indicates containment and ongoing measures to prevent import-linked spread.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール食糧庁がアフリカ豚コレラの流行抑制後、台湾からの豚肉製品の輸入禁止を解除
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは動物疾患であり、人間への感染リスクはない。輸入禁止の解除という対象国の疫病制御成功事例であり、パンデミック対応や公衆衛生上の深刻なリスク要因を示していない。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラは人間への感染例なし。記事は台湾での流行が既に抑制されたことを述べており、シンガポール食糧庁による輸入禁止解除は疫病制御成功の指標。対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため、発生地の中国本土（黒竜江省）のみ verified_locations に含める。ただし人獣共通感染症の規制対象外であることから、IHR通知基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог уточнил, где в России обитают опасные комары
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virologist clarified where dangerous mosquitoes live in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-11, Aedes mosquitoes carrying tropical fever agents are found in Russia's Krasnodar Krai, according to Alexander Lukashev of Sechenov University. No outbreaks have occurred in Russia, and the risk of disease from these vectors remains minimal. Aedes were introduced to Russia in 2008 and are now present across a larger area of Krasnodar Krai. Transmission of tropical viral fevers requires sustained temperatures around 30–32°C, which are not common in Russia, reducing ongoing risk. In contrast, Indonesian epidemiologist Gari Budiman notes Bali's vectors are increasingly active during the day, raising tourist exposure. For travelers, preventive measures include repellents and wearing long sleeves and pants. The article emphasizes that while risks exist in hot climates and endemic regions, Russia currently does not face imminent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者がロシアに生息する危険な蚊がどこにいるかを明確にした
triage.triage_reason: 記事は蚊の分布に関する情報提供であり、ロシアでは実際の感染症アウトブレイクが発生していない。病原体の実際の循環や患者発生がなく、リスク低減の見通しが述べられている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはロシア連邦が含まれているが、記事サマリーはロシアでの実際のアウトブレイク発生がないことを明確に述べている。インドネシア・バリ州については言及があるが、アウトブレイク情報ではなく蚊の昼間活動の増加に関する注釈である。本記事は感染症イベント報告ではなく、ベクター分布に関する情報提供であり、シグナル閾値を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: بحران بهداشتی در نیجریه؛ شمار قربانیان تب لاسا به 167 نفر رسید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health crisis in Nigeria; the death toll from Lassa fever has reached 167.
article.articleSummary: Lassa fever remains a health crisis in Nigeria, according to the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC). Since January, 167 deaths from Lassa fever have been confirmed across the country, while 2025 saw 190 total deaths. New weekly confirmed cases decreased from 51 to 26, yet the mortality rate has risen. The disease was first identified in 1969 in Borno State, northeast Nigeria. Lassa virus is transmitted to humans through contact with rodent droppings and other rodent materials; human-to-human transmission is also possible. Lassa fever causes viral hemorrhagic fever and can be fatal in severe cases. Nigeria has maintained a national emergency since January 2019 due to the outbreak and urges the public to avoid contact with rodents and to follow strict hygienic practices. Outside Nigeria, Lassa fever has been reported in Mali, Togo, Ghana, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. As of 11 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアの保健危機；ラッサ熱の死亡者数が167人に達した
triage.triage_reason: ラッサ熱の大規模発生で167人の死亡が確認され、西アフリカ複数国で報告されている。高い致命率、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、国際的拡大リスク、および継続的な公開保健上の影響により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリアが主要な発生地であるが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていない（GeoNames ID: 2328926）。Mali（対象国外）、Togo（対象国外）、Ghana（対象国内）、Liberia（対象国外）、Sierra Leone（対象国外）が報告されている。確認された対象国はGhanaのみ。ただし、発生地域フィールドにはGhana (2300660) が含まれており、記事サマリーでもGhanaでの報告が明記されている。ラッサ熱はWHO重要感染症であり、西アフリカでの流行は高い国際的関心を有する。

article.articleHeadline: Reducción del 80% en muertes por malaria en territorio Yanomami
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80% reduction in malaria deaths in Yanomami territory.
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in Brazil’s Yanomami territory, Roraima, dropped by 80.8% from late 2025 to January 2023 amid a national emergency over miners. Active case finding increased, with malaria testing rising from 144,986 to 257,930 in 2025. Malnutrition deaths fell 53.2% between 2023 and 2025; under-five children with adequate weight rose from 45.4% to 53.8%, and accompanied children from 70.1% to 85.1%. Severe malnutrition decreased; very-low-weight prevalence declined from 24.2% to 15.2%. Acute respiratory infections surged 254% 2023–2025, but case fatality fell 76% and total deaths since the emergency began declined 16.7%. Vaccination doses rose 40% in 2025 vs 2023 (31,999→44,754); full schedules for children under 1 increased from 27% to 60.6%, and under 5 from 47.4% to 78.3%. Health workforce expanded from 690 to >2,130; water, filter, and solar infrastructure improved; Surucucu Indigenous Health Center refurbished to serve 48 communities with thousands of visits and tests.

triage.headline_ja: ヤノマミ領土におけるマラリア死亡者の80%削減
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は、ブラジル・ロライマ州のヤノマミ領土におけるマラリア死亡率の大幅な改善を報告しており、公衆衛生上の肯定的な進展を示している。新規の流行懸念ではなく、既知の課題への対応が改善されている状況であり、シグナル識別基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年から2026年初期のデータを報告しており、マラリア死亡者数の削減、栄養状態の改善、ワクチン接種率の向上など、保健対応の成功を示している。これは新規の感染症危機ではなく、既存の問題への介入効果の報告であり、シグナル識別の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Idul Adha, Dinas Pertanian OKU intensifkan vaksinasi PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, the OKU Regency Department of Agriculture Intensifies Foot-and-Mouth Disease Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination campaign intensifies in OKU Regency, South Sumatra, ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. OKU Agriculture Department in Baturaja, led by Joni Saihu, mobilizes 300 anti-FMD doses to be administered free of charge to four-legged livestock—even cattle, buffalo, goats, and sheep—across selected farm centers. A task force team, involving village officials, will visit farms in multiple districts to vaccinate only healthy animals aged two weeks to curb spread. The program aligns with a national government directive to shield the livestock sector and protect public health from a contagious disease. In addition to vaccination, farmers are reminded to maintain clean enclosures and surrounding areas and provide healthy feed to reduce disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: イード・アル・アドハを前に、OKUリージェンシー農業局が口蹄疫ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで口蹄疫のワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、動物への影響は明確だが、人間への公衆衛生的リスク、国際的拡大の可能性、管理不可能性など、PICKUP基準となる重大な懸念指標が記事サマリーから検出されない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、アクティブな流行の報告ではない。インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれる。イード・アル・アドハ時期における家畜移動に伴う疾病拡大リスクについては記事に明記されていないため、国際的拡大リスク判定は'No'とした。今後の患者発生報告や制御失敗の情報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hanseníase: sinais iniciais, como manchas com perda de sensibilidade, transmissão e tratamento gratuito pelo SUS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hansen's disease: Early signs, such as patches with loss of sensation, transmission, and free treatment through the SUS.
article.articleSummary: Hansen’s disease (leprosy), caused by Mycobacterium leprae, remains a Brazilian public health concern with free diagnosis and treatment through the SUS. Early signs include skin patches with altered sensation to heat, pain, and touch, often with numbness, tingling, weakness in hands/feet, eyebrow hair loss, and dry skin. Transmission is via upper respiratory droplets during prolonged close contact with untreated cases; casual contact is not a transmission risk. Most people have natural immunity; risk increases with daily, long-term exposure in households or closed environments. Multidrug therapy (PQT) rapidly reduces contagiousness, and patients may stop transmitting after the first dose if correctly administered. Diagnosis is clinical (skin and peripheral nerve exams), with laboratory tests as needed. SUS emphasizes investigating suspected cases and evaluating household contacts, offering routine vaccinations, aiming to prevent disabilities and reduce stigma while allowing continued social participation.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病：初期症状、感覚喪失を伴う斑点、感染経路、およびSUSによる無料治療
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知の疾患であり、記事はブラジルにおける公衆衛生プログラム情報の説明的記事である。異常な発症パターン、急速な拡大、または緊急性を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない（1269750=India, 895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 3469034=Brazil）。本記事はハンセン病の医学情報および既存プログラムの説明であり、新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí tem 28 municípios com alto risco para dengue, alerta Sesapi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí has 28 municipalities at high risk of dengue, warns Sesapi.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-eight municipalities in Piauí, Brazil, are at high risk for dengue, according to Sesapi based on the LIRAa/LIA entomological survey measuring dengue vector infestation. In these areas the infestation index is 4% or higher. A further 85 municipalities are in alert with 1–3.9% infestation, while 111 municipalities are satisfactory with infestation below 1%. An emergency meeting of the state Emergency Operations Center (COE) was held on Friday, 10 April 2026, to address the situation. Since the start of 2026, Piauí has recorded 4,202 probable dengue cases and one death confirmed. The report highlights persistent transmission risk tied to vector presence and underscores the need for intensified surveillance and control measures across the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・ピアウイ州で28市町村がデング熱の高リスク地域と警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の地域的なデング熱流行を示すシグナルだが、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、および社会的・政治的関心の情報が不足している。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ピアウイ州内の地域的デング熱流行を報告。2026年開始時点で4,202例の推定患者と1例の死亡確認。州の緊急対応センター(COE)による対応会議が実施されており、政府関心は高い。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクについての記載なし。WPROスクリーニング基準は3項目該当だがIHR基準は1項目のみであり、情報不足のため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí tem 28 municípios com alto risco para dengue, alerta Secretaria de Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí has 28 municipalities at high risk for dengue, Health Secretariat warns.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Piauí, Brazil: 28 of the state’s municipalities (12.5%) are at high risk (entomological index ≥4) per LIRAa/LIA data; 85 (37.9%) are at alert (1.0–3.9%), and 111 (49.6%) are satisfactory (<1%). Through 2026, the state records 4,202 probable dengue cases and one death. Sesapi convened a COE emergency operations meeting to strengthen surveillance and response. Simultaneous circulation of multiple dengue serotypes, including reintroduction of serotype 3, raises risk of more severe cases. Notably, 93 municipalities (41.5%) are described as “silent,” without recent case reporting, suggesting undernotification or tracking gaps. Other indicators: 60 municipalities (26.8%) low incidence; 19 (8.5%) medium; 12 (5.4%) high incidence. Public urged to eliminate mosquito breeding sites, seek health care for symptoms, and maintain hydration to reduce hospital burden. Highlights quotes from Dirceu Campêlo and Leila Santos.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州は28市でデング熱の高リスクを警告、保健局が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の多地域での同時流行、複数血清型の循環、死亡例の報告、州内28市で高リスクが確認され、州レベルの緊急対応センター開催と社会的関心がある。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルのピアウイ州で2026年を通じ4,202例のデング疑い例と1死亡例を報告。デングウイルスの複数血清型（血清型3の再導入を含む）が同時に流行しており、重症化リスク増加。93市（41.5%）が「沈黙地域」として報告されており、未報告または追跡ギャップの可能性がある。州保健局による緊急対応会議が開催されており、政府レベルでの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura confirma 6ª morte por chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall confirms 6th death from chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil: 6th death confirmed, a 55-year-old indigenous man admitted April 1 at Missão Caiuá Hospital and died April 3. The municipality has 1,572 confirmed cases and 29 patients hospitalized; two more deaths remain under investigation, including a 10-year-old girl at the Regional Hospital of Dourados. In the Jaguapiru and Bororó indigenous settlements, about 1,200 cases were confirmed by week’s end. State data show 4,281 probable and 2,102 confirmed cases statewide. Transmission remains well above targets, with a positivity rate above 70%. Mato Grosso do Sul's incidence is 144 per 100,000, about 13 times the national average; Goiás is second at 95 per 100k. The Ministry of Health allocated over R$28 million to expand specialized care in Dourados; the Caiuá Mission Hospital will receive R$1 million annually, and 40 National Health Force personnel have been deployed since March 17. Public health messaging stresses household/yard vector-control to curb Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラドスでチクングニアの6番目の死亡が確認されました
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でチクングニア熱の集団発生が確認され、死亡例（6件以上、調査中を含む）、高い感染率（70%以上の陽性率）、先住民集落での大規模感染（約1,200例）、全国平均の約13倍の罹患率が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行）およびスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行易感染性、国家的支援）に複数該当します。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていませんが、Americas regionの感染症イベントとして重要です。記事では具体的にゴイアス州（Goiás）とマットグロッソドスル州（Mato Grosso do Sul）での発生が記述されており、先住民集落における急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、保健資源の配分拡大、全国対応の実施が確認されます。陽性率70%超、全国平均の13倍という数値は、局地的な医療危機を示唆しています。

article.articleHeadline: Um mês depois de contaminada, Cláudia Raia fala que a família toda pegou Covid-19 - 19/05/2020 - Olá - Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One month after she was infected, Cláudia Raia says that the whole family caught COVID-19 - May 19, 2020 - Olá - Agora
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Cláudia Raia announced on social media that her entire family—husband Jarbas Homem de Mello and children Enzo and Sofia—contracted COVID-19 about a month after she was infected; all have since recovered. She believes the infection occurred in an elevator when collecting a delivery at the building lobby, and she noted she delayed sharing the news publicly to avoid setting a bad example for fans. The disclosure, reported May 19, 2020, also states the children visited their father, actor Edson Celulari, shortly before her symptoms began, but Celulari did not become infected. The account underscores the virus’s pervasive transmission during the early pandemic period in Brazil and the ease of spread in shared indoor spaces.

triage.headline_ja: 感染後1ヶ月後、クラウディア・ラーアが家族全員がCOVID-19に感染したと語る - 2020年5月19日
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの著名人家族の個人的な感染事例報道であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す証拠がなく、予期しない疾患発生でもない。2020年5月時点でCOVID-19はすでに世界的パンデミックであり、個別事例の報道は定型的である。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの著名人（女優クラウディア・ラーア）およびその家族の感染事例についての社会メディア報道である。パンデミック初期段階（2020年5月）における個人的な感染事例であり、新規の疫学的脅威を示すものではない。記事は個人的な経験談に基づくもので、新規クラスターや管理上の課題を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : plus de 4.600 cas de choléra dont 67 décès enregistrés en 3 mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: More than 4,600 cholera cases, including 67 deaths recorded in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, records 4,607 cases and 67 deaths in the first three months of 2026. The most affected health zones are Fizi, Ruzizi, Nundu, Uvira, and the city of Bukavu. Deaths are linked to disruptions in care inputs across some zones. The South Kivu Provincial Health Division (DPS) prioritizes medical management per the national policy and strengthened surveillance for rapid, accurate case detection. The province is also grappling with a measles outbreak. An intra-action review of cholera response on 10 April 2026 highlighted needs to restore supply chains, ensure timely patient management, and bolster surveillance to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州：3ヶ月間でコレラ患者4,600人以上、死亡者67人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当。対象国DRCにおける複合感染症（コレラ＋麻疹）の多数死亡ケースはフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC南キブ州のコレラ流行を主題としており、Burundiは地域的に隣接しているが記事本文ではコレラ患者の実発生地として言及されていないため除外。Fijiは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。複合感染症（コレラ＋麻疹）の同時流行、供給チェーン破断による死亡、3ヶ月で67人の死亡という重篤性から高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 169 Kasus Positif Ditemukan, Sulawesi Selatan Siaga KLB Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 169 Positive Cases Detected, South Sulawesi on Measles Outbreak Alert
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared in South Sulawesi, Indonesia, with four districts/cities now designated as KLB (outbreak) after 169 positive measles cases identified in recent weeks. Health authorities launched intensive contact tracing to interrupt transmission. The outbreak is linked to historically low routine immunization coverage, prompting authorities to implement Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) to boost herd immunity in affected areas. As of April 10, 2026, the specific districts under KLB status are being validated to confirm the geographic spread. Residents are urged to bring children to health facilities for measles vaccination and to maintain hygiene practices. The measures aim to accelerate immunization in the impacted locations and curb further spread while epidemiological investigations continue at provincial and district levels.

triage.headline_ja: 169人の陽性者が検出、南スラウェシが麻疹のアウトブレイク警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、流行性が確認され、ワクチン接種率低下による管理課題がある。
triage.notes: 南スラウェシで169例の麻疹確認例が報告され、4地区がKLB（アウトブレイク）として認定。予防接種率の歴史的低さが根本的な課題。アウトブレイク対応予防接種(ORI)が実施予定。アジア地域での麻疹流行拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: വൈക്കം ഉദയനാപുരത്ത് പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു: പ്രതിരോധത്തിന് നടപടി; ഒരു കിലോമീറ്റർ ചുറ്റളവിലെ കോഴികളെയും വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെയും അടിയന്തരമായി നശിപ്പിക്കാൻ നിർദ്ദേശം ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Vaikom Udayanapuram: containment measures; urgent culling of chickens and farm poultry within a one-kilometer radius.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, avian influenza (H5N1) has been confirmed in Udayanapuram Gram Panchayat, Ward 16, Vaikom taluk, Kottayam district, Kerala. The District Disaster Management Authority has ordered urgent culling of chickens and other poultry within a 1-km radius of the infected area, declaring the zone infected, with a 10-km surveillance belt around it. The 10-km ring encompasses Vaikom Municipality and the local bodies of Chempu, Maravanthuruthu, TV Puram, Thalayazham, Kallara, Thalayolaparambu, Kaduthuruthy. Within these areas, the use, sale, or transport of eggs, poultry meat, live birds, and manure is prohibited for three days; bringing such materials into or out of the surveillance zone is banned for three months. Violations will be strictly prosecuted under the Disaster Management Act 2005.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァイコム・ウダヤナプラムで鳥インフルエンザ確認：封じ込め対策；1キロメートル範囲内の鶏および家禽の緊急殺処分指示
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の人獣感染が確認された公式事例であり、IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当し、政府レベルの対応（殺処分・制限措置）が実施されている。
triage.notes: H5N1はWHO監視対象の高優先度病原体。ケララ州での確認は公式な当局報告。10km監視帯域の設定、3ヶ月間の移動・流通制限は地域的に重大な影響。3年前（2023年）にも同州でH5N1鳥インフルエンザ確認例あり、再発生の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Imbau Anak Bergejala Campak Tetap di Rumah demi Tekan Penularan di Sekolah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Urges Children With Measles Symptoms to Stay at Home to Curb Transmission in Schools
article.articleSummary: Measles transmission in Indonesia remains high but is decreasing. The Ministry of Health reports an R0 of 12–18. It urges parents and schools to keep students with measles-like symptoms at home to curb spread in crowded classrooms, and to promptly detect fever, cough, runny nose, or conjunctivitis. If signs appear, children should be taken to health facilities; schools should coordinate with Puskesmas for epidemiological surveillance and isolation of patients. Nationally, cases peaked at 2,220 earlier in 2026 and fell to 195 in week 13. Outbreak Response Immunization progress as of 9 April 2026: Depok 100%, Bima 80.8%, Palembang 60.9%. A Measles-Rubella vaccination program is also being rolled out for healthcare workers in 14 high-risk provinces and for medical/dental interns to shield frontline staff. Combined measures aim to rapidly interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 厚生労働省、学校での麻疹感染を抑制するため麻疹症状のある子どもの自宅滞在を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹・風疹の持続的な感染が報告されており、R0=12-18と高い伝播力を示している。複数地域での集団発生対応（予防接種キャンペーン実施中）と政府による公式な感染制御勧告により、IHR基準3項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして認識すべき事象である。
triage.notes: 麻疹はR0=12-18と高伝播力であり、週ごとの症例数の減少傾向が見られるが、依然として全国で複数地域の集団発生が継続中。政府による複合的対策（予防接種キャンペーン、学校での隔離・サーベイランス強化）が実施されている。2026年初期に週2,220症例から第13週に195症例への改善傾向があるが、東南アジア地域全体への波及リスクがあるため、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Programa Cuidar busca reduzir tuberculose e ampliar acesso à saúde no sistema prisional brasileiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuidar Program Aims to Reduce Tuberculosis and Expand Access to Healthcare in Brazil's Prison System.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's National Justice Council (CNJ) launched the Cuidar program in Rio de Janeiro on April 10, 2026, as part of the Pena Justa plan to expand health care access in Brazil's prison system and tackle tuberculosis amid high infectious-disease burdens. The initiative unites CNJ, the Ministries of Health and Justice & Public Security, and Fiocruz under a technical cooperation agreement to provide basic care, strengthen prevention, and integrate prison health into existing public-health policies. Cuidar targets continuity of care across the entire penal cycle—from entry to post-sentence—seeking to reduce overcrowding and improve health and hygiene conditions in prisons, with more than 300 milestones planned through 2027. STF/CNJ President Edson Fachin emphasized the right to health and dignity for incarcerated individuals. Public-health experts highlighted challenges of infections, mental health, and infrastructure; OPAS notes prison health cannot be treated in isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの刑務所制度における結核削減と医療アクセス拡大を目指す「Cuidar計画」
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の公衆衛生課題であり、記事はブラジルの刑務所における結核対策プログラムの立ち上げを扱っている。ただし、新規の流行発生や急速な拡大の報告ではなく、既存の課題への制度的対応であるため、シグナル基準の閾値未満と判断される。情報収集を継続する価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は結核という既知の重大公衆衛生問題を扱い、ブラジルの国家機関による制度的対応を報道している。刑務所という特定環境における長期曝露と流行しやすさの要因は確認されるが、新たな流行勃発や国際的拡大のシグナルではなく、既存課題への政策的対応である。WPROスクリーニング基準では3項目該当するが、IHR基準は1項目のみで、かつ異常性が低いため、フルRRA前のWATCH段階が適切。国際保健機関（OPAS）の関与も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: PiauÃ­ entra em alerta com dengue em 28 municÃ­pios e mais de 4 mil casos registrados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí on alert over dengue in 28 municipalities, with more than 4,000 cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert in Piauí, Brazil: 28 municipalities are classified as high risk with 4,202 probable dengue cases in 2026 and one confirmed death. The Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa/LIA) indicate 12.5% of the state’s municipalities have an infestation index of 4% or higher. A further 85 municipalities (37.9%) are in alert (1–3.9%), and 111 cities (49.6%) are considered satisfactory (<1%). Despite overall relative stability, concern centers on theSão Raimundo Nonato region where cases are rising. On April 10, the State Health Secretariat (Sesapi) activated the Emergency Operations Center (COE) to reinforce surveillance and align new control measures. The circulation of multiple dengue serotypes, including the re-emergence of serotype 3, could raise the risk of severe cases. Authorities urge intensified preventive actions to prevent health-system overload. The survey also flags 93 municipalities as “silent,” with no recent reports, suggesting possible underreporting or surveillance gaps.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でデング熱警報、28自治体で高リスク分類、4,000件以上の症例報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル単一州でのデング熱集団発生（4,202件、死亡1件）として異常性と重症度を示唆するが、国家レベルの国際的拡大リスクや地域管理困難性の明確な証拠に欠けるため。続報による情報充実が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、Bluedot APIで検出されたイベントのため verified_locations に含めた。IHR基準は2つ以上該当（serious_impact、unusual_unexpected）しているため理論的にはPICKUP候補だが、発生がブラジルの単一州に限定され、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクが明確でないため、より保守的にWATCHとした。セロタイプ3の再興や複数セロタイプ循環の情報は重症化リスク増加の指標。93の「沈黙自治体」は過小報告の可能性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Mortes por malária caem mais de 80% na Terra Yanomami, aponta governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from malaria fall by more than 80% in the Yanomami Territory, according to the government.
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in the Yanomami Indigenous Territory in Brazil fell 80.8% from 2023 to 2025 after emergency health measures. The government attributes the decline to expanded diagnostics, with malaria testing rising from about 144,000 to over 257,000 in 2025. Malnutrition deaths decreased by 53.2% over the same period, accompanied by more children achieving healthy weight and receiving regular health follow-up. Treatment of acute respiratory infections also broadened, contributing to lower lethality. Vaccination activity increased, with a substantial rise in doses and improved vaccination coverage among children. The improvements are linked to strengthened presence of health teams in the territory; since the emergency began, the number of health professionals more than tripled, expanding access to care in Indigenous communities.

triage.headline_ja: ヤノマミ領土でのマラリア死亡者数が80%以上低下、政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2023年から2025年にかけてのマラリア死亡者数の大幅な低下を報告しており、これは公衆衛生措置の成功を示すポジティブなニュースであり、シグナルとしての懸念すべき異常事態ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア死亡者数の減少という好ましい傾向を報告しており、緊急事態の改善を示すもの。シグナルトリアージの観点からは、異常または予想外の感染症イベントではなく、公衆衛生対応の成功例として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: Indiana Researcher Sentenced For Smuggling E. Coli DNA Into U.S. From China As Underwear - Tampa Free Press
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-11, Youhuang Xiang, a 32-year-old former Indiana University postdoctoral researcher on a J-1 visa, was sentenced on April 7, 2026, in federal court to more than four months’ prison, a $500 fine, and one year of supervised release for smuggling biological materials into the United States. Investigators traced suspicious shipments from China to university affiliates; a March 2024 package to Xiang bore a deceptive label—“Underwear of Man-Made Fibers, Other Womens”—and originated from Guangzhou Sci-Tech Innovation Trading. In November 2025 at Chicago O’Hare, Xiang admitted the lingerie tactic concealed DNA samples of E. coli, intended to bypass U.S. import controls. Prosecutors said Xiang exploited access to Indiana’s flagship research facilities and his J-1 visa; the USDA IG noted use of federally funded USDA grant. The FBI, CBP, and USDA OIG led the investigation. Following prison, Xiang faces deportation to China under a Judicial Order of Removal.

triage.headline_ja: インディアナ州の研究者がチャイナからの下着に隠したE.coli DNAの密輸で投獄 - タンパフリープレス
triage.triage_reason: 本件は密輸事件であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・公衆衛生上の流行ではない。生物材料の違法な輸送に関する刑事事件であり、患者の発症や集団感染の報告がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベントの流行・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、生物材料の違法密輸に関する刑事司法事件である。E. coliは病原体として検出されたのではなく、DNA サンプルの密輸容疑の対象物にすぎない。患者数、死亡、入院、或いは地域社会への感染リスク等の情報は記事に含まれていない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança em SP e vacinação segue abaixo da meta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu advances in São Paulo, and vaccination remains below target
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in São Paulo state ahead of winter, with Campinas, Baixada Santista, and Bragantina seeing increasing cases. From January to mid-March 2026, Brazil recorded 3,584 influenza-related severe acute respiratory illness cases, nearly double the 1,838 in the same period 2025, and over 800 deaths from respiratory viruses nationally in 2026. Post-Covid-19 shifts have altered seasonality, driving earlier, stronger circulation. Vaccination remains well below target: 9.4% in Campinas and 6.5% in Baixada Santista as of April 8, versus a 90% goal. The federal government advanced the 2026 flu campaign, starting March 28, with a Day D in Campinas and Baixada Santista using fixed and mobile posts. The free vaccine is for seniors, children, pregnant people, healthcare workers, and those with chronic diseases, protecting against influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and influenza B.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザがサンパウロで拡大、予防接種は目標値以下のままである
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの活動が季節外れに拡大し、2026年の重症呼吸器感染症は前年同期比で2倍に達する異常性を示している。公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、複数地域での同時流行という国際的関心を持つシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の変化（post-COVID-19）によってインフルエンザが例年より早期・強烈に流行していることを強調。ワクチン接種率が目標値の90%に対し極めて低い（6.5～9.4%）ため、今後のさらなる拡大リスクがある。複数地域での同時流行であり、システマティックな監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控提醒：流脑进入高发季，警惕早期症状
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC reminds: Meningococcal meningitis has entered its peak season; be vigilant for early symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, China CDC warns that meningococcal meningitis (流行性脑脊髓膜炎) is entering its peak season in winter–spring in China. The disease features abrupt onset, rapid progression, high transmissibility, a high asymptomatic infection rate, and a high case-fatality rate. Early symptoms resemble a common cold, risking delayed diagnosis and treatment. Prevention focuses on vaccination, good personal hygiene, and avoiding crowded places to reduce transmission and protect others. The warning came from a National Health Commission briefing on seasonal health; the article does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or information on imported or exported cases. Vigilance during the peak season and adherence to vaccination and hygiene measures are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 中疾控提醒：流脑进入高发季，警惕早期症状
triage.triage_reason: 流行性脳脊髄膜炎の季節的注意喚起であり、公式な情報提供と考えられるが、具体的な新規症例数、死亡報告、または異常な流行の兆候に関する具体的な情報が欠如している。国内での既知の季節的パターンの範囲内の警告と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は中国CDCによる季節的な公式な健康警告であり、新規の異常な流行事象ではなく、毎年の冬春季における既知の高発季の周知情報と考えられる。具体的な症例数、死亡者数、または異常な流行パターンの報告がないため、IHR基準を満たさない。ただし流行性脳脊髄膜炎は高い感染性と高い死亡率を有する疾患であり、続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: H3N2 cases risen considerably, patients taking longer time to recover: Expert
article.articleSummary: H3N2 influenza is driving a rise in respiratory illness in India, with cases increasing in the last couple of months ahead of Holi. ICMR identifies Influenza A subtype H3N2 as the major cause of rising respiratory illness, with pan-India surveillance by ICMR/DHR across 30 VRDLs showing H3N2 causes more hospitalizations than other influenza subtypes. Among hospitalized SARI patients with influenza A H3N2, 92% had fever, 86% cough, 27% breathlessness, 16% wheezing, 16% signs of pneumonia, and 6% seizures; 10% required oxygen, and 7% needed ICU care. Clinically, influenza symptoms include fever, body ache, sore throat, cough, runny nose, and shortness of breath; recovery time is longer this season with persistent cough and weakness. Dr. S Chatterjee cautions against unnecessary antibiotics; COVID-appropriate behavior helps prevent influenza; immunocompromised individuals should take precautions and seek medical advice if not improving.

triage.headline_ja: H3N2の症例が大幅に増加、患者の回復に長期間を要する：専門家
triage.triage_reason: インドでH3N2インフルエンザの急増が報告され、ICMR/DHRの全国監視で確認。IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行性」「長期曝露」に複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インド全域での監視体制があり、複数州での患者発生を示唆。ホリ祭（4月）に向けた季節的上昇。回復時間の延長と重症化率（ICU入院7%、酸素療法必要10%）が注目される。国際的拡大リスクおよび支援必要性については情報不足。

article.articleHeadline: ഉദയനാപുരത്ത് പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Udayanapuram.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Udayanapuram gram panchayat, Vaikom taluk, Kottayam district, prompting strict containment. A one-kilometer radius around the infected zone will be culled, with immediate disposal of chickens and other domestic birds, eggs, meat, and manure. A ten-kilometer surveillance zone has been established around the outbreak. The District Disaster Management Authority, chaired by District Collector Chetankumar Meen, announced these boundaries and controls. The 10 km radius includes Vaikom municipality and the Chemp, Maravanthuruth, TV Puram, Thalayazham, Kallara, Thalayolaparambu, and Kaduthuruthy panchayats, which will be subject to restrictions. For three days, the sale, use, and transport of eggs, chicks, poultry (and other birds), as well as their meat and manure, are prohibited outside the area.

triage.headline_ja: ウダヤナプラムで鳥インフルエンザが確認された
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の人獣共通感染症として公衆衛生上の関心が高く、国際的な拡大リスクがある。インドのケーララ州で確認された事例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州ウダヤナプラム（Vaikom taluk, Kottayam district）での鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)確認を主題としている。影響カテゴリは「animals」（動物）であるが、H5N1は人獣共通感染症であり公衆衛生上の重大懸念である。1km内の家禽・卵・肉・堆肥の処分、10km監視圏の設置が実施されており、管理レベルは高い。Sri Lankaは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは言及されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: First Marine Virus Jump to Humans Causes Severe Eye Infections - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: CMNV (covert mortality nodavirus), a virus widespread in wild and farmed aquatic animals globally, has been identified as the causative agent of a human eye disease: persistent ocular hypertensive viral anterior uveitis (POH-VAU). This represents the first known case of an aquatic-origin virus crossing the species barrier to infect humans. In China, a growing number of POH-VAU cases have been linked to CMNV, with 70 patients studied showing CMNV infection in ocular tissues and seroconversion. Clinically, POH-VAU causes severe ocular inflammation and increased intraocular pressure, with potential irreversible vision loss; glaucoma-like symptoms have been observed. Exposure risk analyses identified unprotected processing of seafood and consumption of raw aquatic animals as the main drivers, accounting for 71.4% of infections. Animal challenge tests showed CMNV causes elevated intraocular pressure and ocular tissue damage in mice; in vitro CMNV infects mammalian cells. Researchers note climate change and human activity may elevate spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: 海洋ウイルスが初めてヒトに感染、重篤な眼感染症を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 新規人獣共通感染症（海洋ウイルスの初めてのヒト感染）、重篤な眼疾患、中国で70人の患者確認、国際的な水産物流通リスク、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: CMNV（隠蔽死亡性ノダウイルス）は水生動物に広く分布する既知ウイルスだが、ヒト感染は初報告。中国で70人の患者が特定されており、未治療の視力喪失リスクがある。水産物の非衛生的処理と生食が主な感染経路（71.4%）であり、国際的な水産物流通を通じた拡大リスクが存在する。気候変動による人獣共通感染症スピルオーバーのリスク増加も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança antes do inverno e número de casos quase dobra no Brasil em 2026 - Denise Cursino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu spreads ahead of winter and the number of cases nearly doubles in Brazil in 2026 - Denise Cursino.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's flu season began earlier and more intensely in 2026, with influenza-associated severe acute respiratory syndrome rising sharply. Between January and mid-March 2026, influenza-related SARS cases reached 3,584, up from 1,838 in the same period in 2025, while total deaths from respiratory viruses exceed 800. Across the same period, about 14,000 cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome were recorded in Brazil. Climate factors—extended rains and temperature fluctuations—are linked to spread, especially in closed, poorly ventilated spaces. Health authorities emphasize prevention and vaccination; the national campaign runs through May 30 with a 90% target for priority groups. About 6 million doses have been administered. Free vaccination is available at health posts for children, the elderly, pregnant women, health workers, teachers, Indigenous peoples, and people with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが冬前に拡大し、ブラジルの2026年の症例数がほぼ倍増
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザ関連の重症急性呼吸器症候群が前年比で増加しており、スクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度が確認できるが、国際的拡大やトレードへの影響が明確でなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で2026年4月配信。2025年同時期の1,838件から2026年1月〜3月中旬で3,584件への増加を報告。気候要因（延長雨、気温変動）が関連していると指摘。国内予防接種キャンペーンが進行中（5月30日まで、優先グループ目標90%）で6百万回分が投与済み。IHR基準で2つ以上該当しているが、対象国がブラジル（WPRO地域外）であり、国際的な拡大リスクの明確な記述がないため、WATCHとして継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 中国首次大规模爆新型口蹄疫情 病毒来势汹汹没药没疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's first large-scale outbreak of a novel foot-and-mouth disease; the virus is advancing fiercely with no drugs or vaccines.
article.articleSummary: SAT1-type foot-and-mouth disease has triggered China’s first large-scale domestic outbreak, spreading to at least 12 provinces, notably Xinjiang (Yining County, Ili Prefecture) and Gansu (Gulang County). The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs confirmed SAT1 infections in late March, with market data showing 513 cattle at a trading market and 142 ill in Yining, and 5,716 cattle on a farm with 77 ill in Gulang. SAT1 is not covered by the national vaccines (which target O- and A-type serotypes), and there are no effective drugs. The virus, transmissible via air, feed, contaminated surfaces, and vehicles, has a 2–14 day incubation. Calf mortality can reach 50%, piglet mortality 30–70%, and cattle, sheep, and pigs are affected. Control measures include culling, market closures, roadblocks, and cross-provincial transport bans; hog futures plunged, and live pig prices fell below 5 yuan per jin in many areas.

triage.headline_ja: 中国初の大規模新型口蹄疫アウトブレイク；ウイルスが猛烈に進行、治療薬もワクチンもなし
triage.triage_reason: SAT1型口蹄疫の中国初の大規模アウトブレイクで、少なくとも12省に拡大、現有ワクチンでは対応不可、動物への深刻な影響と経済的影響を伴うシグナル。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 動物疾患（口蹄疫）であるが、SAT1型は中国で初の大規模発生、既存ワクチン無効、経済的影響大（食肉価格暴落、先物取引への影響）。人獣共通感染症ではないが、国境措置（家畜移動禁止）の可能性あり。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: "Прорвався через кордон": у Китаї виявили перші випадки ящуру, на який не діє вакцина
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Broke through the border": China detects the first cases of foot-and-mouth disease for which the vaccine is not effective.
article.articleSummary: China reports the first domestic outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease, serotype SAT1, in Xinjiang and Gansu. SAT1 was detected around 28 March; by 7 April authorities confirmed it had breached the border. Vaccines for serotypes O and A do not protect SAT1. Emergency approvals were granted for two SAT1 vaccines by Zhongnong Weite Biotechnology, valid through 30 June 2026, with vaccinations started by 3 April. Jinyu Biotech's subsidiary received emergency approval for two SAT1 vaccines on 8 April. SAT1 is highly contagious among cattle, sheep, and pigs, with near 100% attack rate and >50% mortality in young stock; incubation up to 14 days, symptoms similar to O-type FMD, risking misdiagnosis. Measures include slaughter, disinfection, movement restrictions, and closed housing; recovered animals may shed for up to two years. In Hebei, live cattle imports from Inner Mongolia and Gansu are restricted, with market stock halved by 8 April.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境を突破」：中国で、ワクチンが効かない口蹄疫が初めて確認される
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1型の新規国内発生で、既存ワクチン無効かつ高い伝播性を持つ重要な動物疾病。中国での初検出であり、国際的な家畜貿易への影響リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫SAT1型は中国では初検出。既存ワクチン（O型・A型）が無効であり、ワクチン供給に緊急承認が必要。高い伝播性（攻撃率100%近く）と若齢家畜での高い死亡率（>50%）、最長2年の持続的排菌により管理が困難。河北省での生畜輸入制限など、すでに地域的な貿易影響が発生。

article.articleHeadline: "Прорвался через границу": Китай борется со вспышкой ящура, против которого нет вакцин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Breached the border": China battles a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak for which there are no vaccines.
article.articleSummary: China faces its first domestic outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease caused by SAT1, detected March 28 in Xinjiang and Gansu, with officials saying SAT1 breached the border by April 7. Vaccines for serotypes O and A do not protect SAT1; emergency approvals have been granted for two vaccines (subunit and inactivated) by Zhongnong Weite Biotechnology, valid to 2026-06-30. Vaccination began around April 3; cattle and sheep require 21 days for immunity. Authorities have culled, disinfected, and disposed of infected animals; some western provinces halted movement of cattle and sheep. Hebei’s Zhangbei market barred live cattle from Inner Mongolia and Gansu; stocks fell about half, from ~10,000 to ~5,000–6,000 by April 8. SAT1 is highly contagious, with nearly 100% morbidity and >50% mortality in young stock; carriers may shed for up to two years in cattle. Global spread includes Iraq (2025) and Kuwait, Turkey, Iran, signaling risk to Russia, Afghanistan and Pakistan.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境を突破した」：中国、ワクチンがない口蹄疫の流行と戦う
triage.triage_reason: 中国でSAT1型口蹄疫の国内初発生が確認され、高い感染性（ほぼ100%罹患率、若齢家畜で50%以上の死亡率）と国際的な拡大リスク（イラク、クウェート、トルコ、イラン確認）があり、IHR基準3項目に該当。動物由来感染症としての管理可能性の懸念も認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載されたイラク、クウェート、トルコ、イラン、アフガニスタン、パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。中国（新疆・甘粛省）での初発生と国境越え確認が主題。2026年6月30日までの限定的なワクチン承認により、管理の困難性が懸念される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: More than 1,700 measles cases in the US - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, a UK-China team conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of eight Nipah virus studies through November 2025, detailing acute and long-term sequelae. Nipah transmission is primarily via ingestion of raw date palm sap contaminated by fruit bats; initial Malaysia/Singapore outbreaks occurred in 1998–1999, with survivors reporting residual neurological symptoms. The analysis split into Nipah encephalitis survivors (three studies) and broader Nipah virus infection survivors (five studies), most focusing on the Malaysia/Singapore outbreak. Pooled estimates show 45% of Nipah encephalitis survivors have residual neurological deficits and 24% of Nipah virus infection survivors, with about 10% experiencing delayed or recurrent neurological symptoms after recovery. Across 34 potential post-acute neurological symptoms, fatigue and excessive daytime sleepiness were markedly higher in infected versus household controls in the controlled study. Data on newer Nipah strains from India/Bangladesh are limited; further evidence is needed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で麻疹患者が1,700人以上 - ExBulletin
triage.triage_reason: 記事見出しと内容の不一致が著しい。見出しは米国の麻疹を示唆するが、実際のサマリーはニパウイルスの長期神経学的後遺症に関する系統的レビュー（2025年11月までのデータ）であり、新規アウトブレイクではなく過去事例の分析。シグナル判定には不十分だが、対象国への関連性と継続監視の必要性あり。
triage.notes: 重要な注記：見出しと内容の大きな乖離が認められる。見出しは『米国の麻疹1,700人以上』を示唆しているが、実際のサマリーはニパウイルスの後遺症に関する過去の系統的レビュー・メタ分析であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。API上の疾患タグ（Nipah、Unknown Encephalitis）と見出しの矛盾も確認。Bluedotのメタデータ信頼性に留保あり。記事本文が提供されていないため、詳細な検証不可。サマリー記載の対象国はChina、India、Bangladesh、Malaysia、Singaporeだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはChina（1814991）とIndia（1269750）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു, കോട്ടയത്തെ ഉദയനാപുരം പഞ്ചായത്തിൽ; ഒരു കിമീ ചുറ്റളവിൽ കോഴികളെയും വളർത്തു പക്ഷികളെയും നശിപ്പിക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed again in Kerala, in the Udayanapuram panchayat of Kottayam; within a one-kilometer radius, chickens and other poultry will be culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) is confirmed again in Kerala, in the 16th ward of Udayanapuram panchayat, Kottayam district. An immediate containment order culls chickens and other poultry within a 1-km radius and imposes a three-day restriction on the sale, meat processing, and eggs of poultry across eight local self-government areas, including Vaikom Municipality. Officials say human infection risk is low and urge the public not to panic. Bird symptoms include ruffled plumage, reduced egg production, drooping posture, blue discoloration on beak/comb/wattles, vomiting, diarrhea, weakness, respiratory distress, and possible death in infected birds. Transmission occurs via secretions of infected birds, aerosols, contaminated litter and items, and through meat and eggs from infected stock; human infection can occur by inhaling virus-containing particles or contact with contaminated materials. Current date: 2026-04-11.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で再び鳥インフルエンザが確認、コッタヤム県ウダヤナプラム地区で；1km圏内で鶏および家禽を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、ヒト感染の可能性を含む異常事象。IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）3つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・長期曝露リスク・流行しやすさ）3つ以上が該当し、インド当局による既存対応措置が報告されている。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ケララ州での鳥インフルエンザ確認は2度目の報告。公式当局が家禽殺処分令および鶏卵・鶏肉販売制限を既に実施。ヒト感染リスクは低いと当局が評価しているが、ウイルス粒子吸入および汚染物質接触によるヒト感染の可能性が記事で言及されている。南アジア地域における鳥インフルエンザ循環の継続的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Pernambuco investiga morte de menino de 8 anos com suspeita de meningite bacteriana - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco State Health Secretariat investigates the death of an eight-year-old boy with suspected bacterial meningitis - Portal CBN Recife.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Benjamin Leite Costa died in Recife, Brazil, with suspected bacterial meningitis. Symptoms began during a trip to Gravatá in Pernambuco’s Agreste region, and he sought care at three health units before dying at Hospital Geral de Areias in the city’s West Zone. The Pernambuco State Health Secretariat (SES) says the case is under investigation. Three blood tests were performed; dengue was ruled out in one, while the final result remained inconclusive. After an antibiotic injection, he developed a red rash and was moved to an improvised intensive care area en route to Hospital Oswaldo Cruz, but he did not survive. The death was confirmed post-mortem. The family notified his school, which suspended classes on April 9 for cleaning; authorities state meningitis protocols do not require school closures, with chemoprophylaxis limited to close contacts. The last day of school attendance was April 1.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブーコ州保健局が細菌性髄膜炎の疑いで8歳男児の死亡を調査
triage.triage_reason: 細菌性髄膜炎の死亡報告は重症度基準に該当するが、単一事例であり国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生上の広域影響が明確でないため。情報集約を継続し、追加事例の報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は細菌性髄膜炎の死亡事例であるが、検査結果は最終確定せず、血液検査でデング熱は除外されたが髄膜炎の病因特定に至っていない。単一事例の報告段階であり、IHR基準は1つのみ該当。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、当該イベントはブラジル国内に限定され、国際的拡大の具体的根拠がない。学校閉鎖措置は取られておらず、濃厚接触者への化学予防に限定されている。追加事例報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tim Pengabdian FK Unair Skrining TBC dengan AI di Kecamatan Bulak Surabaya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unair's Faculty of Medicine Community Service Team TB Screening with AI in Bulak District, Surabaya.
article.articleSummary: TB screening using AI integrated with chest X-ray and portable X-ray devices conducted by the University of Airlangga Faculty of Medicine's Community Service Team in Bulak District, Surabaya, as of 11 April 2026. The program, dubbed Cerdas-TB: Chest Early Radiographic Detection and Active Screening, combines radiography and artificial intelligence to improve early case finding and reduce transmission, with an emphasis on community education about TB risk. Diagnoses rely on chest X-ray plus AI interpretation; symptomatic TB can present with a persistent cough for two weeks or longer; other symptoms include unexplained weight loss and night-time fever. TB is airborne; early testing helps prevent spread and possible extrapulmonary dissemination to organs, including the brain. The local government has announced sanctions for patients who do not complete treatment, highlighting public health enforcement to achieve Indonesia's TB-free target.

triage.headline_ja: スラバヤ・ブラク地区でのAIを用いたTB（結核）スクリーニング：Unair医学部地域奉仕チームの取り組み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの結核スクリーニングプログラムの実施報告だが、新規感染症の検出や急激な流行の報告ではなく、既知疾患に対する予防的な早期検査の推進活動。国家的な結核対策政策に位置付く構想だが、信号化するほどの突発的危機性や国際的拡大リスクは現時点では低い。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事はインドネシア政府による組織的な早期検査・治療強化プログラムの報告。新規のアウトブレイクや流行拡大の兆候ではなく、むしろ国家結核対策の一環。ただし結核は長期的な曝露リスク（community transmission）があり、AI導入による検査拡大が行われている点で監視継続の価値あり。情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Virus marino CMNV negli umani: nuovo studio su Nature Microbiology, Bassetti: "Sintomi oculari gravi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marine CMNV virus in humans: new study in Nature Microbiology, Bassetti: "Severe ocular symptoms."
article.articleSummary: Covert mortality nodavirus (CMNV), as of 11 Apr 2026 linked to human infection after previously affecting only aquatic animals, is associated with persistent anterior viral uveitis with elevated intraocular pressure (POH-VAU) and potential vision loss. A Nature Microbiology study examined 70 POH-VAU patients diagnosed between 2022 and 2025 in China, analyzing removed ocular tissues. Electron microscopy showed CMNV-like particles ~25 nm; a gold-labeled antibody specific to CMNV confirmed the virus; genome sequencing yielded 98.96% identity with the animal CMNV. Cell culture and animal models indicate the aquatic virus can infect mammalian cells and provoke intraocular hypertension, mirroring human symptoms. About 71% of patients had frequent exposure to aquatic animals, mainly via handling or raw seafood. CMNV was detected in 49 species, including crabs and mollusks, across Asia, Africa, Europe, Antarctica, and the Americas. Experts warn of severe ocular symptoms with potential permanent vision damage, underscoring oceans as a new infectious-disease frontier.

triage.headline_ja: 海洋ウイルスCMNVのヒト感染：Nature Microbiologyの新研究、バセッティ医師「重度の眼症状」
triage.triage_reason: 新規病原体（海洋ウイルスCMNV）のヒト感染が確認され、重度の眼症状と視力喪失のリスク、および地理的に広範な動物での検出（アジア、アフリカ、ヨーロッパなど）が報告されている。IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露の可能性が認められ、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは2022～2025年の中国での患者70名を対象とした研究が中心であり、動物での広範な検出地（アフリカ、南極、アメリカ等）はBluedt APIの地域抽出によるものと考えられる。検証可能な感染症イベントの発生地は中国（患者の診断および組織分析）に限定。新規人畜共通感染症で重症度が高く、海洋生物を介した継続的曝露リスクがあるため、フルRRA実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി: വൈക്കം നഗരസഭ ഉൾപ്പെടെ ഏട്ട് തദ്ദേശ സ്ഥാപന മേഖലകളിലും നിയന്ത്രണം | Bird flu strikes again in Kerala: Controls in eight local government areas including Vaikom Municipality | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu strikes again in Kerala: Controls in eight local government areas including Vaikom Municipality
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) confirmed in Kerala, India, with infection detected in Udayanapuram Panchayat’s 16th Ward, Kottayam district. Eight local government areas, including Vaikom Municipality, impose containment measures and ban the keeping, sale, and use of eggs and meat from poultry in the affected zones for three days. Transmission can occur via infected bird droppings, contaminated litter and gear, or through meat and eggs from infected birds; airborne spread is possible. Infected birds commonly show blue discoloration, diarrhea, swelling around the head and eyes, respiratory distress, and difficulty walking or standing. No human case counts are reported; human risk is considered low, but the public should follow health department guidance and seek medical care if symptoms appear. Authorities have confirmed the outbreak, with culling planned within a one-kilometer radius around the affected area.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州で鳥インフルエンザが再び発生：ヴァイッカム市を含む8つの地方自治体で対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認事例であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・貿易制限リスクが該当。WPROスクリーニングではケーラ州での再発生（異常性）、公衆衛生対応の実施、多地域への拡大対策が明らかであり、複数基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラ州ウダヤナプラム村での鳥インフルエンザ確認を報道。ヴァイッカム市を含む8つの地方自治体で卵・肉の販売禁止など封じ込め対策を実施。人への感染例は報告されていないが、家禽での確認により国際的な懸念が生じる。2026年のケーラ州での再発生であり、継続的な公衆衛生リスクとして位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: 从"头痛脑热"发展到重症肺炎？农村地区流感防护误区要了解
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From "headache and fever" to severe pneumonia? Common misconceptions about influenza protection in rural areas you should know.
article.articleSummary: Influenza and other respiratory infections peak in spring, with rural areas facing protection misconceptions. Deng Yuli of Cawan Town Health Center, Guilin, notes residents often dismiss influenza symptoms—headache, fever, cough, fatigue—as a cold, delaying care. Reliance on folk remedies and improper use of OTC drugs can let influenza progress to pneumonia, especially among the elderly, children, and people with hypertension or diabetes. Preventive practices are often lax: masks not fully covering nose/mouth or reused; incomplete handwashing; poor cough etiquette; and avoiding indoor ventilation. Measures: wear medical or higher-grade masks that cover nose, mouth and chin; seven-step handwashing for at least 15 seconds per step; cover coughs/sneezes with tissue or elbow and discard tissues; open windows 2–3 times daily for at least 30 minutes; limit visits to crowded places with poor ventilation and keep >1 meter distance. Emphasize early symptom recognition and vaccination; seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 「頭痛と発熱」から重症肺炎へ？農村地域のインフルエンザ対策における誤解を理解しよう
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザは季節性疾患であり、記事は予防啓発の内容。IHR基準は2つ以上該当せず、WPROスクリーニングでも確実な流行証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの予防啓発・教育的内容であり、特定の流行アウトブレイク報告ではない。中国（江西省のニュースサイト）とインドネシア（Cawan Town, Guilin地域）で言及されているが、流行規模・死亡数などの詳細が記載されていない。農村地域での感染症対策不備が指摘されているため、管理可能性上の懸念があるが、イベント報告としては限定的。続報で流行動向が確認できれば再評価の余地あり。

article.articleHeadline: বরগুনায় ডায়রিয়ার প্রকোপ বাড়ছে, ৩২ ঘণ্টায় ৭২ জন হাসপাতালে ভর্তি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diarrheal outbreak rising in Barguna; 72 people admitted to hospital in 32 hours.
article.articleSummary: Barguna District, Bangladesh is experiencing an escalating diarrhea outbreak even as dengue and measles circulate. In the 24 hours to 8am today, hospitals admitted 51 diarrhea patients, with Barguna General Hospital alone recording 21 admissions from 8am to 4pm. Across the district, 96 patients sought treatment in the same 24-hour period. Upazila-wise admissions include Amtali 13, Pathorghata 16, Taltoli 6, Betagi 5, Bamna 5. During 5–11 April, 349 diarrhea cases were treated; January–11 April totals reach 2,634. Authorities cite seasonal change, unsafe drinking water, and poor hygiene as drivers, worsened by heat and water scarcity; many still rely on contaminated water, raising risk of typhoid and paratyphoid. A four-month-old baby, Jihad, was among those admitted with diarrhea and vomiting. Hospital staff report strain but say medicines are currently sufficient; no details on laboratory confirmation or exported/imported cases were provided.

triage.headline_ja: バルグナで下痢の流行が拡大；32時間で72人が入院
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュのバルグナ地区で急速に拡大する下痢の流行が報告されており、短期間での多数の患者入院（32時間で72人、4月5-11日で349例）、麻疹とデング熱の同時流行、不衛生な飲料水が原因とされるチフスおよびパラチフスのリスク上昇が示唆されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と流行のしやすさがIHR基準を満たし、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: バングラデシュ東部で複数の水系感染症（下痢、チフス、パラチフス）とウイルス性疾患（麻疹、デング熱）の同時流行。不衛生な飲料水と季節的要因が感染拡大の主要原因。インド（ジャールカンド州も記事発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主題はバングラデシュ内のみであるため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Un premier cas européen de grippe aviaire chez l'homme confirmé par l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A first European case of avian influenza in humans confirmed by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: First European human case of avian influenza A(H9N2) confirmed in Italy in an adult who had recently returned from Senegal; patient is isolated in hospital and recovering. Detection occurred in late March; symptoms were influenza-like. No known contact with infected poultry or sick people. Italian Health Ministry reports routine contact tracing completed. The ECDC notes such A(H9N2) infections are rare in Europe and no human-to-human transmission has ever been documented. A recent ECDC/EFSA surveillance update records ten human avian influenza cases worldwide from 29 November 2025 to 27 February 2026, with no deaths; additional cases reported in Cambodia (one H5N1) and in China (eight A(H9N2) and one A(H10N3)). Overall, EU population risk remains very low. The case underscores zoonotic spillover risk from avian influenza and ongoing monitoring and contact tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパで初めてのヒトへの鳥インフルエンザ感染例がWHOにより確認される
triage.triage_reason: ヨーロッパでの初めてのヒト感染H9N2事例であり、国際的に重大なシグナル。異常性が高く、国際的拡大リスクが存在するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: イタリアでの初European human case（H9N2）は報告地域ですが、イタリアは対象国外。ただし記事サマリーに「Cambodia（H5N1）」と「China（H9N2, H10N3）」の追加事例が明記されており、これら対象国での発生が確認されているため verified_locations に含める。複数国での動物→ヒト感染スピルオーバーが進行中であることが特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Itapetininga e Tatuí registram três casos de meningite em 2026; dois são em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itapetininga and Tatuí report three meningitis cases in 2026; two are in children.
article.articleSummary: Two meningitis cases in Itapetininga (São Paulo) in 2026: one viral and one bacterial. A girl aged 5–9 and a boy under 1; no deaths reported. In Tatuí, one bacterial meningitis case in a man aged 50–59; health status not disclosed. In 2025, Itapetininga registered nine meningitis cases (six bacterial, one viral, two unspecified); no deaths. Meningitis involves inflammation of the brain’s protective membranes and can be caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi or parasites. Transmission occurs via close contact and respiratory droplets; symptoms include high fever, malaise, vomiting, severe headache and neck stiffness, with infants possibly showing a bulging fontanelle and irritability. Prevention relies on vaccines in Brazil’s National Immunization Program: meningococcal conjugate (group C), pneumococcal 10-valent conjugate, and the pentavalent vaccine (Haemophilus influenzae B, diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B). Meningitis is endemic in Brazil; bacterial cases are more common in autumn–winter, viral in spring–summer.

triage.headline_ja: イタペティニンガとタトゥーイが2026年に髄膜炎3例を報告；2例は小児
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで髄膜炎3例（うち2例は小児）が報告されているが、死亡例なく、症例数が限定的で重症度の詳細が不明。スクリーニング基準の該当は不確定だが、対象国リストに該当しないため国際的関心の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルはCEPR対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジル国内のローカルニュース配信。髄膜炎は季節性を示す風土病として記述されており、予防接種プログラムの周知的な報道と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de chikungunya aumentam na região urbana e Dourados chega a 1,5 mil infectados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya cases rise in the urban region, and Dourados reaches 1,500 infected.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya triggers a public health emergency in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with urban-area cases rising to 1,576. The epidemiological bulletin for April 11 reports 3,509 probable cases in the city, 4,837 notifications, and 2,597 under investigation. Two deaths remain under investigation in Dourados (a 10-year-old girl and a 12-year-old boy) with chikungunya suspected; six other deaths have been confirmed (two women aged 69 and 60, two men aged 73 and 55, and two male infants aged 3 months and 1 month). The city’s notification curve has recently declined in weeks 13–14, though data-lag may affect current figures. Indigenous villages account for 1,962 probable and 1,285 confirmed cases (677 under investigation; 2,417 notifications). Across Mato Grosso do Sul, 16 municipalities are in an epidemic; 4,214 probable cases, 7 confirmed deaths, 3 deaths under investigation, with incidence 144.1 per 100,000 (state average).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱の事例が都市部で増加し、ドウラードスでは1,500人の感染者に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブラジル南部での大規模流行、死亡例確認、先住民村での高い感染率、複数市町村での流行状況がWPRO基準を満たす。
triage.notes: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドウラードス市における公衆衛生上の緊急事態。死亡例7件確認、3件調査中。州全体で16市町村が流行状態。先住民村での高い感染者数（1,962件の疑い患者、1,285件の確認患者）は地域の脆弱性を示唆。ベクター媒介感染症であり、気候条件によっては他地域への拡大リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Profissional de saúde é internado com suspeita de mpox em Itajaí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health professional hospitalized with suspected mpox in Itajaí
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, a nursing technician in Itajaí, on the northern coast of Santa Catarina, Brazil, has been hospitalized with suspected mpox. Laboratory tests are pending to confirm or rule out mpox infection. Health authorities are monitoring the case and emphasize ongoing epidemiological surveillance and adherence to clinical care protocols to prevent transmission. Mpox is a viral disease that can present with fever, skin lesions, and general malaise, making early identification crucial to stop spread. No confirmation has been reported yet, and the article does not provide details on exposure sources or travel history. The response underscores vigilance in local health facilities while awaiting laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイで疑い例のサル痘患者が入院（ブラジル）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるサル痘の疑い例（医療従事者）の報告だが、未確認症例であり、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な集団発生の兆候が現在のところ不明。情報の追加確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は未確認の疑い例報告であり、実験室診断の結果待ち。医療従事者の感染疑いということで医療システム内での感染拡大リスクが存在する可能性があるが、現段階では集団発生の証拠なし。後続報道でサル痘確定と集団感染の兆候が報告される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue dips sharply in 2025, but malaria, chikungunya worry Delhi
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a sharp dengue decline in 2025: 1,399 cases and 2 deaths by Dec 6, down from 6,391 cases/11 deaths in 2024 and 9,266 cases/19 deaths in 2023. Malaria rose to 792 cases in 2024 and remained 719 in 2025; chikungunya reached 168 in 2025 after 267 in 2024. No chikungunya deaths since 2018; malaria deaths totaled two in 2020 and 2022. Dengue outbreaks have been cyclical, with major spikes in 2021 (9,613 cases, 23 deaths) and 2023, reflecting seasonal and environmental factors. Transmission typically rises during the monsoon (late June–July) with peaks in September–October. The State Health Mission pursued IEC campaigns in Oct–Nov 2025, metro-area outreach, and strengthened surveillance via the Integrated Health Information Platform for near-real-time monitoring across facilities. In 2026, authorities aim for sustained vigilance, especially in dense areas.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年のデング熱は急減、しかしマラリアとチクングニアがデリーを懸念させる
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は減少傾向を示しているが、マラリアとチクングニアの継続的な発生が確認されている。対象国インドでの複数蚊媒介感染症の同時発生であり、公衆衛生上の監視が継続されているため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は減少傾向（2023年9,266件→2025年1,399件）であるが、マラリア（719件）とチクングニア（168件）の継続的な発生がある。季節性蚊媒介感染症として年間を通じた長期曝露リスクが存在し、雨季（6月下旬～7月）と9月～10月に流行ピークを迎える。デリー州保健ミッションが監視体制を強化し、2026年も継続監視方針を明示している。

article.articleHeadline: Veterinary dept, MCC to launch drive to make city rabies-free
article.articleSummary: Mangaluru, under the SAPRE Rabies-free Cities initiative and the National Rabies Control Programme (NRCP), launches a joint vaccination drive by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services and Mangaluru City Corporation to vaccinate stray dogs across 60 wards, aiming to make the coastal city rabies-free. Vaccines are provided free at department clinics; nearly 100,000 pet dogs have already been vaccinated in Dakshina Kannada district. District-level steering committees and a city-level task force have been formed to coordinate action and monitor plans as part of SAPRE, with ongoing drives across Dakshina Kannada. Rabies control hinges on universal dog vaccination to prevent dog-mediated human rabies, targeting zero human deaths by 2030. In 2025, Dakshina Kannada reported 27,481 dog-bite cases (21,673 from pets, 5,808 from strays).

triage.headline_ja: 獣医局とマンガロール市公社が狂犬病撲滅キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生や危機的状況の報告ではない。予防的公衆衛生活動であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の疾患が発生している状況を報じるものではなく、インドの公衆衛生当局による予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報道である。2025年に同地区で2万7千件の犬咬傷事例が報告されているが、これは既知の背景疾患であり、新規のシグナルではない。通常の公衆衛生対応活動として報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: Após ave ser recolhida em praia de Alagoas, biólogo faz alerta para risco de gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a bird was collected on a beach in Alagoas, a biologist warns of the risk of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Alagoas, Brazil: The Public Prosecutor’s Office is drafting a State Action Plan to address avian influenza (high-pathogenic H5N1) amid a lack of guidelines and rising numbers of sick wild birds on beaches, with the Agriculture Ministry extending the national zoosanitary emergency for 180 more days. A Biota Conservation Institute report notes people took home a live, stranded yellow-billed shearwater (Calonectris borealis) from a beach, though the bird appeared injured; authorities advise against touching or relocating wildlife and urge reporting to Biota. Biologist João Antônio emphasizes migratory seabirds’ role in transmitting influenza and the virus risk to poultry and human health. Do not handle wildlife—contact Biota via WhatsApp numbers provided. A multidisciplinary hearing with IMA, Adeal, Sesau, BPA, UVZ, Lacen, and Instituto Biota began drafting the Action Plan. The H5N1 outbreak in Brazil’s wild birds was first detected in May 2023.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴアス州の海岸で回収された野鳥を受け、生物学者が鳥インフルエンザのリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで高病原性H5N1の野生鳥類感染が確認され、人獣共通感染リスク、政府対応の強化（180日間の動物衛生非常事態宣言延長）、および多機関による対応計画策定が進行中。国際的な懸念を持つ新興感染症シグナルであり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2023年5月に初検出されたH5N1の継続的な野生鳥類感染。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないが、高病原性鳥インフルエンザの国際的な懸念事項として優先度が高い。野生渡り鳥による国際的な拡散リスク有り。

article.articleHeadline: 广东报告1起流感暴发疫情！发生在学校！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong reports an influenza outbreak! It occurred at a school!
article.articleSummary: Guangdong reports an influenza-like illness (ILI) outbreak at a school during March 30–April 5, 2026. The provincial CDC weekly acute respiratory disease surveillance lists one ILI outbreak in a school with effective containment. Overall ILI accounted for 4.69% of outpatient visits, below last week (5.17%) and the baseline (5.89%). Virological surveillance detected influenza virus in 8.47% of specimens, down from last week (8.96%) and baseline (12.44%), with influenza B (Victoria lineage) at 82.42% and influenza A(H3N2) at 15.38%. Multi-pathogen testing showed rhinovirus (outpatients 10.00%), influenza virus (9.23%), RSV (6.15%) as top pathogens; among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, rhinovirus (6.15%), parainfluenza (4.62%), influenza/adenovirus/enterovirus (1.54% each). Experts note activity below seasonal level but fluctuating, with B Victoria predominant. Recommendations for schools: improve ventilation and cleaning, continue symptom screening and absentee tracking, and reinforce hand hygiene and cough etiquette to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省がインフルエンザの集団発生を報告！学校で発生
triage.triage_reason: 学校でのインフルエンザ様疾患の集団発生が報告されており、複数の呼吸器病原体が同時検出されている。ただし、当局による効果的な封じ込めが既に実施されており、ILI陽性率は季節基準より低い水準にあるため、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響の証拠は現時点では限定的。追加情報の確認を要す。
triage.notes: 複数呼吸器病原体の同時流行（インフルエンザB（ビクトリア系統）82.42%、H3N2 15.38%、RSV 6.15%、ライノウイルス10.00%）が検出されているが、報告された数値や重症度の具体的データは限定的。学校環境での集団発生のため、感染伝播のリスクは存在するが、当局による封じ込めが既に進行中。ILI陽性率が季節基準以下であることから、現段階では制御可能と評価される。
