article.articleHeadline: Ave marinha é retirada de praia em Alagoas e reacende alerta sobre gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seabird Removed from Alagoas Beach Reignites Avian Influenza Alert.
article.articleSummary: A seabird found on an Alagoas beach, a yellow-billed shearwater (Calonectris borealis), was removed by locals and taken home after appearing weak. The Biota Institute warns against touching or rescuing wildlife and urges contacting authorities for proper handling, as part of ongoing avian influenza (H5N1) surveillance in the state. The incident follows a 10 April public agencies meeting to discuss countermeasures and the drafting of an action plan, with no state plan yet. Nationally, Brazil’s zoosanitary emergency for H5N1 in wild birds was extended by 180 days; the measure has been in effect since 2023. Biota offers channels to report strandings with photos, videos, and location. Agencies involved include IMA, Adeal, Sesau, BPA, UVZ, and Lacen."

triage.headline_ja: アラゴアス州のビーチから海鳥が回収され、鳥インフルエンザのアラートが再燃
triage.triage_reason: 動物における H5N1 確認は WPRO 基準で「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」を満たすが、人間への感染報告がなく、ブラジルは CEPR 対象国外のため PICKUP 基準に未達。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは CEPR 対象国（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に含まれていないため、verified_locations は空配列となる。動物における H5N1 の継続的な確認と政府レベルの対応計画策定が報告されており、人間への感染リスク転化を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba como eliminar os criadouros do mosquito da dengue, Zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learn how to eliminate the breeding sites of the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Six Brazilian states—São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Tocantins, Mato Grosso do Sul, and Paraná—are projected by the Ministry of Health to experience higher dengue incidence in 2025 than the previous year. The federal government is expanding arbovirus surveillance and actions, following Minister Nísia Trindade’s announcement of the Emergency Operations Center (COE) and a new contingency plan to strengthen the health network and curb case growth. Dengue vaccination guidance has been revised: two-month shelf-life doses may be redeployed to municipalities not yet covered, or broadened to ages 6–16. Public guidance emphasizes eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites—secure water tanks, discard bottles, empty containers, close trash tightly, store tires properly, avoid scrap, keep drains clean—and cooperating with health and vector-control agents. Additional protection includes repellents (DEET, IR3535, or Icaridin), window screens, bed nets, and long-sleeved clothing.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニア熱の蚊の繁殖地を排除する方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの6州でデング熱の発生予測と公衆衛生対応が報道されているが、記事は主に予防啓発・衛生管理の情報提供であり、重篤な流行拡大や緊急事態の報告ではない。情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健省による2025年のデング熱リスク予測と政府の対応方針（緊急オペレーションセンター、ワクチン展開拡大、媒介蚊対策強化）を報道している。記事は啓発・予防情報主体であり、新規流行発生の確認報告ではない。実症例数、死亡数、入院数などの重症度データが不明であるため、現段階ではWATCHとした。今後の症例増加数や重症例の報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Com 14 de casos de gripe, Jundiaí reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: With 14 flu cases, Jundiaí reinforces vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination campaign continues in Jundiaí, São Paulo, Brazil, with 14 flu cases reported in 2026, including one death. Vaccines are available at Basic Health Units (UBSs) and Family Clinics for groups defined by the Ministry of Health, aiming to raise coverage and keep protection up to date. On Saturday, April 11, 2026, a drive-thru vaccination event was offered for seniors 60 years and older and people with reduced mobility, by appointment. Among participants was 62-year-old Lurdes Couto, who attended with her husband Valter Saes and emphasized the vaccine’s role in protecting against evolving influenza strains. The city underscores vaccination to mitigate ongoing spread and protect vulnerable populations as the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: JJ：グリップの14例で、ジュンジャイはワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの散発的症例（14例、死亡1例）がブラジルで報告されており、通常の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と考えられるが、死亡が報告されているため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの散発例と判断される。ブラジルは対象国（GeoNames ID: 3469034）であり確認された。記事は公衆衛生当局による対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が取られていることを示しており、管理可能な状況と考えられる。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемиолог предупредил туристов об адаптации комаров на Бали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemiologist warned tourists about the adaptation of mosquitoes in Bali.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, Bali's Aedes mosquitoes in tourist zones are showing increased daytime activity, elevating the risk of dengue fever and chikungunya transmission. Indonesian epidemiologist Professor Gary Budiman told RIA Novosti that urbanization, climate change, and constant human presence drive the shift in biting patterns. Consequently, conventional protective measures—mosquito nets and night-time repellents—are becoming less effective. The report emphasizes the need to reassess vector-control and personal protection strategies to address daytime biting. No local case counts are provided in the article, but the finding signals heightened exposure for visitors and residents alike in Bali, underscoring the importance of targeted public-health messaging and possibly expanded daytime mosquito-control interventions in tourist hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者がバリ島の蚊の適応についての警告を観光客に発した
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ島）におけるデング熱・チクングニヤの媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の昼間活動増加という異常な現象が報告されており、WPRO基準の「異常/予想外」に該当する。ただし、具体的な患者数や死亡例が記載されておらず、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」の判断に必要な情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の行動パターン変化（昼間活動の増加）という生態学的変化を強調しているが、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、発症例の確認がない。バリ島の観光地での曝露リスク増加が示唆されているが、実際の流行状況は不明。続報で患者発生数や臨床的影響を確認する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: വൈക്കത്ത് പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. രോഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച മേഖലയുടെ ഒരു കിലോമീറ്റർ ചുറ്റളവിലെ കോഴികളെയും മറ്റു വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെയും മാർഗനിർദേശങ്ങൾ പാലിച്ച് അടിയന്തരമായി നശിപ്പിക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Vaikkath. Hens and other domestic poultry within a one-kilometer radius of the affected area will be culled immediately in accordance with guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Vaikkam, Udayanapuram Panchayat, Ward 16, Kerala. Three days earlier (April 8, 2026), a PD John-owned farm in Puthankariyil ward reported mass mortality of about 1,200 chickens; laboratory testing confirmed avian influenza. In response, the Kottayam District Disaster Management Authority and Animal Husbandry Department ordered immediate culling of hens and other domestic poultry within a 1-km radius of the outbreak site. The affected area is designated infected; a 10-km surveillance zone was established around it. Within the 10-km radius, a three-month prohibition on keeping, selling, moving, or exporting ducks, chickens, eggs, meat, litter, and poultry feed and products applies in Vaikkam Municipality and the villages of Chempu, Maravanthuruth, TV Puram, Thalayazham, Kallara, Thalayolaparambu, and Kaduthuruthy. Investigation into the source and broader measures ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ワイカートで鳥インフルエンザ確認。罹患地域1km圏内のニワトリおよび他の飼育家禽は指針に従い直ちに処分される予定
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認例であり、IHR基準（異常性、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、動物から人への感染リスクがある。インド国内での防疫措置実施中で、監視強化が必要な状況。
triage.notes: H5N1の確認により、動物から人への感染リスク、国際的感染拡大のリスク（渡航制限や食品輸出規制の可能性）が存在。ケーララ州での大規模な家禽死亡（約1,200羽）と確認例に基づき、フルRRA実施推奨。地域検証：記事はインド・ケーララ州ワイカートでのH5N1確認を主題としており、Indiaのみverified_locationsに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza aviária: Biota alerta sobre risco de contato com aves no litoral de AL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Biota warns about the risk of contact with birds on the coast of Alagoas.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza warning for Alagoas coast, Brazil: The Instituto Biota de Conservação warns about risk of contact with wild and domestic birds that can transmit avian influenza, a highly contagious viral disease with potential human health implications. Biologist João Antônio notes migrating birds may strand along the Alagoas coast during breeding or feeding periods, especially if ill or debilitated. The advisory stresses that avian influenza is highly contagious and urges people not to touch or move live or dead birds or bring them home. If a stranded animal is found, contact the Instituto Biota de Conservação at (82) 99115-2944 so authorities can respond. No human cases or outbreak counts are reported; the precautionary guidance is current as of 11 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：アラゴアス州の海岸での野鳥・家禽との接触リスク警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアラゴアス州沿岸での鳥インフルエンザに関する予防的警告。現時点で人的被害や確定例報告がなく、野鳥との接触リスク啓発段階であるため、スクリーニング基準の一部に該当するが情報が不十分。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil(3469034)が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事内容は野生・家禽との接触リスク警告に留まり、人的被害や確定例の報告がない。予防的公衆衛生情報段階と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Síntomas del Nodavirus: Así afecta la salud el virus que ataca China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nodavirus Symptoms: How the Virus That Attacks China Affects Health.
article.articleSummary: Hidden Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV) infects aquatic animals worldwide and is being evaluated for a potential link to human Persistent Hypertensive Anterior Viral Uveitis (POH-VAU) in China. A Nature study reported CMNV infection in the ocular tissues of 70 POH-VAU patients, with higher exposure risk and repeated severe exposures associated with greater POH-VAU risk. Approximately 71% of cases involved activities such as unprotected processing of aquatic animals or consumption of raw seafood. Laboratory data show CMNV can elevate intraocular pressure and cause ocular tissue damage in mice and infect mammalian cells. This constitutes the first proposed association between an ocular human disease and an aquatic-virus, though causality remains unconfirmed. POH-VAU symptoms include intraocular inflammation, raised intraocular pressure, blurred vision, and potentially severe vision loss. No health emergency has been declared; more research is needed, with implications for seafood handling and consumption practices in China.

triage.headline_ja: ノドウイルスの症状：中国を襲うウイルスが健康に及ぼす影響
triage.triage_reason: 未知の水生ウイルス（CMNV）と人間の眼疾患（POH-VAU）の関連性が示唆されており、異常性と重症度基準に該当。ただし因果関係は未確認であり、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は未確認の因果関係を扱っており、公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言はない。水産物処理・消費に関わる曝露リスクが指摘されているが、疾患の国際的拡大可能性は明確でない。より詳細な流行学的情報と研究結果の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 哈工大调查450名感染艾滋病人士，发现：患艾滋病的人，有3大共性_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Harbin Institute of Technology surveyed 450 AIDS patients and found that people with AIDS share three major characteristics.
article.articleSummary: Harbin Institute of Technology researchers surveyed 450 HIV-positive individuals in Harbin, China, and identified three common traits. First, long-standing untreated sexually transmitted infections: over 60% had histories of syphilis, genital warts (condylomata acuminata), or genital herpes before HIV infection, with many not completing formal treatment—relying on self-medication or brief clinic injections—creating mucosal breaches that raise HIV risk. Second, recurrent infections before diagnosis: repeated low-grade fevers, oral candidiasis, and herpes zoster, suggesting waning systemic immunity. Third, exposure to non-sterile injections or invasive procedures: some reported IV drug use, others underwent procedures at unregulated beauty, dental, or foot-care venues with questionable sterilization. Prevention emphasizes avoiding shared needles and using qualified facilities. Traditional Chinese medicine recommendations include Yupingfeng san (Huangqi, Baizhu, Fangfeng) to bolster defenses, daily tapping of axillary and inguinal regions, and moxibustion at Guanyuan twice weekly for 15 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: ハルビン工業大学が450名のHIV感染者を調査し、エイズ患者に見られる3つの共通特性を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はハルビン工業大学による既存HIV患者集団の疫学的特性調査であり、新規発生イベント（新規患者集団の出現、流行、異常な増加）ではない。疾患の既知の危険因子を報告する学術研究であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本件は既存HIV患者の後方視的研究であり、新規感染事例の発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。感染症危機管理の観点からシグナル価値なし。学術的な疫学知見は感染症サーベイランスの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Como eliminar criadouros do mosquito da dengue, Zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to eliminate breeding sites for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Ministry of Health warns that in 2025 six states face higher dengue incidence risk than 2024: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Tocantins, Mato Grosso do Sul and Paraná, based on surveillance showing increasing vulnerability. The federal government expanded arbovirus monitoring and directed actions at state and municipal levels, inaugurating a Center for Emergency Operations (COE) to monitor the national situation and a contingency plan to bolster prevention and care networks. Preventive measures focus on eliminating breeding sites and personal protection (water containers closed, tires stored or discarded, proper waste management) and using repellents (DEET, IR3535, Icaridin), screens, bed nets, and long sleeves in risk areas. Dengue vaccination adjustments reallocate two-month-valid doses to municipalities not yet covered or extend the age range to 6–16 years. Official guidance on dengue, Zika and chikungunya symptoms remains available from the Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニア熱の蚊の繁殖地を排除する方法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの複数州における3つのアルボウイルス感染症（デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア熱）について、保健当局による監視強化と予防措置が報じられている。重症度や国際的拡大のリスク、死亡の報告は記事に記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は公開衛生警告・予防対策の指針に重点を置いており、具体的な患者数、死亡率、重症度に関する情報は提供されていない。ブラジル保健省による積極的なアルボウイルス監視体制の強化と地域レベルの対応が示唆されているが、緊急段階の流行とは言えない状況である。継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Dengue: notificaciones se incrementaron un 8 % en las últimas semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Dengue: notifications increased by 8% in recent weeks.
article.articleSummary: Dengue notifications in Paraguay rose 8% in the latest weeks, with serotypes DENV-1 and DENV-2 identified. The current countrywide average is 343 dengue notifications per week. From weeks 11 to 13, 19 dengue cases were confirmed: 10 in Asunción, 7 in Central, and 2 in Concepción. Year to date, Paraguay has 126 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases. One person hospitalized for dengue originated from San Lorenzo; no deaths were reported in this period. The areas with rising notifications include Central, Asunción, Itapúa, Alto Paraná, Paraguarí, Presidente Hayes, Cordillera, Canindeyú, Ñeembucú, Boquerón, San Pedro, Amambay, Caaguazú, and Alto Paraguay. Health authorities urge the public to conduct environmental cleanups and eliminate potential mosquito breeding sites to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：過去数週間で通知数が8%増加
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイにおけるデング熱の段階的増加が報告されており、複数県で通知数が上昇しているが、現在のところ重症例や死亡は限定的であり、情報不足の部分がある。スクリーニング基準の複数項目が該当する可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはParaguayとPhilippinesの両国が含まれているが、記事サマリーはパラグアイのデング熱状況に焦点を当てている。フィリピン（Calabarzon、San Pedro）への言及は確認されない。対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）にParaguayは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。パラグアイでの感染は検出されても、CEPR/EBS対象国外のため、本シグナルトリアージでは対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por Chikungunya en Tucumán: confirman la circulación comunitaria del virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Alert in Tucumán: Community Transmission of the Virus Confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya alert in Tucumán, Argentina: community transmission confirmed as cases rise from 10 to 93 in 15 days. Local spread centers in the southeast of the provincial capital, with clusters in El Manantial and San Pablo; some infections lack travel history, confirming local circulation. Aedes aegypti remains active despite cooling, aided by persistent rainfall that sustains breeding. Health authorities intensified surveillance and vector-control, including interventions in Yerba Buena (Barrio 120 Viviendas). Incubation is 3–7 days; fever above 39°C with severe joint pain (hands, feet, wrists, ankles); rash in about half; myalgias and fatigue. No vaccine or specific treatment; prevention hinges on eliminating breeding sites: remove or store containers, scrub and rinse to destroy eggs, cover drains, keep pools chlorinated, and empty water storage containers every 3 days, as Aedes eggs can survive up to a year.

triage.headline_ja: トゥクマン州のチクングニヤ警報：ウイルスの地域社会的流行を確認
triage.triage_reason: チクングニヤの地域社会的流行（15日間で10例から93例に増加）が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当し、スクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」が認められるため、フルRRA実施が必要である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはメキシコ（ベラクルス州、エルマナンティアル）、アルゼンチン（トゥクマン州）、フィリピン（カラバルソン地域）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではアルゼンチンのトゥクマン州を主題としている。フィリピンはGeoNamesリストに含まれる対象国であり、APIの位置付けから確認されるため verified_locations に含める。メキシコとアルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sincicial também traz risco para idosos, alertam especialistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Syncytial Virus also poses a risk to the elderly, experts warn.
article.articleSummary: RSV now accounts for a substantial share of SARI in Brazil. In Q1, 18% of lab-confirmed SARI cases were due to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV); in Feb–Mar, RSV represented 14% of confirmed-viral SARI. Private laboratories reported 38% RSV positivity among tested viruses in the week ending 4 April 2026, 12 points higher than early March. Of about 27,600 SARI cases in Q1, only one third had an identified etiologic agent; nearly 17% were not tested. RSV remains the leading cause of bronchiolitis in infants; among 1,651 severe RSV cases Jan–Mar, 1,342 were under 2 years, while 46 were in adults over 50. Total deaths this year: 27 (17 in infants ≤2; 7 in adults ≥65). In adults, RSV increases pneumonia risk 2.7-fold and doubles the risk of ICU admission, intubation, and death versus influenza. Vaccines for adults are currently available only in private networks; Brazil’s SUS offers vaccination for pregnant women to protect newborns, a point discussed at a São Paulo seminar.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器合胞体ウイルス（RSV）は高齢者にも危険をもたらす、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSVの著しい増加と重症例の増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。しかし現段階では社会的・政治的関心の詳細が不明であり、フルRRA前の継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: RSVがブラジルで急速に拡大しており、Q1では確認されたSARI症例の18%を占めている。高齢者での重症化リスク増加（成人での肺炎リスク2.7倍、ICU入院・死亡リスク2倍）が報告されている。IHR基準を2つ満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も4つ該当。ただし、ブラジル国内での対応状況やWHO/国際的な懸念表明の詳細は記事に記載されていないため、WATCHカテゴリが適切。続報により、より深刻なシグナルとなる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: പേവിഷബാധ: പാവറട്ടിയിലെ തെരുവുനായ്ക്കൾക്ക് പ്രതിരോധ കുത്തിവെപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies: Preventive vaccination for Pavaratty's street dogs.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, rabies has been confirmed in a stray dog in Pavaratty Panchayat, Kerala, prompting preventive vaccination of street dogs in the area. Following confirmation, vaccination campaigns were launched in 5th Ward and 13th Ward. The attacks originated in Paikanniyoor, Pulincherrippadi, Kakkassheri, and Poovathur, where the rabid dog had bitten domestic animals and other dogs. Yesterday, four individuals—including a woman, a student, and two former public representatives—were bitten by a street dog and are receiving medical treatment. The dog involved was later found dead with a rope around its neck; laboratory assessment by a veterinary surgeon confirmed rabies. Panchayat President Anto Lijo and veterinary surgeon Dr. Vinodkumar led the preventive operations.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病：パヴァラッティの野良犬に対する予防接種
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の人間への感染が複数件報告されており、地域での積極的な予防対策が展開されている。IHR基準で「異常性」と「公衆衛生への影響」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行可能性」に該当するため、シグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事はマラヤーラム語（ケーララ州の地方メディア）で、野良犬による複数の咬傷事例と、確認済みの狂犬病陽性犬、および複数の患者が医学的治療を受けている事実が記載されている。ケーララ州パンチャヤット当局と獣医局による即応対応が確認されている。狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物由来だが、暴露リスクと重症度が高く、地域公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 天气转暖蚊虫蜱虫活跃，户外活动需做好防范
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the weather warms, mosquitoes and ticks become more active; outdoor activities require precautions.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi, China reports rising mosquito and tick activity as temperatures rise. In Nanning, the Aedes aegypti (white-striped mosquito), commonly called tiger mosquito, is the main vector for dengue fever and chikungunya; daytime activity peaks 7-9 am and 5-7 pm when temperatures exceed 15°C. No conclusive evidence of a larger mosquito population this year; continue routine preventive measures and avoid prolonged exposure in dense mosquito areas. If fever, rash, or joint pain occurs, seek care at a正规 hospital. Ticks are also active with warmer weather; outdoors, inspect head, neck, and body for ticks. Ticks can be sesame-seed-sized and swell after feeding; remove vertically to avoid rupture. Tick bites may carry viruses; use DEET-based repellents before outdoor activity. If fever, malaise, headache, or nausea occurs after outdoor activity, seek medical care and report exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 天気が温かくなると蚊とダニが活発になり、屋外活動には予防措置が必要
triage.triage_reason: 中国広西地域でのデング熱・チクングニアの媒介蚊活動が報告されているが、現在のところ実際の患者発生は記載されていない。媒介蚊の活動増加に対する予防啓発が主目的の記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の患者発生ではなく、季節的な媒介蚊（Aedes aegypti）とダニの活動増加に対する予防啓発が目的。デング熱・チクングニアは流行しやすい病原体であり、中国広西地域は既知のリスク地域であるため、媒介蚊活動の増加は継続観察の対象となる。ただし現時点では疑い症例や確定例の報告がないため、WATCH段階の判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus sincicial também traz risco para idosos, alertam especialistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory syncytial virus also poses a risk to the elderly, experts warn.
article.articleSummary: RSV ( respiratory syncytial virus ) poses rising risk to Brazil’s elderly amid ongoing SRAG surveillance. In Q1 2026, RSV caused 18% of SRAG with confirmed viral etiology; Feb–Mar RSV accounted for 14%, rising to 19.9% by Mar–Apr, while 2025 saw RSV as the most prevalent virus for 23 consecutive weeks (Mar–Aug). Private laboratories reported 38% of positive viral tests in the week ending Apr 4 as RSV, 12 percentage points higher than early March. Of about 27,600 SRAG cases in Q1, only 9,079 had the causative virus identified; nearly 17% were not tested. Severe RSV cases Jan–Mar totaled 1,651, with 1,342 in children under 2; only 46 were in adults over 50. Overall deaths this year: 27 (17 in infants ≤2; 7 in adults ≥65). RSV raises pneumonia risk 2.7× in the elderly and doubles ICU admission, intubation, and death risk versus influenza. Comorbidities (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic respiratory disease) amplify vulnerability; discussed at a São Paulo GSK seminar on Mar 7.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器合胞体ウイルス（RSV）は高齢者にも危険をもたらす、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSVの継続的な監視データが報告されており、高齢者への重症化リスクが指摘されている。ただし、現時点では大規模な集団発生や国際的な脅威の証拠が不足しており、情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: RSVによる重症例（特に高齢者での肺炎リスク2.7倍、ICU入院・挿管・死亡リスク2倍）が報告されており、継続的なSRAG監視下で進行中。Q1 2026でRSVはSRAG確定症例の18%を占め、3月から4月にかけて19.9%に上昇。死亡例は27例（高齢者7例）と限定的だが、高齢者層への健康被害が懸念される。ブラジル国内での監視・報告は機能しており、現時点では国際的拡大の直接的証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndrome respiratória aguda grave dobram estados entram em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases double as states go on alert.
article.articleSummary: Public health emergency in Belo Horizonte, Brazil amid SRAG pressures; 2024: 50,000 healthcare visits for respiratory symptoms and 21 SRAG-related deaths in the city. Fiocruz reports Brazil has over 31,000 SRAG cases in 2026; rhinovirus accounts for 40.8% of positive viral tests, influenza 30.7%. The influenza strain circulating is one seen in the Northern Hemisphere previously; arrival to Brazil occurred early with low vaccination coverage, accelerating transmission and severe cases. The Ministry of Health aims to vaccinate 90 million people nationwide; vaccination is crucial for vulnerable groups to prevent progression to severe disease. The public SUS vaccine covers main circulating influenza strains; authorities stress immunization as the most effective way to avoid hospitalizations and fatal outcomes from respiratory infections.

triage.headline_ja: 重症急性呼吸器症候群の症例が倍増、各州がアラート状態に突入
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザによる重症呼吸器症候群が全国的に拡大し、31,000件以上の症例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な懸念が示唆される。スクリーニング基準で複数該当し、ブラジル全域での政府対応が明確。
triage.notes: ブラジルで検出されているインフルエンザ株は北半球で以前流行したものであり、ワクチン接種率の低さと相まって急速な伝播が起きている。Fiocruzの報告により31,000件以上のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例が確認され、保健省は9,000万人へのワクチン接種を目標としている。この情報は公開ソースからの報道であり、信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes soroti penanganan AIDS, TBC, dan malaria di Papua Pegunungan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health highlights AIDS, TB, and malaria management in the Papua Highlands.
article.articleSummary: Six districts in the Papua Highlands—Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang—receive ongoing Global Fund support to combat AIDS, Tuberculosis, and malaria. The Indonesian Ministry of Health, through Adinkes, urges serious handling of AIDS, TB, and malaria (ATM) in Papua Highlands to minimize fatalities. Ferdinan J Laihad, an Adinkes executive, said control must be well implemented and synchronized between central and provincial/district programs, with cross-sector collaboration across government, NGOs, and communities. Management cannot be done by health offices alone. The program emphasis remains in the six districts, with a plan to expand, but security concerns require relocating/merging activities to specific locations with central approval. The goal is elimination of ATM in Papua Highlands, improving community safety and welfare. Article location: Wamena, Indonesia; publication 11 Apr 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がパプア高地のエイズ、結核、マラリア対策を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 結核とマラリアを含む複数感染症が対象国インドネシアのパプア高地で報告されているが、記事は主に既存プログラムの強化と管理体制の改善について述べており、新たな流行やアウトブレイクの兆候は明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはパプア高地における既存のAIDS・結核・マラリア対策プログラムの管理体制改善に焦点を当てており、新規アウトブレイクや急速な流行拡大の兆候は示されていない。6地区でのGlobal Fund支援継続と対策強化が述べられているが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・急増の証拠は提示されていない。セキュリティ懸念による活動の制約が言及されている点は注目に値するが、感染症の実際の動向を把握するには追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă: virus din fructe de mare și pești ajunge la oameni și poate provoca o boală gravă a ochilor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: a virus from shellfish and fish reaches humans and can cause a serious eye disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 April 2026, a nodavirus (CMNV) previously confined to marine animals has crossed a barrier and is linked to a human eye disease: persistent ocular hypertension with anterior viral uveitis. In China, unexplained case increases have raised concern. In a study of 70 patients, viral particles were detected in ocular tissues of affected individuals but not in healthy controls; genetic testing showed ~99% identity to CMNV strains found in marine life. Laboratory experiments in cell cultures and mice reproduced the ocular symptoms, supporting causality. CMNV has been identified in dozens of marine species, including crabs and mollusks, across Asia, Africa, Europe, Antarctica, and the Americas, indicating global spread. Transmission appears tied to handling or consuming raw or undercooked seafood, underscoring new food-safety and surveillance needs for seafood markets worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: 警告: 貝類と魚のウイルスが人間に感染し、深刻な眼疾患を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 新興の人畜共通感染症（ノドウイルス）による説明のつかない眼疾患の増加が中国で報告され、ヒト感染の確実な証拠（70例の患者研究、遺伝子同定99%）、国際的な海洋生物での流行、食品媒介感染の可能性があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはスペイン（カナリア諸島）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な懸念は中国での説明のつかない症例増加に集中している。ノドウイルス（CMNV）は複数大陸の海洋生物で検出されているものの、対象国リストではアジア・アフリカの明記はなく、中国のみが確実に該当する。食品媒介感染の可能性と国際的な海産物市場への影響から、世界保健サーベイランスの拡大が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança pelo Brasil e já tem 24 mil casos prováveis em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya is spreading across Brazil and already has 24,000 probable cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya is spreading rapidly in Brazil, with over 24,000 probable cases in 2026. Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, has declared a state of emergency, affecting more than 4,000 residents. Nearby Indigenous communities report upwards of 1,200 cases and six deaths. A screening center serves about 20,000 Indigenous people. Rio de Janeiro also shows rising cases compared with last year. Nationwide, 15 deaths have been confirmed. A Butantan Institute vaccine has been approved by Anvisa but is still in a pilot phase in Mirassol, São Paulo. The Army and SUS’s National Force operate in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve to install traps and reduce Aedes aegypti breeding. The federal government will allocate over 27 million reais to strengthen public health services. Families are urged to weekly eliminate mosquito breeding sites to curb Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアがブラジル全土に広がり、2026年には24,000件の疑い例が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当（重症度、流行しやすさ）、かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチクングニア、デング、ジカの同時流行を示唆。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれ、複数州（マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州のドゥラドス、リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ）で確認。先住民コミュニティでの死亡例と高い罹患率が重症度を示唆。ワクチン展開進行中だが、パイロット段階。国家動員レベルでの公式対応が進行中（政府予算配分、軍隊配備）。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penyakit ATM di Papua, Ini Penjelasan Kemenkes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Wary of ATM Disease in Papua; Here Is the Ministry of Health's Explanation.
article.articleSummary: Six districts in the Papua Highlands—Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang—are the focus of intensified control of AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria (ATM), per Indonesia’s Ministry of Health via Adinkes. With Global Fund support, ATM programs in these districts aim to serve as a model for nationwide elimination of AIDS, TB, and malaria. Effective containment requires structured, coordinated action across central and local governments, NGOs, and communities, not reliance on health offices alone. No changes to the intervention zones were announced, but field operations are adjusted due to security concerns, including consolidating activities at selected sites with Adinkes central approval. The objective is to reduce ATM transmission, prevent deaths, and improve living conditions in the Papua Highlands through cross-sector collaboration and alignment between national and regional authorities.

triage.headline_ja: パプアのATM病に注意、保健省の説明は以下の通り
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのパプア地域における結核とマラリアの制御活動に関する報道であり、異常な疾患発生を示すものではなく、既存プログラムの実施状況を報じたもの。情報が不足しており、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はATM（AIDS/結核/マラリア）の既存制御プログラムに関する説明であり、新規のアウトブレイクや急性の危機的状況を示していない。パプア高地における長期的な曝露と流行性疾患の存在は確認されるが、イベントの深刻度や異常性に関する具体的数値が不足している。セキュリティ上の懸念から現場活動の調整が行われている旨の記載があり、地域的課題の複雑性が示唆されているが、公衆衛生上の危機としての急性度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 牲畜屍體堆成山...中12省爆發口蹄疫！當局1強硬舉動惹怒網：果真共產國 | 國際 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock carcasses pile up into mountains... Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in 12 central Chinese provinces! Authorities' one hardline move angers netizens: a truly Communist nation
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease, South African type, has erupted in 12 Chinese provinces, including Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, and the North/Northeast regions. The virus is highly airborne, prompting emergency market closures and strict livestock transport bans that have devastated the livestock sector. Live cattle and swine markets were shut; prices collapsed; farmers face slaughter or destocking with mortality risk in young stock exceeding 60%. Official information remains limited, but reports show images of carcasses and crowded markets with little activity. Enforcement by local authorities is described as heavy-handed, with allegations in Xinjiang that teams entered homes and injected animals with unknown drugs and removed unresponsive livestock, without transparently provided test results. The article provides no laboratory confirmation or data on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜の遺体が山積み...中国12省で口蹄疫が大発生！当局の強硬措置がネットユーザーを激怒させる：本当に共産主義国家だ
triage.triage_reason: 中国の12省にわたる口蹄疫（南アフリカ型）の大規模発生であり、IHR基準における異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準における重症度（畜産部門への深刻な影響、若い家畜の死亡率60%超）、流行しやすさ（高い空気感染性）、管理可能性（情報開示不足、当局対応への疑問）が複数該当するため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は南アフリカ型の口蹄疫がシンジャン、内モンゴルを含む中国12省で発生していることを明記。高い空気感染性、市場閉鎖、家畜輸送禁止、若い家畜の死亡率60%超、当局による強硬措置（不透明な薬剤注射、立ち入り）が報告されている。ただし、実験室確認や輸出入事例データは記事に記載なし。国内対応の不透明性が社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya avança pelo Brasil com 24 mil casos prováveis em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya spreads across Brazil with 24,000 probable cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya spreads across Brazil in 2026 with more than 24,000 probable cases. Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, declared a state of emergency after over 4,000 residents affected, with Indigenous communities most affected (more than 1,200 confirmed cases in nearby Indigenous areas and at least six deaths). A triage center has been established to serve about 20,000 people, expediting diagnosis and referrals. Rio de Janeiro reports a surge in cases compared with last year, with 15 deaths to date. A Butantan Institute chikungunya vaccine has ANVISA approval but remains in a pilot in Mirassol, São Paulo, in an experimental phase. The Armed Forces are aiding Dourados to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding, deploying traps and surveillance. The federal government pledges over R$27 million to strengthen public health response. Preventive efforts stress weekly elimination of breeding sites to curb transmission by Aedes aegypti, including removing standing water and case monitoring in health units.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がブラジル全土で拡大、2026年に24,000件の推定患者数
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：24,000患者・死亡報告、異常な拡大パターン、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国ブラジルでの実際の流行イベント。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱の急速な拡大。患者数24,000以上、死亡者6名以上（リオデジャネイロで15名）。先住民コミュニティで特に深刻（確認患者1,200名以上）。緊急事態宣言発令、連邦政府による対応強化（R$2,700万以上の予算投入）、ワクチン接種パイロット実施中。ベクター対策展開中。国際的な感染症流行リスク判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes harap penyakit ATM Papua Pegunungan ditangani secara serius - ANTARA News Kalimantan Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Health Ministry hopes the ATM disease in the Papua Highlands will be treated seriously.
article.articleSummary: AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria (ATM) in the Papua Highlands require serious, coordinated action to prevent deaths, according to Indonesia's Health Ministry via the Adinkes network. The Ministry urges provincial and district governments to push ATM programs for better central-local synchronization and elimination of the disease. Effective control depends on cross-sector government and community involvement, not just health agencies. The effort centers on six districts in Papua Highlands that currently receive Global Fund support for AIDS, TB, and malaria control. Those districts are Jayawijaya, Nduga, Yahukimo, Mamberamo Tengah, Yalimo, and Pegunungan Bintang. The program could be expanded beyond these districts, but Global Fund planning remains focused on the six loci. Security concerns have led to adjustments in intervention delivery, with activities consolidated in certain locations with approval from the central Adinkes.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省がパプア高地のATM疾患の真摯な対応を期待
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのパプア高地におけるAIDS・結核・マラリア（ATM）の同時流行に対し、保健省が公式に深刻化を警告し、多セクター間の政府関与が必要とされている。重症度が高く国家レベルの対応が進行中であり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・深刻性）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: パプア高地（Jayawijaya、Nduga、Yahukimo、Mamberamo Tengah、Yalimo、Pegunungan Bintang）の6地区で複合感染症流行。Global Fund支援を受けており、国際支援既に関与。セキュリティ上の制約により介入活動に制限がある点も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: 1.254 pasien TBC di Lebak jalani pengobatan selama Januari-Maret - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,254 tuberculosis patients in Lebak undergo treatment during January-March - ANTARA News Banten
article.articleSummary: 1,254 tuberculosis patients in Lebak Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia, were undergoing treatment during January–March 2026, per the Lebak Health Office. This accounts for 21% of an estimated 5,927 positive TB cases for the period, with no deaths reported. Indonesia ranks second globally in TB burden after India. Diagnosis and treatment follow standards: all suspected TB cases (coughing >3 months) are screened, and confirmed TB patients receive 6–12 months of uninterrupted therapy. Before treatment, patients undergo Tes Cepat Molekuler (TCM) rapid molecular testing. Free treatment is provided under the Standard Minimal Service (SPM) and the Free Health Check Program (CKG). Public health measures emphasize Clean Living and Healthy Behavior (PHBS), ventilation, avoiding smoking/alcohol, and maintaining a clean environment. Weekly contact tracing and Thursday house screenings of TB contacts by local cadres aim to detect new cases early and ensure adherence, with family-led Medication Supervision (PMO) during the six-month regimen.

triage.headline_ja: 1,254人の結核患者がレバック県で1月～3月の治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者の定期的な治療状況報告であり、異常な集団発生や新興感染症の危機的な拡大ではない。患者数、死亡報告なし、検査・治療システムが確立されており、公式な定期統計情報の域を出ていない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性疾患であり通常の疾病負荷であって、検査陽性率21%、死亡報告なしは管理下にあることを示唆。記事は公式な保健統計の報告であり、CEPR EBS活動の優先対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ nguy kịch vì mắc bệnh tay chân miệng không triệu chứng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child in critical condition due to asymptomatic hand-foot-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Two children in Vietnam presented with severe hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) linked to enterovirus EV71, treated at Ho Chi Minh City’s Nhi Dong 2 Hospital in April 2026. Case1: a 1-year-old boy from Dat Do, TPHCM, began with fever and sore throat, then developed a subtle rash; rapid deterioration with autonomic instability and respiratory failure requiring intubation, dialysis, and inotropes. After >3 days, condition improved with weaning to CPAP and ongoing neuro monitoring. Case2: a 3-year-old from Khanh Hoa Province started with fever and rash, later exhibited neurological signs; given IVIg, then deteriorated with fever 39°C, pulmonary edema, tachycardia up to 230/min, and hypoxemia, necessitating ventilation, dialysis, and vasopressors; after 6 hours stabilized and dialysis was discontinued after 3 days. Ho Chi Minh City CDC notes EV71 accounts for about 56% of samples in early 2026, with high virulence, fecal-oral and direct contact transmission, and potential for rapid CNS involvement and death within 12–24 hours without timely intervention.

triage.headline_ja: 無症状だが手足口病で危篤状態の子ども
triage.triage_reason: EV71による重篤な手足口病2症例（呼吸不全、神経症状、需要な集中治療）が報告され、地域的なEV71の高い病原性（56%の検体で検出、12-24時間以内の死亡リスク）が確認されている。IHR基準では「異常性」「重症度」が明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム（Ho Chi Minh City、Khanh Hoa Province）でのEV71関連HFMD症例を明確に述べており、地域疫学データ（EV71が56%の検体を占める、高い病原性）と臨床の重篤性が強調されている。小児に対する急速な進行（12-24時間以内の死亡リスク）が報告されている点で公衆衛生上の懸念は顕著。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito hotspots sting Nagpur
article.articleSummary: Nagpur's Lakadganj, Hanuman Nagar, Nehru Nagar and Mangalwari are high-risk zones for mosquitoes, with persistent Culex densities from January to March and early Aedes presence signaling dengue risk. January hotspots included Hanuman Nagar (33.66), Satranjipura (32.60) and Dhantoli (30.35); February saw Hanuman Nagar peak at 37.66, Lakadganj 33.07 and Mangalwari 32.08. By March, Lakadganj (37.43), Nehru Nagar (36.11) and Mangalwari (36.09) remained top densities, with Gandhibagh (28.37) and Dhantoli (34.16) also breeding. Aedes indices persisted in Dharampeth (1.58) and Hanuman Nagar (1.47); Anopheles stephensi appeared in Gandhibagh (0.02) and Lakadganj (0.10), indicating malaria risk. Between January and March, two malaria, four chikungunya and 10 dengue cases were reported, with underreporting suspected. Despite 216 hours in Gandhibagh and 108 hours in Dhantoli, outcomes remained uneven, signaling fragmented control and rising risk as temperatures rise.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の温床がナグプルを襲う
triage.triage_reason: 複数の媒介蚊由来感染症（チクングニア、マラリア、デング）の同時発生が報告され、3ヶ月間で16症例が確認されている。蚊密度が高い地域での継続的な曝露リスクがあり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行性）を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: ナグプル市内の複数地域でCulex、Aedes、Anopheles stephensiが同時に検出され、複合的な蚊媒介感染症リスク環境が形成されている。2〜3ヶ月の短期間で4つのチクングニア、10のデング、2のマラリア症例が報告されており、過少報告の可能性も指摘されている。統制措置の効果がばらついているため、気温上昇に伴い蚊密度が増加する季節への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Poliomyelitis revisited
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis is a paralytic viral disease caused by poliovirus (Enterovirus, Picornaviridae). Evidence traces to ancient Egypt; a 1789 clinical description and a 1894 Vermont outbreak of 132 cases. The virus was identified in 1908; three strains were described in 1930. Jonas Salk’s inactivated polio vaccine was developed in 1953 and became the US-recommended immunization by 1999. Africa was declared wild poliovirus–free in August 2020, with Nigeria likewise. In 2003 polio was endemic in India, Niger, Pakistan, Afghanistan and Egypt, with later importations to polio-free countries. Transmission is fecal–oral and via infected mucus; virus shedding occurs in throat and stool, with June–September peaks in areas with low immunization and poor sanitation. There is no cure; treatment is supportive, including respiratory support and physical therapy. Risk groups include the very young, pregnant women, the immunocompromised, and travelers to endemic areas such as Pakistan and Afghanistan.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオミエリティスの再考
triage.triage_reason: ポリオウイルスは国際的に重要な病原体であり、IHR基準を複数満たす可能性があるが、記事は歴史的背景と一般的な疾患情報を述べた教育的内容であり、現在の具体的な発生事例や流行の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオウイルスの歴史的背景と一般的な特性に関する教育記事であり、現在進行中の発生事例の詳細が記載されていない。サマリーではインドは2003年に風土病であったと過去形で述べられており、パキスタンとアフガニスタンは現在の風土病地域として言及されている。ただし対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ。IHR基準は満たされるが、具体的な流行の詳細や現在の危機的状況が不明であるため、フルRRA前の継続的監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 已出现相关病例 正是高峰期！武汉疾控提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Related cases have already appeared—this is the peak period! Wuhan CDC reminds.
article.articleSummary: Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) has been reported in Wuhan, with cases. As of 1 April 2026, SFTS is designated a Class B infectious disease under China’s Law on Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases, triggering enhanced prevention and control measures. SFTS is tick-borne; symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, and thrombocytopenia, with elderly and those with underlying illness at higher risk of severe disease, multi-organ failure, bleeding, and death. Tick activity peaks April–July; ticks have been found in grasslands, woodlands, shrubs, and parks, and can be carried by birds and pets. Prevention includes wearing protective clothing, using repellents (DEET or permethrin), avoiding prolonged exposure in grassy areas, and checking for ticks after outdoor activities. If bitten, remove carefully with tweezers, disinfect, and seek medical care within 14 days if symptoms appear. Transmission can occur via contact with patient blood or secretions. Patriotic Health Month emphasizes cleaning and pet protection.

triage.headline_ja: 関連症例が既に発生—これは流行期です！武漢疾病対策センターが注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）が武漢で報告されており、中国が Class B 感染症に指定し強化対策を実施。ダニ媒介感染症として4～7月が活動ピークであり、高齢者や基礎疾患患者の重症化・死亡リスクがある。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」で懸念あり。
triage.notes: SFTS は既知の新興感染症だが、武漢での複数症例報告と「高峰期」の警告が公式発出されている点が重要。ダニ媒介感染症のため、4～7月の季節的ピークと野外活動増加のリスク要因がある。記事は正式な予防啓発であり、政府・疾病対策当局による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: سمندری غذائوں میں وائرس آنکھوں کی بیماری کا سبب بن رہا ہے،تحقیق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study: A virus in seafood is causing an eye disease.
article.articleSummary: On 12 April 2026, researchers in China linked Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV) — previously known to infect shrimp and other seafood — to a human ocular disease named Persistent Ocular Hypertension Viral Anterior Uveitis (POH-VAU). CMNV DNA/RNA was detected in eye tissues of affected patients, and several cases reported recent exposure to raw seafood or aquatic animals. If confirmed, CMNV would be the first marine-origin virus implicated in human eye disease, posing a potential future public health problem. The report does not provide case counts or outbreak data; it underscores the need for further laboratory confirmation and surveillance to assess zoonotic spillover and possible human-to-human transmission, and to determine whether seafood exposure is the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 研究：海産物のウイルスが眼病を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 未知の疾患と新規の人獣共通感染症リンケージが報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数項目に該当するが、症例数・流行規模・確定診断などの詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRA前の追加情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はCMNVと眼疾患POH-VAUの新規リンケージを報告する研究発表のみで、症例数、重症度分布、ヒト-ヒト感染の有無、公衆衛生上の影響規模などが全く記載されていない。海産物接触が持続的な曝露源となる可能性は示唆されるが、確定診断の状況、サーベイランス体制、中国内での広がりなど重要な詳細が欠落している。続報による情報確認が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 28 fogging machines defunct,mosquito menace plagues city
article.articleSummary: Nagpur's malaria and filaria department reports 28 of 51 hand fogging machines defunct or awaiting repairs, with 19 under repairs and 9 condemned, leaving 27 working. A shortfall of 17 machines and a demand gap for 17 more undermine vector control as malaria, dengue and other vector-borne diseases loom ahead of the monsoon. The crisis is worst in Mangalwari (1 of 7 working), Hanuman Nagar (2 of 5), and Lakadganj (2 of 4). Spraying units total 126 (demand gap 45); vehicle-mounted machines 11 (including HQ), all but one in use on main roads. Interior localities remain exposed. Residents report inequities in fogging, with calls for broader coverage. Health committee chairperson Manisha Atkare orders at least one fogging round per prabhag weekly and urges coordination with corporators to prioritise mosquito-prone pockets, though non-functional machinery hampers implementation.

triage.headline_ja: 28台の噴霧機が不調、蚊の被害が都市を悩ます
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱の潜在的リスク報道だが、記事の主題は機械整備不足と媒介生物対策の管理問題。現在の流行状況・患者発生の記載がなく、発病や死亡の具体的情報も不明。今後の雨季に向けた予防的準備状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はNagpur市の媒介生物対策インフラの不備を報道しており、マラリア・デング熱への暴露リスクは存在するが、現時点での発病や流行の報告はなし。雨季前の予防体制不備として注視する価値がある。政府当局が対応を指示している点から社会的・政治的関心あり。

article.articleHeadline: The Economic and Health Burden of Chikungunya Virus in Brazil (2011-2020) - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 3.2 million chikungunya virus (CHIKV) cases from 2011–2020, with an economic and health burden of US$9.8 billion. A cost-effectiveness analysis evaluates vaccination for adults 18+ using live-attenuated and recombinant vaccines, implemented through a modified Susceptible-Vaccinated-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered-Deceased model to reduce CHIKV impact. The work frames CHIKV within the broader vector-borne disease challenge and references 2019 Global Burden of Disease estimates: dengue 2.38 million DALYs, yellow fever 290,000 DALYs, Zika 347 DALYs. Authors note that global CHIKV burden is likely underestimated, citing a December 3, 2024 BMJ Global Health model-driven analysis underscoring the need for comprehensive prevention and control strategies. The study provides a data-driven framework to guide Brazilian health authorities in vaccination policy to mitigate substantial health and economic costs. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱ウイルスの経済的および健康負担（2011-2020年）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2011-2020年の過去データに基づく回顧的分析・経済評価であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。信号としては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な経済分析・ワクチン費用効果分析論文の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイク事象ではない。過去10年間のデータ集計とモデリング研究に基づくシステマティックな負担評価が主題である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: "A tuberculose não acabou", diz John Green, que lança livro sobre a "infecção mais mortal" - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: " Tuberculosis isn't over," says John Green, who launches a book about the "deadliest infection" - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, tuberculosis (TB) kills about 1.2 million people annually worldwide, including in the United States and Brazil. John Green’s book, Tudo é tuberculose: a história e a reincidência de nossa infecção mais mortal (Intrínseca, 2024), argues TB is not over and has become a disease of populations with limited access to drugs. The article emphasizes that TB control hinges on active case finding, universal treatment, and preventive care for contacts, rather than new technology. Stigma remains a major barrier; survivors report family abandonment and health workers sometimes bearing burial duties due to fear. Policy context is highlighted: the 2025 U.S. administration cut treatment access for hundreds of thousands, later partially restored, but resistance and costs can rise. Advocacy and sustained global health funding are presented as crucial to reduce stigma and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「結核は終わっていない」とジョン・グリーンが語り、「最も致命的な感染症」に関する本を発表 - ジョルナル・オ・スル
triage.triage_reason: 結核は年間約120万人の死亡者を出す公衆衛生上の重大な影響を持つ疾患であり、米国とブラジルでの発生が報告されている。政策変化（2025年の米国政府の治療アクセス削減）による国際的な懸念も示唆されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）および社会政治的関心が認められるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルメディア（Jornal O Sul）での発表であり、ブラジルでの結核対策に焦点。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは主に政策文脈として言及されており、主要な流行地としての確認は限定的。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に列挙。著名著作家による啓発活動と政策変化が社会的・政治的関心を引き起こしており、特にアクセス不平等と薬剤耐性に関する懸念が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes tetapkan KLB campak di tujuh daerah Sulawesi Selatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health declares a measles outbreak in seven areas of South Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: Seven areas in South Sulawesi were designated measles outbreak (KLB) by the Ministry of Health: Makassar City; Luwu; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur, reflecting national spread of measles. In Sulsel, 169 children tested positive for measles by April 8 after laboratory confirmation. Measles, caused by a virus, has shown rising cases since late 2025, with January–March 2026 signaling continued increases. Since December 2025, the MoH circulated an outbreak-mapping directive; Sulsel issued early readiness advisories to all local leaders. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaigns target children aged 9 months to 59 months to halt transmission. Data indicate most cases occur in unvaccinated children, underscoring weak herd immunity. Authorities urge vaccination uptake, especially for those with incomplete immunization, and maintain public health measures and vaccination campaigns to contain the KLB across the province.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が南スラウェシ州7地域の麻疹アウトブレイク（KLB）を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。インドネシア南スラウェシ州における169名の確定患者を伴う麻疹アウトブレイクであり、未接種児童に集中し、herd immunityの低下を示唆する懸念がある。
triage.notes: インドネシア南スラウェシ州（Sulawesi Selatan）で2026年4月8日時点で169名の確定患者が報告されている。2025年12月以降、全国的に麻疹患者が増加しており、2026年1月〜3月に上昇傾向が継続している。ほとんどの患者が未接種児童であり、予防接種率の低下が問題となっている。保健省はアウトブレイク対応予防接種（ORI）キャンペーンを9ヶ月から59ヶ月の小児を対象に展開している。

article.articleHeadline: Sulsel Siaga 1 Campak: 7 Kabupaten/Kota Ditetapkan KLB |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sulawesi Level 1 Measles Alert: 7 Regencies and Cities Declared an Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared (KLB) in seven districts/cities of South Sulawesi, Indonesia: Makassar City; Luwu Regency; Wajo; Sinjai; Bulukumba; Jeneponto; and Luwu Timur. The declaration follows a national upward trend in measles cases. As of 8 April, 169 children in South Sulawesi tested positive for measles by laboratory confirmation. The rise began in late 2025 with suspected cases in several districts; by early 2026, laboratory-confirmed cases increased as transmission expanded. Health authorities issued an early readiness circular to regional leaders and intensified preventive measures, including maintaining essential health services, promoting clean-living practices, and heightened surveillance. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaigns for children aged 9–59 months were rolled out to break transmission. Most cases occur in unvaccinated children, with herd immunity still low in some areas; even some vaccinated children may be infected if transmission is widespread.

triage.headline_ja: スラウェシ南部警報レベル1はしか：7つの県市が流行と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（予想外の上昇傾向）と国内複数地域への拡大が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度（検査確定169例）、流行しやすさ（未接種児童の高感受性）が該当。政府の警報レベル1宣言と広域的な対応実施があり、シグナルの積極拾い上げが必要。
triage.notes: スラウェシ南部州内の7地区で同時に流行宣言が発出されており、2025年末から上昇傾向が続いている。169例の検査確認例があり、未接種児童の割合が高く、一部の接種児童にも感染が見られている。ORI（アウトブレイク対応ワクチン接種）キャンペーンが実施されており、政府が積極的に対応している。国家レベルでの上昇傾向との関連性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: OIKN taps local residents to rid new capital of malaria and dengue
article.articleSummary: North Penajam Paser and Kutai Kartanegara in East Kalimantan, within the Nusantara Capital Core Government Area (KIPP), are the focus of the Nusantara Capital Authority (OIKN) malaria and dengue elimination plan. Local residents form health cadre teams to educate communities, manage environmental vectors, and sustain prevention in Nusantara. Malaria shows no local transmission in KIPP, but dengue remains a significant challenge. The authority aims to cut dengue by 50% by strengthening early warning systems and boosting community involvement in high-risk residential and construction zones with standing water. Before cadre formation, malaria and dengue prevention training was provided to housing managers and Occupational Health and Safety teams within KIPP. The Ministry of Health's Larvae-Free Village program pilots vector control in East Kalimantan (North Penajam Paser). The central government is drafting a larvae-free zone concept for areas like industrial zones and Nusantara.

triage.headline_ja: 新首都のマラリアとデング熱排除に向けヌサンタラが地域住民を動員
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのヌサンタラ新首都地域におけるマラリアおよびデング熱の管理・予防活動に関する記事。現在のところ局所的な疾病負荷が低く、予防的対策が進行中である。ただし、デング熱は依然として課題となっており、建設地域における水たまりなど環境的リスク要因が存在するため、情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新首都建設地域における予防的保健対策に焦点を当てており、重大な疾病発生や国際的拡大のリスクは現在報告されていない。ただしデング熱は環境的リスク（立ち水）と関連しており、建設工事による人口流入に伴う流行可能性があるため、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当。政府主導の予防対策が進行中であり、現時点ではWATCH段階が適切。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 全国流感病毒检测阳性率连续3周上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National influenza virus test positivity rate has risen for three consecutive weeks.
article.articleSummary: China's national influenza sentinel surveillance shows, as of late March/early April 2026, the influenza virus positive rate has risen for three consecutive weeks, with northern provinces recording higher positivity than the south. The upsurge is mainly driven by Influenza B, part of a pattern that peaks November–March; last B-dominant peak occurred in December 2023–January 2024, and immunity to B has waned amid temperature fluctuations. Beijing You’an Hospital infection department chief Li Tongzeng notes that A and B influenza symptoms are similar (fever, cough, sore throat, muscle aches), while children with B infection may experience vomiting and diarrhea more often than adults. Treatments within 48 hours of onset—oseltamivir, peramivir, baloxavir marboxil—reduce severe disease and shorten illness. Vaccination with trivalent or quadrivalent vaccines covers A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B strains, best completed by November. Other circulating viruses include rhinovirus, RSV, and parainfluenza; wear masks and practice good hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 全国流感病毒検査陽性率が3週連続で上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なインフルエンザB型の上昇であり、予想外ではなく重症度も限定的。ただし複数のウイルス（RSV、ライノウイルス、パラインフルエンザ）の同時流行兆候があり、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節的なインフルエンザB型の定期的なピークであり、サーベイランスデータは継続的な監視を示唆している。複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行が記載されているが、深刻度の記述はない。医学的な対応可能性（抗ウイルス薬、ワクチン）が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trung Quốc bùng phát dịch lở mồm long móng chủng mới, nguy cơ lây lan cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China faces outbreak of a novel strain of foot-and-mouth disease, with high risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: South Africa type 1 (SAT1) foot-and-mouth disease has been detected in China for the first time, with two outbreaks confirmed: Yining County, Yili Prefecture, Xinjiang, and Gulang County, Wuwei City, Gansu. SAT1, confirmed by Lanzhou Veterinary Research Institute, is a distinct strain with no cross-immunity to existing O/A vaccines. In Xinjiang, a market of 513 cattle reported 142 infections; in Gansu, a farm with 5,716 cattle had 77 infections. Authorities culled affected animals, disinfected sites, and launched epidemiological investigations. SAT1 can infect cattle, pigs, sheep, camels, deer, and other hoofed animals; incubation 2–14 days; symptoms include fever 40–41.5°C, inappetence, hypersalivation, vesicles in mouth/hooves/udders, and secondary infections after rupture; young animals may die from myocarditis, recovered animals may shed virus long-term. By 12 April, at least 12 provinces—Xinjiang, Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Ningxia, Hebei, Guizhou, Anhui—reported cases, with strict transport controls and market closures. An emergency SAT1 vaccine is being scaled up. Live pig futures fell to 9,125 CNY/ton (7 April); cash pig prices under 10 CNY/kg in many regions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種の口蹄疫が流行、感染拡大のリスク高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。複数省での急速な地理的拡散、SAT1という新規株の確認、既存ワクチン無効性、ヒトへの直接的健康被害がないが畜産産業への重大な経済的打撃を示す。
triage.notes: SAT1株は中国で初めて検出された新規株。既存O/A型ワクチンに対する交差免疫がなく、複数の易感染動物（牛、豚、羊、ラクダ、シカなど）に感染可能。12日時点で12省に拡大。緊急ワクチンの増産が進行中。畜産関連の市場価格（生豚先物価格が9,125元/トンに下落）への大きな影響あり。ヒト-ヒト感染はないが、国際的な畜産品貿易への制限リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी के इस जिले में 10-10 हजार की दवा 'पी' गए मच्छर! न बेहोश हुए न मरे, अब मच्छरदानी में खाना खा रहे ग्रामीण - mosquitoes immune funds badaun villagers forced eat inside nets
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In this district of Uttar Pradesh, mosquitoes were given a drug worth Rs 10,000, 'P'! They neither fainted nor died; now villagers are eating inside mosquito nets.
article.articleSummary: Rural areas of Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, report a rising mosquito problem as spraying funds are allocated (Rs 10,000 per Gram Panchayat) but reportedly not implemented, with control efforts appearing only on paper. Since Holi, warmer weather has fueled mosquito growth, and dusk swarms disrupt outdoor meals, forcing residents to eat under mosquito nets. Mosquito coils are said to have little effect. Health officials attribute breeding to poor sanitation, yet daily upkeep is lacking in many panchayats. District Malaria Officer Yogesh Saraswat says spraying is carried out where teams are available and will be dispatched to areas lacking coverage. The article does not provide malaria or other disease case counts, and focuses on gaps in vector-control funding and implementation in rural Uttar Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州のこの地区では、蚊が10万ルピー相当の薬を与えられた！気を失わず死ぬこともなく、今は村民が蚊帳の中で食事をしている
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの実際の患者発生が記事で報告されておらず、蚊の薬剤耐性と媒介物対策の不備に焦点が当たっている。潜在的なリスク要因は存在するが、疾病負荷の具体的情報がないため情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の薬剤耐性、ベクター制御資金の不適切な実施、衛生状態の悪化という構造的問題を指摘している。マラリア症例数は報告されていないが、ウッタル・プラデーシュ州の農村部における蚊媒介疾病のリスク環境の悪化は懸念される。続報でマラリア患者の増加が報告された場合、トリアージはPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Book Review: 'Mumbai Fights Back' Offers A Factual Inside Account Of How BMC Tackled Covid-19
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in Mumbai: Mumbai Fights Back, by Suresh Kakani (with Sumitra DebRoy), is a 18-chapter account of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation’s response to the pandemic across Mumbai’s three waves. The book, intended as a reference for future crises, details how Mumbai’s health systems adapted to the century’s biggest health emergency. Key measures included isolating slum populations, notably Dharavi, using a mix of hotels, dharamshalas, and camps. The narrative also highlights challenges from misinformation and media-fueled panic. It covers encounters with dubious products, including a spray claimed to kill coronavirus and immunity boosters, with Kakani noting BMC refused unverified items unless certified by government institutions. The work aims to provide facts and figures to guide frontline workers and authorities in mega-cities facing similar outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 書評：『ムンバイ・ファイツ・バック』 - BMCがCOVID-19にどう対処したかの事実に基づいた内部記録
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19パンデミック対応についての書評であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。新たな疾病動態、危機的状況、あるいは管理上の課題を示唆する内容がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はムンバイのCOVID-19対応についての書籍レビューであり、進行中のイベント報告ではない。歴史的な振り返りおよび教訓の記録として機能するものであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Infecções respiratórias desafiam o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Infections Challenge the Country.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A incidence remains high in Brazil, with 13 of 27 states reporting Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) at alert levels and rising over six weeks, Fiocruz reports. Affected states are Acre, Pará, Tocantins, Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Alagoas, Sergipe, Bahia, Mato Grosso, Goiás, Minas Gerais, and Espírito Santo; the Federal District is at risk. From January 4 to April 4, 1,445 SRAG cases were confirmed in the Federal District (about 16 per day), peaking at 208 in early March and easing to 60 in the week of March 29–April 4. SRAG can be triggered by influenza A, coronavirus, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, all circulating and potentially requiring hospitalization for elderly and infants. Since January 2026, 1,621 SRAG deaths have been recorded. The flu vaccination campaign began two weeks ago, with vaccines largely available through Brazil’s Unified Health System to reduce progression to severe disease; this follows the 2024 dengue outbreak and ongoing mass-immunization capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器感染症が国を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土13州で重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)がアラート水準に達し、2026年1月～4月で1,621人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常性」に該当。複数の呼吸器病原体(インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV、デング熱)が同時循環する多病原体イベント。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器病原体が同時に循環中。記事では13州の具体名が列挙されており、ブラジル全土での多病原体イベント。Fiocruzが報告していることから公式な公衆衛生当局の認識あり。死亡者数1,621名(2026年1月～4月)は重大な公衆衛生影響を示唆。フルRRA実施推奨。
